news.details: While he didn't see his usual volume on an afternoon in which Tyler Shough threw for only 144 yards, Olave was on the other end of one of the QB's three scores, hauling in an 18-yard TD early in the fourth quarter that proved to be crucial after the Giants staged a late, but unsuccessful, rally. Olave got double-digit targets in each of the first four games of the season, but over the last two contests he's been targeted just 13 times, posting an 8-89-1 line. news.details: For the fourth time in six games, Taylor came up just short of 100 rushing yards, but his 151 scrimmage yards were a season high, and he got into the end zone for the seventh time in 2026 on a four-yard run in the fourth quarter. His fumble was one of three Indy turnovers on the day, however, and it was Taylor's second lost fumble of the year. news.summary: Bowers (hamstring/calf) upgraded to a full practice Thursday, Anthony Galaviz of The Fresno Bee reports.
news.details: After popping up on the injury report Wednesday as a limited participant with a pair of new "injuries," Bowers was able to get in a full session Thursday and should be ready to roll for Sunday's game with the Rams. The top TE1 play every week, Bowers has 28 grabs for 382 yards and three touchdowns through four appearances.

news.summary: Collins caught three of five targets for 74 yards in Sunday's 34-31 win over the Jaguars. He added five yards on his only carry.
news.details: C.J. Stroud spread the ball around to 10 different pass catchers, and Jaylin Noel wound up being the most productive of the bunch with a 4-107-1 line. Collins still hit for a 42-yard gain on his first catch of the day, helping to set up a Foster Moreau TD in the first quarter. Collins has topped 70 receiving yards in three of his four games this season, compiling a 22-323-3 line on 30 targets. He'll take on an injury-thinned Giants secondary at home in Week 7.

news.summary: Bernard caught 11 of 12 targets for 87 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-19 overtime win over the Bucs.
news.details: With Michael Pittman (foot) and Roman Wilson (finger) out for the Steelers, Bernard was the clear WR2 behind DK Metcalf and actually ran a team-high 54 routes on Aaron Rodgers' 56 dropbacks. Metcalf edged Bernard out in targets 15 to 12, while both players caught 11 passes. Pittman and Wilson are both required to miss at least two and three more games, respectively, so Bernard is locked into an every-down role for the immediate future. Rodgers has sung the rookie wideout's praises early this sea

news.summary: Jeanty rushed 10 times for 22 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of six targets for 36 yards in the Raiders' 33-30 loss to the Bills on Sunday.
news.details: Jeanty's inefficient rushing line underscores how Buffalo's stout run defense essentially shut him down, but the 2025 first-round pick did manage to record a one-yard touchdown run, his first of the season, with 4:27 remaining in the first quarter. The Bills had also opened up a 10-point lead going into the final period, so Jeanty lost out on some work to Mike Washington as the Raiders went to more of a pass-centric approach. Jeanty now has been under 30 rushing yards in two straight games, but

news.summary: Henry rushed 17 times for 58 yards and brought in his only target for two yards in the Ravens' 13-10 loss to the Browns on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.
news.details: Henry looked like he was on his way to one of his signature performances when he rattled off 11- and 17-yard gains on Baltimore's opening possession, but the veteran back found running room at a premium for most of the rest of the contest. Henry finished without a touchdown for the second straight game and tallied his lowest rushing yardage total of the campaign, while his early fourth-quarter fumble led to a Browns game-tying touchdown. Henry will aim to bounce back in a Week 7 home divisional

news.summary: Hubbard rushed 28 times for 120 yards and a touchdown and brought in one of two targets for one yard in the Panthers' 25-14 win over the Eagles on Sunday.
news.details: Hubbard thoroughly dominated the Panthers' ground attack with AJ Dillon (ankle) sidelined and finished with his highest rushing workload of the campaign. Hubbard also hit the 120-yard mark on the ground for the second straight contest, and he added his fourth rush TD on a one-yard run early in the fourth quarter. news.summary: McBride caught seven of nine targets for 53 yards in Sunday's 18-16 win over the Rams.
news.details: McBride led the Cardinals in catches, receiving yards and targets as Arizona pulled off the upset on the back of six field goals. The star tight end led the NFL with 42 catches through five weeks and has at least seven receptions in every game this season. McBride is up to 49 catches for 361 yards and three touchdowns on 65 targets as the top option in the passing game for the Cardinals heading into a Week 7 home game against the Broncos.

news.summary: Brown rushed 13 times for 39 yards and brought in three of four targets for 21 yards in the Bengals' 31-24 win over the Dolphins on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.
news.details: As his final numbers corroborate, Brown found efficiency on the ground elusive against a surprisingly game Dolphins defense. The versatile back made a serviceable impact as a complementary option in the passing game, although his lost fumble came after a three-yard reception just past the midway point of the second quarter. McCarthy in the fourth quarter after throwing his second interception of the day, but Nabers stayed busy no matter who was under center for the Giants, leading the team in catches, targets and receiving yards. news.summary: Williams notched 10 carries for 50 yards and recorded three catches (on six targets) for 17 yards during Sunday's 18-16 defeat to the Cardinals.
news.details: Williams' rush total represents a season low as he ceded nine carries to reserve RB Blake Corum. Additionally, Williams also didn't reach the end zone for only the second time in six games in 2026, while Corum recorded a TD for the second consecutive contest. Williams is nearly exactly doubling up Corum in terms of touches on the campaign (110 versus 56), so he figures to be the better bet for a fantasy-relevant performance next Sunday in Las Vegas.

news.details: Love opened Week 7 prep as limited at Wednesday's walkthrough due to a back injury. news.details: The Lions offense got off to a generally non-descript start during a scoreless first quarter, but Goff helped fuel a 24-point breakout in the second quarter that set the tone for the lopsided win. Goff connected with Sam LaPorta (38 yards) and Jameson Williams (eight yards) for a pair of scoring tosses before halftime, and he added a 39-yard strike to Jameson Williams early in the third quarter before adding his one-yard scoring dive late in the period. news.details: St. Brown fell below his usual lofty standards with his numbers, but the star receiver still finished with team-high reception and target totals while also slotting in as the runner-up in receiving yards. St. Brown remains as integral a component of the Lions' air attack as ever, as he now has back-to-back 11-target games and has already seen 57 passes come his way overall in the first five contests of the campaign. news.summary: Watson (ankle) practiced in a limited fashion Thursday, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.
news.details: Watson now has logged a limited walkthrough and a capped practice to kick off Week 7 prep as he tends to an ankle issue. Head coach Matt LaFleur downplayed Watson's injury Thursday, telling Demovsky that he has no concerns about Watson and fellow WR Matthew Golden (shoulder) for Sunday's game in Detroit. Having said that, Watson may still be tagged with a designation when the Packers post their final practice report of the week Friday.

news.summary: Gibbs rushed 25 times for 151 yards and two touchdowns while bringing in five of six targets for 56 yards in the Lions' 45-21 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
news.details: Gibbs, and the Lions' offense as a whole, had a somewhat quiet start to the game, but the star running back soon began breaking through against the Cardinals defense and ultimately turned in another dominant performance. Gibbs recorded his first touchdown from one yard out early in the second quarter and went on to add a three-yard scoring rush with just over five minutes remaining to seal the high-scoring victory. news.summary: Warren carried the ball 14 times for 50 yards and caught two of four targets for 28 yards in Sunday's 26-19 overtime win over the Buccaneers.
news.details: While Warren still led the Steelers' backfield, his touch volume and production took a dip as Rico Dowdle returned from a three-game absence due to a toe injury, with Dowdle turning 10 touches into 49 scrimmage yards. As long as coach Mike McCarthy insists on using a timeshare between the two, Warren will be hard-pressed to repeat the outstanding numbers he compiled while Dowdle was on the shelf. Warren will try to make a bigger impact in Week 7 against the Saints in Paris.

news.summary: Walker ripped off 128 yards and two touchdowns on 19 carries and added two catches (on three targets) for 11 yards during Sunday's 22-6 win against the Chargers.
news.details: Following the Chiefs' Week 5 bye, Walker continued his early-season momentum with his new team, surpassing 100 yards on the ground for the fourth time in five games in a different uniform than the Seahawks. He now boasts 133.0 rushing yards per game, which prorated over a 17-game slate (2,261) would easily go past Eric Dickerson's NFL record 2,105 from the 1984 campaign and also mark the 10th 2,000-yard season in the history of the league. news.summary: Jacobs took part in practice Thursday, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.
news.details: Jacobs was removed from the commissioner's exempt list Monday, and while the Packers held a walkthrough Wednesday, it wasn't open to the media, so his activity Thursday marks his first visible on-field work since training camp. It remains unclear if Green Bay will clear him to play Sunday at Detroit, but the team has a roster exemption at its disposal that lasts until Monday, Oct. 26, which allows it flexibility if Jacobs isn't deemed ready to make his season debut this weekend.

news.summary: Smith-Njigba brought in 12 of 16 targets for 134 yards in the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday.
news.details: Despite the Broncos being down Pat Surtain (ankle) and Talanoa Hufanga (ankle), Smith-Njigba and the Seahawks' air attack as a whole couldn't get much going through the first half-plus of play. The All-Pro receiver turned it on in the later portion of the contest, however, and he ultimately finished with season highs in receptions and targets, along with his second-highest amount of receiving yards. news.summary: Mahomes completed 23 of 30 passes for 272 yards, no touchdowns and one interception and rushed five times for 16 yards during Sunday's 22-6 win versus the Chargers.
news.details: The Chiefs offense continues to be the Kenneth Walker show, as the No. 1 RB reeled off 100-plus rushing yards for the fourth time in five appearances to begin his tenure with the team. Meanwhile, Mahomes failed to record a touchdown pass for the first time this season after tossing multiple TDs in each of the first four contests. news.summary: Burrow completed 23 of 32 passes for 190 yards with four touchdowns and no interceptions and rushed four times for 10 yards in the Bengals' 31-24 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
news.details: Burrow averaged only 5.9 yards per attempt and finished with a season-low passing yardage total, but he offset the modest numbers by throwing a season-high number of touchdown passes. news.summary: Chase brought in six of 10 targets for 77 yards and a touchdown in the Bengals' 31-24 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
news.details: Chase was ultimately able to clear concussion protocol just before Sunday's game after exiting the Week 4 loss to the Jaguars with the head injury, and he finished as the Bengals' leader in all of receptions, receiving yards and targets against Miami. news.summary: Jefferson (ankle) practiced in full Thursday, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.
news.details: Jefferson's upgrade from limited Wednesday to uncapped one day later indicates that the ankle injury that has bothered him since the middle of a Week 3 win at Tampa Bay is behind him. He'll be taking on a Colts defense Sunday that has allowed the 10th-most yards per target (8.6) to opposing wide receivers this season.

news.summary: London brought in four of 10 targets for 62 yards in the Falcons' 31-23 loss to the Bears on Sunday. He also recorded a two-point conversion catch.
news.details: London finished second in both receptions and receiving yards on the afternoon for the Falcons, while also setting the pace in targets. The star wideout couldn't quite capitalize on a Bears defense that had proven beatable at times over the first five games of the season, and London ultimately equaled his second-lowest catch total of the campaign despite also tying his second-highest target tally. news.summary: Kittle brought in five of eight targets for 69 yards and a touchdown in the 49ers' 23-17 win over the Commanders on Monday night.
news.details: Kittle was one of Brock Purdy's most effective targets on the night, finishing with the 49ers' second-highest reception, receiving yardage and target totals. The athletic tight end also was on the other end of Brock Purdy's one touchdown pass, recording an 11-yard scoring grab to cap off the opening possession of the night. news.summary: McCaffrey rushed 16 times for 64 yards and two touchdowns and brought in nine of 10 targets for 53 yards in the 49ers' 23-17 win over the Commanders on Monday night. He also lost a fumble.
news.details: McCaffrey, who's been subject to a markedly lighter workload than usual over the first weeks of the campaign, recorded season highs in rush attempts, receptions, receiving yards and targets on a very busy night. The star running back also contributed his second multi-touchdown tally of the season, powering into the end zone on a pair of one-yard runs in the first half. news.details: While the final score wouldn't suggest it, the Falcons had to abandon the run fairly early Sunday, as the Bears already had a 21-7 lead at halftime before Atlanta made things somewhat interesting with a 16-point fourth quarter. Robinson therefore finished with his lowest rush attempt and rushing yardage totals of the season, although he did manage to average an impressive 6.8 yards per carry. news.summary: McMillan secured six of nine targets for 86 yards in the Panthers' 25-14 win over the Eagles on Sunday.
news.details: McMillan tied for the team lead in receptions with Jalen Coker while finishing second to his talented position mate in receiving yards and targets. The 2025 first-round pick was coming off a career-best 14-catch, 192-yard performance that also included two touchdowns against the Lions back in Week 4, and he's gone for at least 75 receiving yards in four of his first five games of the campaign as a Week 7 home divisional showdown against the Buccaneers approaches.

news.summary: Irving (illness) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice.
news.details: Several Buccaneers missed practice Wednesday due to an illness, including Irving. The third-year running back got back in the mix on Thursday, which is an encouraging step for him going into the team's Week 7 game against the Panthers. Provided Irving practices again on Friday, he'll be trending in the right direction to play.

news.summary: Vele caught three of six targets for 42 yards during the Saints' 34-27 win over the Giants on Sunday.
news.details: Vele was on the field for 66 of the Saints' 70 offensive snaps (94.3 percent), which was well ahead of fellow wideouts Chris Olave (42) and rookie Bryce Lance (36). Vele has seen at least six targets in each of the first six games of the regular season, and his 28-294-2 line on 43 targets already surpasses his totals across 13 regular-season games in 2025 (25-293-2 on 40 targets). news.summary: Johnson failed to reel in either of his targets during Sunday's 34-27 win over the Giants.
news.details: Johnson went without a catch in a regular-season contest for the first time since Week 3 of the 2024 campaign. The tight end had reeled in at least three passes in each of the team's first five games of the year. Over the last two weeks, Johnson has caught four of seven targets for 16 yards, and his next chance to get back on track will come in Week 7 against the Steelers in Paris.

news.summary: Metcalf caught 11 of 15 targets for 93 yards in Sunday's 26-19 overtime win over the Buccaneers.
news.details: The targets and catches were season highs for Metcalf, while the veteran WR came up just short of his second 100-yard performance in the last three weeks. Metcalf will take a 30-318-1 line on 52 targets into a Week 7 clash with the Saints in Paris.

news.details: Kraft briefly exited the game in the second half but quickly returned after a visit to the medical tent. His eight targets tied Christian Watson for second on the team behind Matthew Golden's 13, and the Green Bay offense has settled on funneling its targets mostly through the two wideouts and tight end. news.summary: Shaheed (hip) was a full participant in Thursday's practice, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.
news.details: Shaheed was limited Wednesday but appears to be on track for his normal role Sunday against the Chiefs. Playing behind Jaxon Smith-Njigba and Cooper Kupp in an offense that likes to use multiple tight ends, Shaheed has yet to get going in the receiving department this season, as he has just 14 catches for 162 yards through six contests.

news.summary: Golden (shoulder) was limited at Thursday's practice, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.
news.details: Both Golden and fellow WR Christian Watson (ankle) have opened Week 7 prep as limited on both of the Packers' first two injury reports. Head coach Matt LaFleur told Demovsky on Thursday that he has no concern about the availability of either player for Sunday's contest at Detroit. Friday's report will reveal if Golden or Watson enter the weekend with a designation.

news.details: Kupp accumulated 15 targets through the first five games of the regular season, but the veteran wide receiver was peppered Thursday by Sam Darnold, who attempted a season-high 51 passes. It was the first time since Week 12 of the 2024 season (with the Rams) that Kupp saw double-digit targets, and he finished second in that category Thursday behind Jaxon Smith-Njigba (16). Barner has played 90 percent or more of the Seahawks' offensive snaps in five of six games this season, but he's also caught more than three passes just once (Week 3 against the Commanders). news.summary: Fant brought in his lone target for seven yards during the Saints' 23-13 loss to the Vikings on Sunday.
news.details: Fant played 30 of 45 offensive snaps Sunday in his return from a one-game absence due to an abdominal injury, which was one more than fellow tight end Juwan Johnson. Fant saw only one target from Tyler Shough, although the Saints' offense struggled as a whole against the Vikings' defense. Fant has a 9-73-3 receiving line on 13 targets through four games heading into Week 7 against the Giants, whose defense has given up 33 catches to tight ends this season, tied for fifth-most in the NFL.

news.summary: Williams brought in two of four targets for 47 yards and two touchdowns in the Lions' 45-21 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
news.details: Williams made good use of both his receptions by recording his first two touchdowns of the campaign, which came from eight and 39 yards out. The speedy 2022 first-round pick had already managed another first in Week 4 against the Panthers when he eclipsed the century mark, and Williams now has reached a second milestone in what has been a reasonably productive start to the season. news.summary: Kamara (back) practiced in a limited capacity Thursday, Katherine Terrell of ESPN.com reports.
news.details: Kamara now has logged back-to-back capped practices to begin Week 7 prep as he deals with a back concern for a third consecutive week. He's been able to play through it, but his snap shares in Week 5 (27 percent) and Week 6 (26 percent) didn't equate to much work (14 touches for 75 yards from scrimmage and one receiving TD). Friday's injury report will unveil whether or not Kamara enters the weekend with a designation for Sunday's contest versus the Steelers in Paris.

news.summary: Dowdle (knee) was listed as a limited participant on Thursday's injury report, Alan Saunders of SteelersNow.com reports.
news.details: Thursday marked another limited session for Dowdle, who has been dealing with a knee issue in the lead-up to the Steelers' upcoming game against the Saints. He will have a chance to ramp up to a full practice on Friday before the Steelers make a final call on his gameday status.

news.summary: TeSlaa failed to haul in either of his two targets during the Lions' 45-21 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
news.details: It was the second time in five games this season that TeSlaa did not record a catch, but he still logged the third-most offensive snaps among Lions wide receivers, though he was well behind Jameson Williams (59) and Amon-Ra St. Brown (57). TeSlaa has a 9-187-0 receiving line on 19 targets this season, though his scoring ceiling will continue to be quite low as long as Jared Goff has Williams, St. Brown, Jahmyr Gibbs and Sam LaPorta at his disposal. The Lions will rest up during their Week 6 bye

news.summary: LaPorta brought in all five of his targets for 88 yards and a touchdown in the Lions' 45-21 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
news.details: The athletic tight end was a constant presence in the air attack during the high-scoring victory, and he finished with a season-high yardage total that also set the pace for the Lions on the afternoon. LaPorta also contributed his third touchdown of the campaign -- and his second in as many games -- with a 38-yard grab in the second quarter. LaPorta has his two highest yardage tallies of the season in the last two games, which affords him plenty of momentum heading into the Week 6 bye that prece

news.summary: Higgins brought in two of four targets for 22 yards in the Bengals' 31-24 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
news.details: Higgins was able to work through groin and neck injuries to suit up Sunday, but the veteran field-stretching receiver wasn't called on to do much on an afternoon when Joe Burrow threw for a season-low 192 yards. Nevertheless, Higgins seemingly made it through the game unscathed -- albeit with season-low totals across the board -- and he'll now have a Week 6 bye to further recover before a Week 7 road matchup against the Ravens on Sunday, Oct. 25.

news.summary: Concepcion (calf/quadriceps) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice.
news.details: Concepcion and Denzel Boston (foot) have now been limited in both of the Browns' first two Week 7 practices, so the two rookie wideouts may need to upgrade to full participation Friday to avoid taking injury designations into Sunday's game against the Titans. After sustaining a concussion in the Browns' Week 5 loss to the Jets, Concepcion was able to clear the five-step protocol prior to last week's game against the Ravens and went on to finish with four catches for 37 yards on six targets while

news.summary: Robinson caught three of seven targets for 22 yards during Sunday's 26-20 win over the Colts.
news.details: Robinson finished tied for the team lead in targets with fellow wideout Carnell Tate, but he finished with 22 or fewer receiving yards for the second time in three weeks and the third time overall this season. The wide receiver, along with the rest of Tennessee's offense, is incredibly inconsistent, but he has seen at least five targets in four straight games.

news.summary: Fannin brought in one of three targets for nine yards in the Browns' 13-10 win over the Ravens on Sunday.
news.details: Fannin was quiet for a second straight game while Jerry Jeudy surprisingly paced the Browns' air attack with a season-high 69 receiving yards. Fannin's production has been hard to trust during the first few weeks of the season, as he's recorded five or more catches just twice and three receptions and 27 receiving yards or less in his other four games. Fannin will look for a boost in his numbers during a Week 7 road matchup against the Titans on Sunday.

news.summary: Tate caught six of seven targets for 70 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-20 win over the Colts.
news.details: The rookie wideout capped a solid performance with an eight-yard TD in the fourth quarter, accounting for the Titans' only points on offense for the afternoon in their first win of 2026 and marking the first touchdown of his career. Tate's numbers were more remarkable considering that Cam Ward threw for a meager 102 yards in the game. Tate has begun to find a groove, posting a 22-279-1 line on 33 targets over his last four games. He'll look to keep rolling in Week 7 against the Browns.

news.summary: Boston (foot) remained limited at Thursday's practice.
news.details: Boston has been bothered by a foot injury since the start of Cleveland's Week 6 preparations against the Ravens. He suited up for that game after three limited practices but was held to one catch, and the rookie second-round pick has opened Week 7 prep with a pair of limited sessions. Boston will look to increase his practice participation Friday and avoid an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Titans.

news.summary: Addison (hamstring) was a full practice participant Wednesday.
news.details: Prior to the Vikings' last game Week 5 at New Orleans, for which Addision was inactive, he managed a pair of limited practices as he tended to a sore hamstring. After a Week 6 bye, his ability to handle every on-field rep has him in the clear for Sunday's game versus the Colts. With Justin Jefferson (ankle) still limited Wednesday, Addison may in line for a bit more reps this weekend if the former is at all inhibited.

news.summary: Corum produced 42 yards on nine carries and reeled in both of his targets for 18 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's 18-16 loss against the Cardinals.
news.details: Corum was only two touches behind the Rams' clear lead RB Kyren Williams, which marked the second-smallest gap between the two in a game this season. Moreover, Corum took advantage of Sunday's slightly expanded workload by reaching the end zone for the second time in as many contests. So far, his 56 touches have equated to 314 yards from scrimmage and two TDs, and he'll aim for another somewhat even split with Williams next Sunday at Las Vegas.

news.summary: Higgins caught all three of his targets for 28 yards during the Cardinals' 18-16 win over the Rams on Sunday.
news.details: Higgins has caught exactly three passes in three of his last four games, and, over that span, he has an 11-124-1 receiving line on 11 targets. Trey McBride is the focal point of the Cardinals' offense, but Higgins has been on the field for at least 40 percent of the team's offensive snaps in three games this season. The Cardinals will stay home for Week 7 against the Broncos, whose defense has given up 329 receiving yards to opposing tight ends this season, which ranks 21st in the NFL.

news.summary: Sutton brought in two of three targets for 19 yards in the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday.
news.details: Sutton tied for third in receptions and targets while holding the same slotting in receiving yards for the Broncos on a night when Bo Nix could only manage 107 passing yards. The veteran wideout also took a hard hit on the one target he couldn't corral, and Sam Jane of The Denver Post reported Sutton was seen bent over and slightly limping on the sideline but never required a trip to the medical tent. Like fellow wideout Jaylen Waddle, the long-time Bronco's production has suffered as a result o

news.summary: Mims caught two of four passes for 13 yards, returned one punt for 11 yards and returned one kickoff for 24 yards during the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday.
news.details: Mims once again did a little bit of everything during Thursday's OT win, and his four targets from Bo Nix ended up being tied with RJ Harvey for second-most on the Broncos behind Jaylen Waddle (seven). Mims' impact will mostly come on special teams, but over his last three games he's turned nine targets into five catches for 29 yards. The Broncos will hit the road for Week 7 against the Cardinals on Sunday, Oct. 25.

news.summary: Pitts brought in five of seven targets for 60 yards and two touchdowns in the Falcons' 31-23 loss to the Bears on Sunday.
news.details: Pitts led the Falcons in receptions and was second and third in targets and receiving yards, respectively. The veteran tight end helped fuel an Atlanta comeback in the fourth quarter with touchdown grabs of 10 and five yards, his second and third scoring catches in the last two games. Pitts has also now posted back-to-back five-catch tallies as a Week 7 home matchup against the 49ers approaches Sunday.

news.summary: Engram caught both targets for 13 yards in Denver's 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday night.
news.details: Engram started and played 31 of 60 offensive snaps, but the Denver passing offense has been stuck in neutral all season to this point. Through six games. Engram has just 12 catches for 134 yards and a touchdown on 19 targets. Bo Nix has to this point mostly refused to throw the ball down the field, and all Denver pass catchers are suffering from it in the box score.

news.summary: Tucker caught five of seven targets for 97 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Bills.
news.details: With Brock Bowers clamped in coverage for much of the afternoon until the second half, Tucker ended up leading the Raiders in receiving, while he also secured both of Kirk Cousins' touchdown passes via 11- and 44-yard scores. It was Tucker's second ceiling game in the first six weeks after he went 5-119-1 on seven targets in Week 2 against the Chargers. Tucker has been held under 50 yards with no touchdowns in Las Vegas' other four contests. He's a boom-or-bust type of fantasy player whose boom

news.summary: Mayer brought in seven of nine targets for 95 yards in the Raiders' 33-30 loss to the Bills on Sunday.
news.details: Mayer set a new single-game career high in receiving yards while outpacing position mate Brock Bowers by 25 yards in the high-scoring loss. Mayer's reception total was a team high for Las Vegas on the afternoon and served as the fourth-year pro's second best of the season. There clearly appears to be consistent room for both athletic tight ends in head coach Klint Kubiak's offense, especially with the Raiders' receiving corps lacking some depth and experience behind Tre Tucker.

news.summary: Brooks caught two of three targets for 30 yards and returned a kickoff for 25 yards during Sunday's 18-16 win over the Rams.
news.details: Both of Brooks' catches came in the fourth quarter, the second of which was for 21 yards late in the period that also drew a penalty flag for unnecessary roughness by defensive back Josh Wallace. That set up the Cardinals at the Rams' 29 yard line and led to the game-winning, 43-yard field goal by Chad Ryland. Brooks has four catches (on 10 targets) for 46 yards over the Cardinals' last two games and has stepped into a more prominent role offensively since Arizona's trade of Marvin Harrison to H

news.summary: Franklin caught one of two targets for 27 yards in Sunday's 20-13 win over the Jaguars.
news.details: With Marvin Mims (foot) inactive, Franklin played 13 of 62 offensive snaps as the clear No. 4 receiver behind Courtland Sutton, Pat Bryant and Jaylen Waddle. Franklin's 27-yard grab was his lone catch of the season through two weeks. He'll need an injury to obtain any fantasy relevance in redraft formats.

news.summary: Bourne caught five of eight targets for 47 yards during the Cardinals' 18-16 win over the Rams on Sunday.
news.details: Bourne led all Cardinals wide receivers in catches, targets and yards during Sunday's win, and he finished second to superstar tight end Trey McBride in each of those three categories. Bourne has a 10-117-0 line on 16 targets over his last two games, which coincides with the absence of Marvin Harrison following the latter's trade to the Texans. The Cardinals will head back home for Week 7 on Oct. 25 against the Broncos, whose defense ranks in the top-10 in fantasy points allowed per game to wide

news.summary: Wilson caught four of seven targets for 32 yards in Sunday's 18-16 win over the Rams.
news.details: Wilson finished third on the team in catches, targets and receiving yards, trailing Trey McBride and Kendrick Bourne in all three categories in Arizona's first game since trading Marvin Harrison to Houston. Bourne seems to be the biggest beneficiary of Harrison's departure, as he tied his season high with eight targets and had five catches for 47 yards Sunday, while Wilson has been limited to seven targets in both of the games Arizona has played without Harrison. Wilson should continue to work a

news.summary: Waddle (chest) remained a limited participant in Thursday's practice.
news.details: With back-to-back limited practices Wednesday and Thursday, Waddle appears to at least have a good chance to play through the issue Sunday against Arizona. Waddle has been one of the more disappointing early-round fantasy picks through six weeks, collecting just 22 catches for 228 yards and one touchdown on 38 targets across six games.

news.summary: Dotson caught three of five targets for 87 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 31-23 loss to Chicago.
news.details: Dotson led the team in receiving yards, and his most notable moment of the game came in the second quarter when he connected with quarterback Michael Penix for a 13-yard touchdown. The wide receiver has now reeled in multiple passes in three straight contests, exceeding 50 receiving yards in each of those games, and he appears to have distanced himself as the team's No. 2 option behind Drake London at his position.

news.summary: Coker brought in six of 13 targets for 97 yards in the Panthers' 25-14 win over the Eagles on Sunday. He also committed a fumble recovered by Carolina.
news.details: Making his return from a one-game absence due to a quadriceps injury, Coker picked up right where he left off while tying for the team lead in receptions and setting the pace in both receiving yards and targets. He also had a game-long 32-yard catch, and he now has at least six grabs in three of his first four games. With a 24-319-2 line through four contests, the speedy third-year wideout is well on his way to setting new career bests as he heads into a Week 7 home matchup against the Buccaneer

news.summary: Kelce (ankle) was listed as a limited participant in Thursday's practice.
news.details: Kelce has operated with a cap on his reps for the Chiefs' first two practices of Week 7, but as long as he's able to maintain limited activity or upgrade to full participation Friday, he should be in good position to play Sunday in Seattle. With top wideout Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) remaining sidelined for Thursday's practice and perhaps trending toward another missed game in Week 7, Kelce could be a candidate to take on more volume than usual in the Kansas City passing attack if he's not too

news.summary: Waller failed to catch either of his two targets in Sunday's 25-14 win over the Eagles.
news.details: Waller dealt with a toe injury during the practice week and ended up playing behind both Tommy Tremble and Mitchell Evans in this one, as Tremble was the big producer in the box score, catching a pair of red-zone touchdowns. Waller is one of the many touchdown-or-bust fantasy options at the tight end position.

news.summary: Tremble caught all four targets for 46 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 25-14 win over the Eagles.
news.details: Tremble played 54 snaps to Mitchell Evans' 43 and Darren Waller's 36, and Tremble ran the most routes of the trio. His touchdowns were both of the red-zone variety, as he scored from 12 and 19 yards out. The tight end entered Sunday with 11 catches for 82 yards on 15 targets, so he's not worth chasing in fantasy ahead of next Sunday's date with the Bucs.

news.summary: Horton caught one of five targets for 13 yards and returned a punt for 13 yards during the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday. He also logged one tackle.
news.details: Horton finished Thursday's game fourth on the Seahawks in targets but managed to catch only one pass from Sam Darnold, the latter of whom attempted a season-high 51 throws. Horton has a 5-67-1 receiving line on nine targets through five regular-season games, and he's firmly entrenched as the Seahawks' WR4 behind Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Cooper Kupp and Rashid Shaheed. The Seahawks will head back home for Week 7 to host the Chiefs on Sunday, Oct. 25.

news.summary: Williams (ankle) was listed as limited at Thursday's practice, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.
news.details: Williams was also listed as limited on Wednesday's estimated injury report. The same applies to Christian Watson (ankle) and Matthew Golden (shoulder), while Bo Melton (back) has drawn consecutive 'DNP' listings. Friday's final injury report thus is slated to add further context with regard to the health of the Packers' WR corps for Sunday's 4:25 p.m. ET kickoff against the Lions.

news.summary: Boutte finished with two receptions for 16 yards on three targets in Sunday's 34-31 win over the Jaguars in London.
news.details: Though the newly acquired Marvin Harrison was limited to just 12 snaps in his Texans debut, his presence may have been enough for Boutte to see a notable role reduction in Week 6. Boutte took the field for 26 of the Texans' 63 snaps, with his 41.3 percent share representing a season-low rate and placing him fourth among Houston receivers. Harrison is likely to see his snaps pick up once he gains a full grasp of his new playbook, and Boutte could end up being a casualty from a playing-time standp

news.summary: Schultz (quadriceps) was a limited participant at Thursday's practice.
news.details: Schultz took a step forward Thursday after sitting out Wednesday's practice. He'll have one more opportunity Friday to log a full practice, which could help him avoid an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Giants. Schultz is still searching for his first touchdown of the season.

news.summary: Harrison caught three of four targets for 34 yards in Sunday's 34-31 win over the Jaguars.
news.details: Making his Texans debut, Harrison wasn't especially productive on his own, but quarterback C.J. Stroud seemed to benefit from his presence and spread the ball around to 10 different pass catchers. The three grabs still tied Harrison's season high, giving him something to build on as he looks to put his disappointing Cardinals tenure behind him. The two former Ohio State teammates will look to re-buiild their chemistry further in Week 7 against the Giants.

news.summary: Noel gathered in all four targets for 107 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's 34-31 win against the Jaguars in London.
news.details: Noel has made much of his mark on special teams through five games this season, including two kick returns for 65 yards and one punt return for two yards in Week 6. However, he reached the end zone for a second consecutive game on a 13-yard connection with QB C.J. Stroud, and Noel's receiving-yardage total easily bested his previous career high of 85 yards, which he managed in Week 4 against the Cowboys. Nico Collins remains the top dog in the Texans' receiving corps, and Marvin Harrison just sh

news.summary: Moreau caught both of his targets for seven yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 34-31 win over the Jaguars in London.
news.details: Moreau made the most of his two opportunities, securing a pair of red-zone scores from one and six yards. Three of Moreau's 11 grabs this season have resulted in red-zone touchdowns. He can mostly be ignored in fantasy football while Dalton Schultz is healthy.

news.summary: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that Dell (knee) is on track to return from injured reserve to make his season debut in Week 7 versus the Giants, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.
news.details: Dell will be making his first appearance since Dec. 21, 2024, when he sustained a severe left knee injury that included a dislocated kneecap and damage to multiple ligaments. Through his first two seasons in the NFL, Dell had emerged as a key complementary option behind No. 1 wideout Nico Collins, but the Texans are likely tempering expectations for the 26-year-old coming off a nearly two-year layoff. Dell, who was cleared to resume practicing Oct. 7 and was a full participant throughout Week 6

news.summary: Hutchinson caught two of three passes for 10 yards and returned two kickoffs for 52 yards during the Texans' 34-31 win over the Jaguars on Sunday in London.
news.details: Though he finished with season-low marks in catches, receiving yards and targets, Hutchinson was on the field for 34 offensive snaps, surpassing his playing time from each of the previous three contests. He also saw some usage as a kickoff returner for the first time since Week 18 of the 2024 season. Working as a return man could prove to be Hutchinson's primary role moving forward, after Houston acquired Marvin Harrison from Arizona and anticipates Tank Dell (knee) returning from injured reserv

news.summary: Hockenson (concussion) was listed as a full participant Thursday.
news.details: Hockenson is inching closer to clearing the protocol for head injuries after sustaining a concussion during the Vikings' Week 5 win at New Orleans. At the very least, he must gain clearance from an independent neurologist in order to suit up again Sunday against the Colts.

news.summary: Wilson brought in four of six targets for 44 yards in the Jets' 26-19 loss to the Patriots on Sunday.
news.details: Wilson had an early catch and then had a quiet middle portion of the game before rounding out his line some in the fourth quarter. Wilson still finished with modest production overall, as his reception and receiving yards totals were both his second lowest of the campaign. Geno Smith has undergone his fair share of struggles in his return to New York this season, but Wilson remains his top target with 48 looks from the veteran signal-caller over the first six games. Wilson will take a 35-418-3 l

news.summary: Sadiq caught one of three targets for 12 yards in Sunday's 26-19 loss to the Patriots.
news.details: Sadiq was able to clear concussion protocol during the week, but the rookie tight end has been playing through minor injuries all season. Since catching seven passes for 105 yards in Week 3 against the Lions, Sadiq has just three catches for 15 yards on 10 targets over the last three contests. He's become waiver-wire fodder in redraft leagues.

news.summary: Likely caught six of 11 targets for 99 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 34-27 loss to the Saints.
news.details: The tight end came through with another big performance and connected with J.J. McCarthy on a 24-yard TD in the fourth quarter after the young QB had replaced Jameis Winston under center. It's reassuring that Likely remained involved even after the switch at quarterback, and he's seen double-digit targets in three straight games, delivering a 24-259-3 line on 36 targets as the team's No. 2 pass catcher behind Malik Nabers. Likely will look to keep rolling in Week 7 against the Texans, regardless

news.summary: Lance caught two of four passes for nine yards and a touchdown during the Saints' 34-27 win over the Giants on Sunday.
news.details: Lance's four targets were tied with Alvin Kamara for third most on the Saints behind Chris Olave (seven) and Devaughn Vele (six), with quarterback Tyler Shough completing only 16 of 30 passes. Both of Lance's catches came in the second quarter, the second of which was a two-yard touchdown that tied the game up at 10-10 with five seconds left in the first half. Lance's 36 offensive snaps were third most among New Orleans wide receivers, but his time as the team's WR3 could come to an end as soon

news.summary: Gray caught all three of his targets for 53 yards during the Chiefs' 22-6 win over the Chargers on Sunday.
news.details: Gray's third and final catch of Sunday's game was for 31 yards early in the third quarter. It was the fourth time in his six-year NFL career that he surpassed 50 receiving yards in a game, with the other three instances taking place in 2024. Gray's 39 offensive snaps were one shy of Travis Kelce, though the latter was nursing a right ankle injury during Sunday's game, and that health concern will be worth monitoring ahead of the Chiefs' Week 7 road tilt against the Seahawks on Oct. 25.

news.summary: Gesicki brought in one of two targets for a four-yard touchdown in the Bengals' 31-24 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
news.details: Gesicki looked like he might be on his way to a big day against one of his former squads when he capped off the Bengals' lightning-fast opening possession with his scoring grab. However, the veteran tight end was a non-factor the rest of the way, posting his second-lowest totals over the first five games across all three categories of his receiving line. Gesicki's week-to-week production can certainly be difficult to trust, but he remains a trusted target of a prolific quarterback in what is sti

news.summary: Washington secured six of eight targets for 43 yards, rushed once for 18 yards, returned two kickoffs for 45 yards and ran back one punt for 28 yards in the Dolphins' 31-24 loss to the Bengals on Sunday.
news.details: Washington led the Dolphins across the board in receptions, receiving yards and targets during Caleb Douglas' third straight absence because of an ankle injury, although the middle total was relatively modest on an afternoon in which Malik Willis threw for just 137 yards. Washington's catch total was also a new season high, and he's now upped his reception tally over that of the previous week in four consecutive contests. Washington will remain a relevant asset in deeper PPR formats and as a DFS

news.summary: Ayomanor caught one of two passes for 17 yards during the Titans' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Sunday. He also added a tackle on special teams.
news.details: It was the fourth time in five games this season that Ayomanor caught one pass, with his lone connection with Cam Ward on Sunday coming late in the fourth quarter. Ayomanor was on the field for 33 of the Titans' 63 offensive snaps (52.4 percent), which was fourth-most among Tennessee wide receivers behind Carnell Tate (48), Wan'Dale Robinson (47) and Calvin Ridley (35). The Titans' 11.6 points per game is lowest in the NFL, so it's hard to put much stock into Ayomanor or any of the team's skill-

news.summary: Gordon rushed 18 times for 88 yards and a touchdown in the Dolphins' 31-24 loss to the Bengals on Sunday.
news.details: Gordon turned in a useful fantasy performance in the lead role once again, even as he navigated a brief exit from the game due to an undisclosed injury in the second half. The second-year back was able to still handle a robust workload despite the Dolphins trailing for the majority of the game, and he finished with a new career high in rush attempts. Gordon also recorded a rushing touchdown for the third straight game when he went in from one yard with just over eight minutes remaining in the fi

news.summary: Washington caught four of six targets for 25 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-19 overtime win over the Bucs.
news.details: The Steelers entered the fourth quarter trailing 16-3, but Washington sparked the comeback with a five-yard touchdown to make it 16-10. It was the big tight end's second touchdown of the season, and he's now recorded 15 grabs for 156 yards and the two scores on 22 targets through six games. He's on pace for a career year in the receiving department and is a preferred target of Aaron Rodgers near the goal line due to his sheer size advantage.

news.summary: Singletary turned four carries into 14 yards and hauled in his lone target for 19 yards during Sunday's 34-27 loss to the Saints on Sunday.
news.details: Singletary was back in action Sunday after being a healthy scratch in each of the Giants' three games prior to Week 6. Three of his four carries went for two yards or fewer, although he did log a nine-yard rush and 19-yard catch on back-to-back plays early in the fourth quarter. Singletary's 31 offensive snaps were most among Giants running backs, but the team's backfield situation is a mess, given Cam Skattebo saw the field for only six offensive snaps and did not record a carry. The Giants wil

news.summary: Jeudy caught all four targets for 69 yards in Sunday's 13-10 win over the Ravens.
news.details: Jeudy's four targets were third on the team, but he made the most of them and ended up leading the Browns in receiving on a day Deshaun Watson threw for just 164 yards and no touchdowns. The veteran wideout entered Week 6 with just eight catches for 81 yards and can largely be ignored in fantasy as Cleveland's fourth or fifth option on offense most weeks.

news.summary: Strong rushed 11 times for 28 yards in Sunday night's 23-13 win over the Cowboys. He caught five of six targets for 39 yards.
news.details: Strong led the backfield in carries and out-targeted MarShawn Lloyd six to one. The Packers still couldn't run the ball effectively, but Josh Jacobs is due back from the Commissioner's Exempt list in time for next Sunday's game against the Lions, making all three of Strong, Lloyd and Kaleb Johnson waiver-wire material in fantasy moving forward. Strong has turned 16 carries into just 35 yards through two games, but he's secured eight of 10 targets for 50 yards.

news.summary: Meyers brought in both of his targets for 12 yards during the Bengals' 31-24 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
news.details: Meyers entered Sunday on the heels of a huge performance on both offense and special teams during the Bengals' Week 4 loss to the Jaguars, when top pass catchers Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins sustained injuries. Chase and Higgins were both cleared to play against Miami and didn't face any restrictions in their respective snap counts, so Meyers reverted to a rotational role and was on the field for only 19 of Cincinnati's 65 offensive snaps (29.2 percent). The Bengals will enjoy their Week 6 bye

news.summary: Freiermuth caught two of three targets for 11 yards in Sunday's 26-19 overtime win over the Bucs.
news.details: Freiermuth entered Week 6 questionable due to a calf injury, but he ended up running 41 routes on Aaron Rodgers' 56 dropbacks. The tight end just didn't do much in the box score and was targeted on just 6.1 percent of Rodgers' 49 pass attempts. Freiermuth has already scored four touchdowns this season but has just 180 receiving yards on 21 grabs across 29 targets through six games. He's a touchdown-or-bust fantasy option.

news.summary: Douglas (ankle) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice, Marcel Louis-Jacques of ESPN.com reports.
news.details: Back practicing with Miami this week for the first time since exiting a Sept. 20 loss to the 49ers due to an ankle injury, Douglas had his reps capped for the second day in a row. The wideout noted Wednesday that he's viewing himself as day-to-day at this stage of his recovery, and he'll likely need to upgrade to full participation at Friday's practice to head into Sunday's game against the Jets without a designation. If available to play this weekend, Douglas will likely slide back into a top-t

news.summary: Taylor caught four of six targets for 33 yards during Sunday's 26-19 loss to the Patriots.
news.details: Taylor put together his best performance of the year, setting new season highs in catches, yards and targets. The tight end now has caught nine of 12 targets for 55 yards over four games this season. With rookie Kenyon Sadiq also heavily involved at tight end, Taylor's upside will continue to be hard to gauge moving forward.

news.summary: Helm was on the field for 33 of 46 offensive snaps (71.7 percent) but didn't show up on the box score otherwise during the Titans' 26-20 win over the Colts on Sunday.
news.details: Helm has seen his role on offense steadily decline since his four-catch performance in Week 1 against the Jets. He's been held without a catch in each of the last two games and has seen only two targets from Cam Ward over the Titans' last three games. Tennessee's offense is one of the worst units in the league this season, and it's hard to put much stock into any of the position players outside of rookie wide receiver Carnell Tate and, to a lesser extent, veteran running back Tony Pollard. The T

news.summary: Perine rushed 14 times for 68 yards while catching both of his targets for 10 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 31-24 win over Miami.
news.details: Perine surprisingly logged one more carry than starting running back Chase Brown (13) in the contest. Additionally, although he saw two fewer targets than Brown, Perine was able to reach paydirt in the second quarter, reeling in a six-yard touchdown pass from Joe Burrow. Perine remains a highly valuable insurance policy for fantasy managers with Brown on their roster. Through five games, the 31-year-old has rushed 27 times for 110 yards while reeling in seven of 10 targets for 61 yards and a sco

news.summary: Fields caught two of eight targets for 19 yards during the Giants' 34-27 loss to the Saints on Sunday.
news.details: Fields' eight targets were a career high for the rookie third-rounder and third most among Giants pass catchers behind Malik Nabers (15) and Isaiah Likely (11). However, Fields had only two receptions to show for it, and he's logged two catches in each of the first six games of his NFL career. The Giants will hit the road for Week 7 against the Texans, and Fields could be working with J.J. McCarthy rather than Jameis Winston for that contest.

news.summary: Tracy rushed six times for 18 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 34-27 loss to the Saints. He added two catches for 27 yards and an additional touchdown on three targets.
news.details: With Cam Skattebo seemingly benched after losing a fumble in overtime against the Commanders last Sunday, Tracy played a season-high 29 offensive snaps and led the team with six rushing attempts. Only Devin Singletary (31 snaps) played more on offense, as Najee Harris (11 snaps) got the nominal start. Skattebo was in for just six offensive plays. It's unclear if the Giants will continue to punish Skattebo next Sunday against the Texans, but this looks like a backfield to avoid in fantasy.

news.summary: Bell (knee) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Bengals, Paul Dehner Jr. of The Athletic reports.
news.details: Bell has played through a knee issue over the Dolphins' last couple of games, and the rookie third-rounder will do so again Sunday after logging a full practice Friday. He was unable to haul in any of his three targets during Miami's Week 4 loss to Minnesota, but he could see more looks from QB Malik Willis this weekend due to the continued absence of fellow rookie Caleb Douglas (ankle).

news.summary: Dulcich caught four of five targets for 37 yards during Sunday's 31-24 loss to the Bengals.
news.details: Dulcich finished second on the team in catches, and his five targets were third most for Miami. The tight end rebounded nicely after failing to garner a target over 20 offensive snaps in Week 4 against Minnesota's tough defense, and he now has caught 13 of 17 targets for 127 yards over five contests this season.

news.summary: Rodgers completed 33 of 49 passes for 253 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 26-19 overtime win over the Buccaneers.
news.details: Down 16-3 to begin the fourth quarter, Rodgers began the comeback with a five-yard TD pass to Darnell Washington before leading the Steelers on three straight field-goal drives. The veteran QB then put together a 12-play, 70-yard drive to begin OT that was capped with a six-yard score to Germie Bernard. Rodgers has tossed multiple touchdowns in four straight games, posting an 11:4 TD:INT over that stretch and giving him plenty of momentum heading into a Week 7 trip to Paris to face the Saints.

news.summary: Shough completed 16 of 30 passes for 144 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 34-27 win over the Giants. He added 32 yards and a TD on five carries.
news.details: While he didn't produce much yardage, Shough kept the Saints' offense humming, connecting with Bryce Lance, Alvin Kamara and Chris Olave for scores through the air while adding a one-yard touchdown on the ground in the third quarter. Shough has been playing through a couple broken bones in his non-throwing hand, which could help explain why he has just 242 passing yards over the last two weeks, but the second-year QB showed he can be plenty productive despite the injury. Shough will take a 12:5

news.summary: Donaldson (shoulder) practiced without limitations Thursday.
news.details: Donaldson upgraded to full participation Thursday while Alvin Kamara (back) was limited for a second consecutive practice. Heading into Sunday's overseas showdown against the Steelers, Donaldson has been working as the Saints' third option in the backfield behind Kamara and Kendre Miller while Travis Etienne (hamstring) is on IR. Donaldson has accumulated 82 scrimmage yards on 16 touches over the past three games.

news.summary: Pollard carried the ball 19 times for 76 yards and failed to catch his only target in Sunday's 26-20 win over the Colts.
news.details: Tyjae Spears had only two touches as Pollard dominated work in the Titans backfield, and the veteran RB led the team in scrimmage yards on the afternoon. Pollard's 76 rushing yards were a season high, but he's gotten into the end zone just once in six games. He'll offer a solid floor, but little ceiling, in a Week 7 matchup against the Browns.

news.summary: Andrews caught one of three targets for four yards during the Ravens' 13-10 loss to the Browns on Sunday.
news.details: Andrews saw only three pass attempts from Tyler Huntley on Sunday, and it was the first time that the veteran tight end saw less than five targets in a game this season. Andrews' 41 offensive snaps were most among Ravens tight ends, but his receiving line was below rookie fifth-rounder Josh Cuevas (4-44-1 on five targets). Baltimore will head back home for Week 7 against the Bengals on Oct. 25, and Andrews' scoring floor will be boosted if Lamar Jackson (ankle) is cleared to return from a two-ga

news.summary: Jones rushed 25 times for 113 yards and a touchdown and brought in all three targets for four yards in the Vikings' 23-13 win over the Saints on Sunday.
news.details: Jones continued handling the workhorse role in Minnesota's backfield, and he finished Sunday's contest with a new season high in carries despite exiting the game for a spell due to a leg issue. Jones added his second rushing touchdown of the season on an eight-yard run early in the fourth quarter, while the 100-yard effort was his second of the campaign. Sunday marked Jones' backfield mate Jordan Mason's fourth absence while on injured reserve due to a thumb injury, and it remains to be seen if

news.summary: Delp was not targeted during Monday's 45-24 loss versus the Falcons.
news.details: Delp did record a solo tackle in punt coverage after New Orleans went three-and-out on its first offensive series, but that was his only mark on the stat sheet in Week 4. On a positive note, he was second on the team in snaps at tight end (23) behind veteran Juwan Johnson (53) with Noah Fant (abdomen) sidelined. His involvement in Week 5 versus the Ravens will likely depend on the availability of Fant.

news.summary: Miller carried the ball 20 times for 70 yards and caught both his targets for zero yards in Sunday's 34-27 win over the Giants.
news.details: Alvin Kamara missed time in the first half due to an undisclosed injury, and while he was able to return and make an impact as a pass catcher, Miller led the Saints in rushing yards and touches with 22. The 70 yards also represented his best total since Week 18 of his rookie season in 2023. With Travis Etienne (hamstring) not eligible to return until after a Week 8 bye, Miller should split reps in the backfield with Kamara once again in Week 7 against the Steelers in Paris.

news.summary: Flowers brought in six of 11 targets for 66 yards and rushed once for one yard in the Ravens' 13-10 loss to the Browns on Sunday.
news.details: Flowers set the pace for the Ravens in receptions, receiving yards and targets on the afternoon, displaying solid chemistry with Tyler Huntley once again. The speedy wideout has no fewer than five catches and 53 receiving yards in any game this season, and he's recorded a 14-118-0 line over the last two games alone with Huntley under center. Flowers will remain a must-play wideout regardless of who's helming the Ravens offense in a Week 7 home matchup against the division-rival Bengals next Sund

news.summary: Otton caught one of two targets for four yards in Sunday's 26-19 overtime loss to the Steelers.
news.details: Otton was targeted on just two of Jalon Daniels' 43 pass attempts, good for a lousy 4.7 percent share. The tight end has yet to catch a touchdown this season and has been held below 40 yards in five of six contests. He's a low-floor fantasy option at the position who is best left on waivers.

news.summary: Marks carried the ball 15 times for 56 yards and caught two of three targets for 25 yards in Sunday's 34-31 win over the Jaguars.
news.details: With David Montgomery (groin) inactive, Marks led the Texans backfield in touches and scrimmage yards, but practice-squad elevation Jawhar Jordan arguably made a bigger splash with 43 rushing yards and a touchdown on just six carries. Jordan showed some upside late last season when pressed into duty as well, so even if Montgomery's absence continues, Marks could see his workload shrink. Marks will take on the Giants in Week 7.

news.summary: Nacua suffered a calf injury during Thursday's practice and went down as a limited participant, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.
news.details: Nacua already has dealt with psoas soreness (in August) and discomfort in his groin (in September), the latter of which cost him Weeks 2 and 3. With a new health concern in tow, it remains to be seen if he's in any danger of missing Sunday's contest at Las Vegas. Head coach Sean McVay likely will touch on Nacua's new health concern Friday, at which point the wide receiver may be tagged with a Week 7 game designation.

news.summary: Conklin (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Jets.
news.details: Conklin has been used sparingly through the first two games of the regular season, and the veteran tight end will be a healthy scratch Sunday against the team he played for from 2022 to 2024. Brock Wright and Jackson Meeks will provide depth at the position behind Sam LaPorta, and Conklin's next opportunity to play is Week 4 against the Panthers on Sunday, Oct. 4.

news.summary: Vaki recorded one carry for seven yards and caught his only target for 13 yards during Thursday's 41-31 loss at Buffalo.
news.details: Vaki was on the field for 11 of the Lions' 65 offensive snaps in Week 2, a similar workload to what he saw in Week 1. Barring an injury to starter Jahmyr Gibbs, Vaki seems unlikely to get the ball more than a couple times in any given game.

news.summary: Briningstool caught his only target for nine yards and made two tackles in Monday night's 31-10 win over the Broncos.
news.details: Briningstool played 13 of 69 offensive snaps primarily as a blocker for Kenneth Walker. The tight end's bigger role came on special teams, where he played 20 snaps and made a tackle in kick coverage and punt coverage. Briningstool's success comes after No. 4 tight end Jared Wiley was inactive as a healthy scratch, further showing Briningstool's place on the tight end totem pole.

news.summary: Darnold completed 27 of 51 passes for 278 yards with no touchdowns and two interceptions and rushed twice for 19 yards in the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday. He also threw a two-point conversion pass.
news.details: Darnold's final passing yardage total appears perfectly acceptable from a fantasy standpoint, but the veteran quarterback couldn't produce anywhere near enough scoring and also committed a pair of critical turnovers. While Darnold's first interception didn't lead to any points, it came at the Broncos' 31-yard line with 1:31 remaining and could have cost Seattle the game had the Seahawks not gotten another opportunity with the ball by subsequently forcing a three-and-out. Darnold's second pick di

news.summary: Allen caught both of his passes for 27 yards during the Chiefs' 22-6 win over the Chargers on Sunday.
news.details: Despite the absence of Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee), Allen was on the field for only nine of the Chiefs' 61 offensive snaps (14.8 percent). He drew a 20-yard pass interference penalty late in the first quarter before hauling in a four-yard pass from Patrick Mahomes on the first play of the second quarter, which was the first reception of Allen's career. The rookie wide receiver added a 23-yard catch midway through the fourth quarter, and he ended up finishing second among Chiefs wideouts in rece

news.summary: Homer posted two carries for minus-1 yard during Thursday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
news.details: With Rico Dowdle (toe) out for a second consecutive contest, Homer had an opportunity for more involvement. However, the 2019 No. 204 overall pick didn't do much of relevance, logging just two of the Steelers' 72 offensive snaps to finish well behind Jaylen Warren (70). Even if Dowdle misses more time moving forward, it's hard to imagine Homer doing anything to benefit fantasy managers if Warren is active.

news.summary: Rice (hamstring/knee) did not practice Thursday.
news.details: Rice has yet to resume practicing since sustaining a hamstring injury during Kansas City's Week 4 win over the Raiders. He's also dealing with a knee injury, so Rice looks likely to remain sidelined Sunday night against the Seahawks. Rice would likely need to practice in some capacity Friday to avoid being ruled out.

news.summary: Smith caught his only target for 19 yards during Green bay win Sunday versus the Falcons.
news.details: Smith has now managed to catch a pass in three of his four appearances during the current campaign while serving as the No. 2 tight end behind Tucker Kraft. Smith has hauled in five of his seven targets for 85 yards so far this season.

news.summary: Remigio returned two punts for seven yards and three kicks for 78 yards during Monday's 31-10 win versus the Broncos.
news.details: Remigio did not log any snaps on offense in Week 1, but he held his own in the return game. He figures to play a similar role come Sunday night, when Kansas City is set to host the Colts.

news.summary: Brown (thigh) is active for Sunday's game against the Vikings.
news.details: Brown was a full participant in Friday's practice, signaling that the returner and No. 4 wide receiver has recovered from the thigh injury he suffered in the Saints' Week 4 loss to the Falcons. Brown is all set to suit up for the Saints and will likely handle most of the return duties in Sunday's contest.

news.summary: Meeks (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against Arizona.
news.details: Meeks appeared in the Lions' first four games of the 2026 campaign but will be a healthy scratch in Week 5. The 23-year-old hasn't had a productive season, catching his only target for eight yards.

news.summary: Lloyd rushed eight times for 10 yards while failing to catch his only target during Sunday night's 23-13 win over Dallas.
news.details: Lloyd was rather inefficient in Week 6, averaging 1.3 yards per carry while logging three fewer carries than fellow running back Pierre Strong (11). Lloyd was briefly sidelined by an undisclosed injury during the contest, but his ability to finish the game would suggest that whatever he was dealing with is minor. With Josh Jacobs expected to be removed from the Commissioner's Exempt List on Monday, Lloyd will likely transition into a complementary role behind Jacobs in the backfield moving forwa

news.summary: Wiley (coach's decision) is inactive against the Raiders on Sunday.
news.details: Wiley will once again be a healthy scratch, and his next chance to make his 2026 regular-season debut is Week 6 against the Chargers on Oct. 18. The Chiefs will go with Travis Kelce, Noah Gray and Jake Briningstool as the active tight ends for Sunday's AFC West showdown.

news.summary: Melton (back) did not participate in practice Thursday, Weston Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.
news.details: Melton did not practice on Wednesday or Thursday due to a back injury that likely occurred in the Packers' win over the Cowboys in Week 6. The 27-year-old will likely need to practice in some capacity to have a chance at playing Sunday against the Lions.

news.summary: Smith had zero carries during Monday's 31-10 win versus the Broncos.
news.details: Kenneth Walker saw a heavy workload in the win, while rookie Emmett Johnson recorded eight carries as his backup. Smith was a non-factor on offense, logging just three snaps on special teams. The backfield arrangement isn't expected to change while Walker and Johnson are healthy.

news.summary: Worthy totaled seven catches on as many targets for 73 yards during Sunday's 22-6 victory versus the Chargers.
news.details: Worthy served as the Chiefs' No. 1 WR in Week 6 with Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) on the pine, and the former paced the team in all receiving categories on an afternoon in which QB Patrick Mahomes didn't record a touchdown pass. There are bound to be weeks like Sunday in which a ground game led by RB Kenneth Walker keeps Kansas City's offense humming along, but if Rice continues to miss time, Worthy figures to be among the team's leading pass catchers on a weekly basis.

news.summary: Royals caught two of his four targets for 24 yards during Kansas City's win over the Chargers on Sunday.
news.details: Royals saw increased playing time with Rashee Rice out due to a hamstring injury and ended up amassing a season-high 24 receiving yards. The 2025 fourth-round pick has now caught five passes for 41 yards and a touchdown across five games this season and could once again serve as the team's No. 2 receiver should Rice remain sidelined for the Week 7 matchup against the Seahawks.

news.summary: Johnson turned three carries into six yards and caught two of three targets for 18 yards during Sunday's 22-6 win over the Chargers. He also returned two kickoffs for 50 yards.
news.details: Johnson maintained his rotational role in the Chiefs offense, with his 18 offensive snaps well behind Kenneth Walker's 45. Given Walker's tremendous start to the season, Johnson is one of the premier handcuff running backs in fantasy, and his scoring floor would rise significantly if the former ever misses time. The Chiefs will take their 5-0 record on the road for Week 7 against the Seahawks on Oct. 25.

news.summary: Whyle (neck) was not listed on the injury report Wednesday.
news.details: Whyle injured his neck in Sunday's 39-22 loss to Minnesota, but it appears it wasn't anything too serious. The 27-year-old is currently on track to play in Week 2 against the Jets, though he isn't expected to be much of a contributor behind Tucker Kraft and Jonnu Smith.

news.summary: Branch caught both of his targets for nine yards while adding 85 yards as a kick returner during Sunday's 31-23 loss to Chicago.
news.details: Branch has now caught exactly two passes in three straight games, but he has only compiled 34 total yards on those receptions. The wide receiver is merely a depth option behind the likes of Drake London, Jahan Dotson and Olamide Zaccheaus, and he's much more valuable as a return specialist for Atlanta. On the season, Branch has reeled in nine of 10 targets for 55 yards over six contests so far.

news.summary: Penix completed 19 of 33 passes for 225 yards and three touchdowns with no interceptions while rushing once for one yard in the Falcons' 31-23 loss to the Bears on Sunday. He also threw two two-point conversion passes.
news.details: Penix and the Falcons faced a 28-7 deficit going into the fourth quarter, but he helped bring Atlanta back with 10- and five-yard scoring tosses to Kyle Pitts and subsequent two-point conversion passes to Zachariah Branch and Drake London, respectively. Penix also connected with Jahan Dotson for a 13-yard scoring strike in the later portion of the second quarter, and Sunday's game served as Penix's first multi-TD-pass effort of the season. The third-year signal-caller also visited the medical te

news.summary: Young (knee) was not listed on the Bengals' injury report Wednesday.
news.details: Young missed each of the Bengals' two games prior to the Week 6 bye due to a knee injury. The extra rest has paid dividends for the rookie fourth-rounder, who is on track to be available for Sunday's AFC North showdown against the Ravens. He's operated in a minimal role offensively this season, having logged only two catches on as many targets for nine yards across three games.

news.summary: Turner reverted to San Francisco's practice squad Tuesday, per the NFL's transaction report.
news.details: Turner played just three snaps on offense during Monday's victory over the Commanders despite Mike Evans exiting the game early due to an Achilles injury. Turner also played 13 snaps on special teams s but failed to produce any output in the box score.

news.summary: Cowing accrued zero targets during Monday's 23-17 win against Washington.
news.details: Despite the absence of Deebo Samuel (hamstring) and the premature exit of Mike Evans (Achilles), Cowing went without a catch for the fifth time this season. With neither Samuel nor Evans a lock to suit up in Week 7 versus the Falcons, Cowing might see more snaps alongside Brandin Cooks and Jordan Watkins. However, that may not be the case if Demarcus Robinson (ankle) can manage to get on the field after spending time on injured reserve since the Week 2 win over Miami.

news.summary: Farrell secured both of his targets for 19 yards in the 49ers' 27-7 win over the Rams in Week 1.
news.details: With George Kittle still working his way into game shape off last season's torn Achilles and Jake Tonges going down with a knee injury in the second quarter, Farrell ended up playing 46 of 65 offensive snaps and ran 19 pass routes to Kittle's 17. With Tonges looking at an extended absence, Farrell is going to see more action as the TE2.

news.summary: Juszczyk (knee) was a full participant in Friday's practice, Harrison Rich of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
news.details: Juszczyk was cleared to practice without restriction Friday after being limited in Thursday's session. The full practice designation indicates that the veteran fullback has fully recovered from a knee injury and will play against the Commanders on Monday.

news.summary: Zaccheaus (shoulder) was a limited practice participant Thursday, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.
news.details: It's the second straight limited practice to begin the week for Zaccheaus, who is dealing with a shoulder injury. He may need to upgrade to full participation Friday to avoid being tagged with a designation heading into the weekend. Zaccheaus had four catches on six targets through three weeks but hasn't caught any of his five targets over Atlanta's past three contests.

news.summary: Purdy completed 21 of 29 passes for 264 yards with one touchdown and no interceptions while adding five rushes for 28 yards in the 49ers' 23-17 win over the Commanders on Monday night.
news.details: Purdy took multiple sacks for the second straight game after not being taken down over the first four contests, but the veteran signal-caller otherwise had a mostly clean night that included a robust average of 9.1 yards per attempt. Purdy's passing yardage total also was his third highest of the campaign, and he kept his season-long touchdown-pass streak alive when he connected with George Kittle on an 11-yard scoring strike to cap off the opening drive of the night. Purdy completed passes to s

news.summary: Hibner (hand) was a full participant at practice Thursday.
news.details: Hibner managed a full practice Thursday for the first time since he hurt his hand back in Week 5 at Atlanta, suggesting he'll more than likely be available in Week 7 versus the Bengals. Before getting hurt, he was operating as Baltimore's secondary tight end, filling a complementary role relative to veteran starter Mark Andrews.

news.summary: All notched two receptions (on three targets) for five yards during Sunday's 20-6 win versus the Texans.
news.details: All logged 25 offensive snaps in Week 2, finishing behind Drew Sample (36) and Mike Gesicki (21). After not garnering any attention from Joe Burrow in the 33-27 win over the Buccaneers in Week 1, the 26-year-old was targeted three times versus the Texans. All finished his rookie 2024 campaign with 20 receptions for 158 yards, but he didn't play in 2025 due to a knee injury. While All should have a weekly presence in the offense as long as he's healthy, he won't carry much fantasy value as long a

news.summary: Hill caught all three of his targets for nine yards during the Ravens' 13-10 loss to the Browns on Sunday.
news.details: Hill was on the field for 24 of the Ravens' 57 offensive snaps (42.1 percent), which wasn't far behind lead back Derrick Henry (33). That was more due to game script, as the Ravens' offense struggled to move the ball down the field against a tough Browns defense. The offensive outlook for Hill and the rest of Baltimore's skill position players would improve dramatically if Lamar Jackson (ankle) is cleared to play in Week 7 against the Bengals on Oct. 25.

news.summary: Cooks brought in one of two targets for 13 yards in the 49ers' 23-17 win over the Commanders on Monday night.
news.details: Cooks unsurprisingly played a minor role in the air attack as one of four players with one catch on the night. The veteran wideout has two receptions for 20 yards and a touchdown on five targets over the three games for which he's been active to date, and with Demarcus Robinson (ankle) not likely to return from injured reserve until Week 8, Cooks is likely to suit up again in a Week 7 road matchup against the Falcons on Sunday.

news.summary: Walker caught one of his two targets for 19 yards during Baltimore's win over the Titans on Sunday.
news.details: Walker managed to record his second reception of the season, as he continues to make a limited impact offensively even with Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) on injured reserve. Walker will look to be more productive during the Week 5 matchup versus the Falcons.

news.summary: James (coach's decision) is inactive against Denver on Sunday.
