news.summary: Schoonmaker finished with one catch for 12 yards in Sunday's 28-20 loss to the Giants.
news.details: The tight end played on 13 of 58 offensive snaps and 10 more on special teams. Schoonmaker, now in his fourth NFL season, has 50 career catches in the regular season.

news.summary: Lemon caught three of six targets for 19 yards in Sunday's 25-14 loss to the Panthers.
news.details: The rookie wideout briefly exited Week 6 with an undisclosed injury but quickly returned and ended up running a team-high 45 routes on Tanner McKee's 49 dropbcks. It still didn't result in much production, as Lemon's six targets were a distant third on the team. The first-round wide receiver has just 18 catches for 127 yards and no touchdowns on 28 targets through six games. He can't be trusted as a fantasy starter headed into next Monday night's game against the Cowboys.

news.summary: Mundt caught two of three targets for eight yards in Sunday's 24-20 win against the Titans.
news.details: Mundt started along with fellow tight end Dallas Goedert (knee), and he logged 49 of Philadelphia's 76 offensive snaps. The significant playing time was partly due to Goedert exiting in the first half after spraining his MCL. Goedert is now slated to miss multiple weeks due to the injury, but that won't necessarily mean that Mundt will be an attractive fantasy waiver-wire pickup. The Eagles signed veteran Zach Ertz to a contract Tuesday, and he'll likely slide in as the team's top tight end duri

news.summary: Spann-Ford caught both of his targets for 14 yards and made one tackle on kick coverage in Sunday's 28-20 loss to the Giants.
news.details: Spann-Ford is the No. 2 tight end behind Jake Ferguson, but the secondary option outperformed Ferguson by eight receiving yards in Sunday's contest. Spann-Ford played 13 offensive snaps and 11 special-teams snaps, contributing to the Cowboys in both phases to the start the season.

news.summary: Pierce rushed 12 times for 35 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of five targets for 15 yards in the Eagles' 25-14 loss to the Panthers on Sunday.
news.details: Pierce handled all the running back carries for the Eagles with all of Saquon Barkley (hamstring), Tank Bigsby (IR, abdomen) and Will Shipley (IR, foot) unavailable. As his rushing line suggests, Pierce found running room mostly at a premium, but he managed his first touchdown on the ground since the 2024 season on a two-yard run late in the first half. Pierce also was surprisingly involved as a receiver with Tanner McKee quarterbacking the offense, and the veteran back will remain in a similar

news.summary: Goodson is active for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
news.details: Todd Archer of ESPN.com initially reported that Goodson would be a healthy scratch. Instead, it will be Emari Demercado (coach's decision) that will be inactive, with Goodson and Javonte Williams the active running backs for the Cowboys in Brazil.

news.summary: Prescott completed 34 of 54 passes for 258 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions in Sunday's 23-13 loss to the Packers. He also rushed twice for seven yards.
news.details: Prescott threw for just 86 yards with two interceptions in the first half, and the Cowboys took a 17-0 deficit into the locker room. He was only moderately more effective in the second half as Dallas looked out of sorts offensively for a second consecutive game in primetime. Prescott's lone touchdown pass was a six-yarder to Ryan Flournoy in the final minute of the fourth quarter. Dallas dropped to 2-4 with Sunday night's loss, and Dak has an ugly 4:4 TD:INT over his last four starts after posti

news.summary: McKee completed 26 of 45 passes for 215 yards with a touchdown and no interceptions while adding one carry for no gain in the Eagles' 25-14 loss to the Panthers on Sunday. He also recovered a fumble.
news.details: McKee's completion total was impressive, but he averaged a modest 4.8 yards per attempt on the afternoon despite having DeVonta Smith back from a two-game absence due to a hamstring injury. McKee's longest completion of the day went for 19 yards to Smith on a fourth-quarter scoring strike, which brought Philadelphia to within five at the time. McKee ultimately wasn't able to complete the comeback in the first installment of what figures to be an extended starting assignment in place of Jalen Hur

news.summary: Brown (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Texans, Joe Hoyt of The Dallas Morning News reports.
news.details: The undrafted rookie has yet to make his regular-season debut despite making the Cowboys' 53-man roster after a strong training camp, and his next opportunity to do so is Thursday against the Buccaneers. The Cowboys will have five active wide receivers for Sunday's game, with the position group led by CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens.

news.summary: Cooper caught one of two targets for nine yards and added 38 yards as a kick returner during Sunday's 25-14 loss to the Panthers.
news.details: Cooper saw his offensive workload decrease with the return of DeVonta Smith in Week 6, and, as a result, this was the first time he's failed to reel in multiple passes since Week 3. With Smith, Dontayvion Wicks and Makai Lemon all active, Cooper's ceiling will be limited from a fantasy perspective moving forward.

news.summary: The Eagles signed Covey to the active roster Tuesday, Tim McManus of ESPN.com reports.
news.details: Covey returned four punts for 37 yards in Sunday's 24-22 win over the Commanders. The wide receiver's production on special teams has now earned him a spot on the 53-man roster. It remains to be seen if Covey has earned additional responsibilities for next Sunday's game against the Titans.

news.summary: Demercado (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday night's matchup with the Packers, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.
news.details: Demercado was signed to the team's 53-man roster Tuesday, but he will ultimately take a seat in Week 6. In his absence, Javonte Williams and Tyler Goodson will handle the lion's share of the touches in the backfield.

news.summary: NFL reporter Jordan Schultz reports that teams seeking help at wide receiver will likely call the Eagles about the status of Brown before the Nov. 10 deadline.
news.details: Brown's lone regular-season game this season was in Week 2 against the Titans, when he rushed for 12 yards on two carries and did not record a target. He missed the next three games due to an ankle injury and was a healthy scratch for Week 6 against the Panthers, and the veteran wide receiver doesn't appear to be in the Eagles' offensive gameplan moving forward. The Eagles have a 2-4 record, and with franchise quarterback Jalen Hurts (calf) likely out for the rest of the season, the team could b

news.summary: Barkley (hamstring) practiced in a limited capacity Thursday.
news.details: This marks Barkley's first official on-field work since he initially suffered a hamstring injury in Week 4 against the Rams. He consequently sat out Weeks 5 and 6, but his return to drills this week at least gives him a chance to suit up Monday versus the Cowboys. Barkley told Jeff McLane of The Philadelphia Inquirer on Thursday that he wants to play in Week 7 but still needs to test out his hamstring over the next few days. Ultimately, Saturday's practice report will reveal Barkley's odds to re

news.summary: Richardson caught 4 of 7 targets for 29 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 28-25 loss to Georgia Tech.
news.details: Richardson now has a touchdown in back-to-back in weeks, and in the past three games he's emerged as a threat in the Duke passing game with nine catches for 111 yards and two scores after posting goose eggs in the first two weeks. He'll look to stay involved in Week 7 against UNC.

news.summary: Reynolds accrued two receptions (on three targets) for 18 yards during Saturday's 34-24 victory against Georgia Tech.
news.details: Reynolds was limited to just 18 yards, and he hasn't scored a touchdown in four consecutive outings since Sept. 19 at Maryland. He had at least four catches per game until Georgia Tech managed to shut him down. He'll look to get back his mojo at Clemson on Saturday night.

news.summary: Brown compiled six receptions (on seven targets) for 182 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 34-24 victory versus Georgia Tech.
news.details: Brown has caught fire lately, going for 147 or more yards in two of the past three outings. He has been a high volume pass-catcher this season, going for at least five receptions in all seven outings, while averaging 13.4 yards per reception. He'll look to keep up the good work at Clemson on Saturday.

news.summary: Brown tallied two receptions (on three targets) for 42 yards and one touchdown during Friday's 35-33 defeat versus Pittsburgh.
news.details: The freshman from Richmond had his first collegiate touchdown. He has carved out a nice role for himself in the offense, securing at least two receptions in four of his five appearances. He'll look to keep it rolling at Cal next Saturday.

news.summary: Moore reeled in all seven targets for 38 yards during Saturday's 28-20 victory against North Carolina.
news.details: Moore caught seven passes for the second straight week, but unlike against Georgia Southern when he was able to parlay that into an 103-yard, one touchdown day, the wideout was limited to just 38 yards as he couldn't find a big play through the air. He'll look to remain heavily involved in Week 4 at California.

news.summary: Wesco accrued nine receptions (on 12 targets) for 152 yards during Saturday's 41-13 defeat against Miami (FL).
news.details: Wesco's nine catches and 152 yards were both season highs, and it was the first time the wideout eclipsed 100 yards receiving all year. Clemson's passing game was more productive in Week 5 despite freshman quarterback Tait Reynolds being held without a touchdown for the second straight week. Wesco will look to stay hot in a much easier matchup in Week 6 against Charleston Southern.

news.summary: Hasley gathered in 5 of 6 targets for 88 yards during Saturday's 35-7 win over Stanford.
news.details: Hasley was Duke's top receiver in an easy win over Stanford. The tight end has been a consistent target for quarterback Walker Eget, who hasn't put up big numbers consistently but has orchestrated a solid passing game. Hasley will face another poor defense in Week 4 as the Blue Devils host William & Mary.

news.summary: Greene caught their only target for five yards during Saturday's 34-24 victory over Georgia Tech.
news.details: Greene ended up with just a single 5-yard reception, splashing cold water on his recent hot streak. His modest two-game touchdown-scoring streak was snapped, too. He'll look to bounce back in Saturday's game at Clemson.

news.summary: Becker recorded nine receptions (on 18 targets) for 165 yards during Saturday's 19-15 loss versus Ohio State.
news.details: On a day in which quarterback Josh Hoover attempted 40 passes, Becker recorded season-high numbers across the board in receptions and yards while logging 18 targets against the Buckeyes. Despite the fact that he was held out of the end zone, Becker remains a top tier option within the Indiana passing attack and should continue to see high levels of volume moving forward. A road matchup against Michigan on Saturday will serve as his next opportunity.

news.summary: Bennett (undisclosed) is not listed on the injury report for Saturday's tilt at Florida.
news.details: Bennett was listed as probable in South Carolina's initial injury report, so this was the expected outcome. The wideout has already surpassed his totals from last year as he looks to add to his 201 receiving yards on 18 receptions recorded through five games this season.

news.summary: Harbor totaled four receptions (on eight targets) for 83 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 38-19 victory against Florida.
news.details: Harbor led the team in receiving yards while also finding the end zone on a 15-yard pass from quarterback LaNorris Sellers, his second of the season. The senior wide receiver will aim to build on this performance for next week's contest against Tennessee.

news.summary: Marsh posted three receptions (on six targets) for 57 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 19-15 defeat to Ohio State.
news.details: Marsh caught a 19-yard touchdown from quarterback Josh Hoover in the fourth quarter, his seventh score in as many games this season, though the theme of his day was what could have been. The 6-foot-3 junior appeared to have caught a potential game-winning score from Hoover with less than a minute remaining in the contest but was unable to get his feet inbounds, sealing the victory for the Buckeyes. Despite the missed opportunity, Marsh remains a top tier option at receiver and should continue to

news.summary: Matthews totaled seven receptions (on nine targets) for 85 yards during Saturday's 26-10 win versus Alabama.
news.details: Matthews led the team in receptions and receiving yards, providing sophomore quarterback George MacIntyre with a reliable option. The junior wideout has now recorded at least 57 receiving yards in five consecutive games and will aim to maintain that consistency when they travel to South Carolina next Saturday.

news.summary: Staley accrued four receptions (on six targets) for 59 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 42-9 win against Kennesaw State.
news.details: Staley led Tennessee in receiving and connected with Brandon Faizon on a 13-yard strike for a touchdown in the first quarter. The junior wide receiver has scored in back-to-back games and will aim to extend his streak in next week's game against the Crimson Tide.

news.summary: Black tallied three receptions (on four targets) for 66 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 35-34 overtime defeat to Kentucky.
news.details: Black finished with his best performance of the season and scored his first touchdown on a 15-yard pass from LaNorris Sellers. He will hope to earn more opportunities for next week's game against Florida.

news.summary: Sherrill tallied eight receptions (on 11 targets) for 99 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 31-21 defeat to Arkansas.
news.details: Sherrill hauled in a 24-yard touchdown pass from Jared Curtis, marking two scores in his last three games. The senior wide receiver has reeled in at least four receptions in every game this season and  will aim to maintain his consistent production when Vandy visits Kentucky next Saturday.

news.summary: Jackson caught 5 of 6 targets for 61 yards during Saturday's 38-14 defeat against Wake Forest.
news.details: Jackson racked up five receptions, tying TE Preston Douglas and RB Davion Gause in the category. He has at least 61 receiving yards in four of the past five outings. However, he saw his three-game touchdown streak snapped. The offense will look for much better results in its next game Oct. 23 at Stanford.

news.summary: Douglas recorded five receptions (on six targets) for 45 yards during Saturday's 38-14 loss to Wake Forest.
news.details: Douglas tied for the team lead with five receptions in the 24-point loss. There weren't a lot of bright spots, but Douglas was certainly one of them. That's three consecutive games with exactly five receptions, as he continues to build a nice rapport with QB CJ Bailey. He'll look to keep up the good work at Stanford next time out on Oct. 23.

news.summary: Thomas caught all seven targets for 126 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 35-32 victory over Oklahoma State.
news.details: Thomas had his best game of the season in Saturday's ranked win, catching a pair of touchdowns and gaining over 100 yards. He caught all seven of his targets and gained more yards than he had in the last three games combined. He now has six touchdowns this season and will look to add to that total in Saturday's difficult matchup at Utah.

news.summary: Brown hauled in 4 of 5 targets for 42 yards during Saturday's 57-3 defeat against Wake Forest.
news.details: Brown paced the Cardinal with 42 receiving yards, and 10.5 yards per reception, which was actually one of the few bright spots in a mostly bleak performance. With Stanford likely to be behind early and often at Notre Dame, he could see a few more targets than usual on Saturday.

news.summary: Pegan posted eight receptions (on 13 targets) for 86 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 27-24 victory against Colorado.
news.details: Pegan further solidified his status as Utah's number one receiver. The standout performance came on yet another double-digit target performance, continuing a season-long trend that has seen Pegan emerge as Devon Dampier's most trusted option in the passing game. While Utah spreads the ball around to several playmakers, Pegan continues to command the most consistent workload among the receivers, and his two-touchdown outing against Colorado only reinforces his role as the focal point of an undefe

news.summary: Snow accrued three receptions (on six targets) for 39 yards during Saturday's 31-28 win over Louisville.
news.details: Snow, the former standout at the University of Buffalo, could be thrust into a larger role against Wake Forest on Saturday depending upon the health status for WR JoJo Trader (lower body). Snow has the potential to be a sleeper against the Demon Deacons if Trader is deemed unable to play.

news.summary: Whittemore had three receptions (on five targets) for 88 yards during Saturday's 27-24 victory over Colorado.
news.details: Whittemore's 88 receiving yards were a career-high, continuing a recent trend of making the most of his limited opportunities. While the target volume still isn't high enough to make him a dependable fantasy starter, his explosiveness is showing as the Utes head into a marquee matchup with Houston. If the volume continues to climb, he could become a sneaky fantasy contributor down the stretch.

news.summary: Thomas caught 3 of 4 targets for 60 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 52-17 defeat versus Mississippi.
news.details: Thomas led Vanderbilt in receiving yards and found the end zone for the first time this season on a 13-yard strike from Jared Curtis in the third quarter. He will hope to earn more opportunities for next week's contest against Arkansas.

news.summary: Blackburn reeled in 3 of 4 targets for 30 yards during Saturday's 34-7 victory over Elon.
news.details: Blackburn was one of five Stanford receivers with at least 10.0 yards per catch against the overwhelmed FCS Elon defense. He has at least three receptions in three consecutive games, but has also has 30 or fewer receiving yards in five straight outings.

news.summary: Young recorded three receptions (on four targets) for 68 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 35-32 victory over Oklahoma State.
news.details: Young caught his fifth touchdown of the season Saturday, a 48-yard reception in the 4th quarter which gave his team a 10-point lead. He gained a season-high 68 yards in the win. While he certainly has a knack for the endzone and for big plays, Young appears to be the fourth option in the passing game so he's really only valuable in deep formats at this point.

news.summary: Rodriguez caught 5 of 7 targets for 38 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 21-13 victory versus Oklahoma.
news.details: Rodriguez had a career high two touchdowns against the Sooners. Rodriguez came down with a 2-yard touchdown grab in the first quarter and followed it up with a 12-yarder in the fourth quarter. With five receptions against Oklahoma, Rodriguez now has hit that mark four times in the last five games.

news.summary: Walker gathered in 7 of 11 targets for 104 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 35-32 victory versus Oklahoma State.
news.details: Walker had his best outing of the season Saturday as he set season highs in catches, yards and targets in the win. He also caught his second touchdown of the season, a two-yard reception in the third quarter. He's been productive across the last four games, catching 20 passes on 30 targets for 298 yards and two touchdowns.

news.summary: Overmyer totaled five receptions (on eight targets) for 32 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 35-32 win against Oklahoma State.
news.details: Fresh off his four-touchdown game last week, Overmyer found the endzone again versus Oklahoma State. It marked his seventh touchdown through seven games this season. It was his second lowest yardage total of the season, but the receivers were getting open all game so it's not a big concern for Overmyer. Next up is another huge game at No. 10 Utah.

news.summary: Parker tallied 23 rushes for 98 yards and gathered in all two targets for 11 yards during Saturday's 27-24 win over Colorado.
news.details: Parker didn't find the end zone for the first time in three games, but his fantasy managers should be thrilled with the usage after he handled a season-high 25 touches. Even without a touchdown, Parker still piled up nearly 100 rushing yards and continued to operate as the unquestioned centerpiece of the Utes' ground game. The biggest takeaway is that Parker's workload continued to trend upward as Utah pushes deeper into Big 12 play. With back-to-back 170-yard performances preceding this outing

news.summary: Bennee totaled four receptions (on five targets) for 29 yards during Saturday's 27-24 victory over Colorado.
news.details: Bennee continue to serve as Utah's primary tight end. While he didn't find the end zone this week, his steady target share keeps him firmly on the fantasy radar in an offense led by Devon Dampier.

news.summary: Johnson hauled in all five targets for 104 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 41-24 win versus Kansas.
news.details: Johnson delivered his first 100-yard receiving game of the season. What's especially impressive is that Johnson reached the century mark despite continuing to work with modest target volume, as he has yet to see more than five targets in a game this year, highlighting just how explosive he can be when the ball comes his way.

news.summary: High caught 1 of 3 targets for seven yards during Saturday's 34-7 win against Elon.
news.details: High, the team's most productive receiver, did next to nothing. It was more of a run-heavy offense, but Stanford still had six other receivers with at least two receptions and at least 25 receiving yards. High will look to bounce back against NC State on Friday night.

news.summary: Glasker accrued five receptions (on eight targets) for 66 yards during Saturday's 28-24 victory over Notre Dame.
news.details: Glasker had another productive day Saturday, leading the team with a season-high eight targets. He reached 70 yards from scrimmage for the fifth time in his six appearances this season and he's now caught five passes in three of the last four games. The true freshman has become Bear Bachmeier's favorite target already which bodes well for the rest of the season and the rest of his collegiate career.

news.summary: Scott reeled in 4 of 7 targets for 56 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 56-23 victory over Mississippi State.
news.details: Scott had a big day as he was on the same page with Keelon Russell in big spots. Scott put together his first multi-touchdown game of his career. Scott overall did not have huge yardage numbers as Russell continues to spread the ball around in the passing game across all thre top wideouts in Scott, Ryan Coleman-Williams and Lotzier Brooks.

news.summary: Upshaw totaled four receptions (on seven targets) for 91 yards during Saturday's 43-35 overtime win against Florida State.
news.details: Upshaw didn't find the end zone in the big win over the rival Seminoles, but his 91 yards were his highest yet this fall as were his seven targets. Malachi Toney and Cooper Barkate remain the top two wideouts on this offense, but with a quarterback like Darian Mensah, every eligible receiver is liable to have a good game at the drop of a hat.

news.summary: Dixon reeled in 7 of 9 targets for 62 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 38-37 overtime win against Michigan State.
news.details: While he was held to his season-low receiving yards total ont he day, Dixon still managed to have an impact with a team-leading seven receptions to go along with his ninth touchdown of the season. The 6-foot-1 senior connected with quarterback Michael Clayton on a 14-yard scoring strike in the fourth quarter, giving the Fighting Illini a 14-point lead at the time. Discon continues to roll through the 2026 regular season, totaling 47 catches for 608 yards and nine scores through six games. A home

news.summary: Moore totaled seven receptions (on 14 targets) for 36 yards during Saturday's 17-14 win versus Nebraska.
news.details: Although Moore caught seven balls, he didn't do much with the target share. His slight increase in receptions was due to Evan Stewart's (undisclosed) absence, and he should have been able to do more without his teammate's involvement.

news.summary: Ohrstrom reeled in 2 of 5 targets for 21 yards during Saturday's 23-13 victory over Virginia.
news.details: Ohrstrom's yardage total was a season low, but fantasy managers shouldn't get away from him just yet. He has four touchdowns across four games, including multi-score games on two occasions. He'll look to re-discover the end zone against Cal on Saturday afternoon.

news.summary: Cooper caught 5 of 7 targets for 45 yards during Saturday's 25-16 win against Boston College.
news.details: Cooper has totaled 13 receptions across the past two games, and he had at least four catches in three of four outings against FBS opponents this season. He also has managed at least 42 receiving yards in four of five outings. WR Yamir Knight is the top target, but Cooper is battling to be the secondary option for QB Kevin Jennings, with TE Randy Pittman also in the mix.

news.summary: Lofton logged three receptions (on four targets) for 26 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 43-35 overtime victory over Florida State.
news.details: Lofton scored his second touchdown of the season as Miami beat Florida State in an absolute thriller. He's been a minor part of this passing game, but he has at least one reception in every game and has four targets and three catches in each of the last two weeks.

news.summary: Kasper recorded six receptions (on eight targets) for 66 yards during Saturday's 28-24 victory over Notre Dame. He also threw a 15-yard touchdown pass.
news.details: Kasper had a high-volume receiving outing Saturday, setting season highs in receptions and yards in the massive win over Notre Dame. Kasper, who has three touchdown receptions this season, also returned the favor to his quarterback by tossing Bear Bachmeier a 15-yard touchdown pass in the second quarter. With at least five targets in five of six outings this season, Kasper has established himself as an important piece of the Cougars' offense, especially with star running back LJ Martin (ankle) o

news.summary: Kent notched two receptions (on five targets) for 20 yards during Saturday's 27-21 defeat to Boston College.
news.details: Kent has multiple receptions in four of the past five games. He hasn't found the end zone since he had six grabs for 57 yards and a TD against Bucknell on Sept. 26. He has had a few bright spots this season, but more often than not his production is rather limited.

news.summary: Smith logged five receptions (on six targets) for 87 yards during Saturday's 23-13 win over Virginia.
news.details: Smith posted a game-best in receiving yardage, highlighted by a 59-yard reception, the longest play from scrimmage for either side. After scoring in the first two games, he hasn't found the end zone in each of the past three outings. However, Smith has five receptions three times, and he continues to jell nicely with QB Kevin Jennings.

news.summary: Knight (undisclosed) hauled in 3 of 7 targets for 62 yards during Saturday's 21-17 loss to North Carolina.
news.details: Knight returned to the field after sitting out three consecutive games due to an undisclosed injury. He led the receiving corps with 62 yards and logged a 40-yard reception that stood as the team's longest offensive play of the contest. He will aim to replicate his success in the receiving game in Week 7 against Boston College.

news.summary: Vander Zee hauled in 3 of 4 targets for 69 yards and one touchdown during Friday's 41-24 win versus Washington.
news.details: On a day in which Iowa dominated on the ground, Vander Zee led the way for the Hawkeyes with 69 receiving yards while tying for the team-lead with three receptions to go along with a touchdown against Washington. The 6-foot-4 junior connected with quarterback Jeremy Hecklinski on an eight-yard scoring strike in the third quarter to extend the Iowa lead at the time. A road matchup against Minnesota awaits after next week's bye.

news.summary: Knight reeled in all six targets for 51 yards during Saturday's 23-13 victory over Virginia.
news.details: Knight didn't have the greatest yardage total against the Hoos, but the six receptions were certainly nice. His 8.5 yards per reception was his lowest mark since being held to 8.2 yards per catch in the road win at Florida State on Sept. 7. He has managed six or more catches in four of his six outings. He'll look to build upon that at Cal on Saturday.

news.summary: Piening caught 7 of 8 targets for 60 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 42-28 defeat to Oklahoma State.
news.details: Piening caught his second touchdown of the season Saturday, a four-yard reception late in the fourth quarter. He has found a larger role in the offense since the start of Big 12 play, catching 10 passes (on 16 targets) for 96 yards and two touchdowns across three games. If he can keep up that pace through the rest of the season he'll be a good fantasy option.

news.summary: Marsh (undisclosed) is no longer listed ahead of Saturday's game versus Penn State, per the Big Ten availability report.
news.details: Marsh, who was listed as probable earlier in the week, will be available for the Wolverines in Week 7. The 6-foot-1 sophomore wideout continues to command a large role in his second season with the program, logging 25 receptions for 268 yards and one touchdown through five outings. Marsh and the Wolverines will look to get back on track in their first game following a Week 5 loss against Minnesota.

news.summary: Derry posted 11 receptions (on 13 targets) for 84 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 42-28 defeat versus Oklahoma State.
news.details: Derry caught a touchdown in his second straight game Saturday, a 12-yard reception in the first quarter. He also set season highs in receptions and targets and he now has 18 catches for 185 yards and two touchdowns across the last two games alone. If he can maintain even close to that pace across the remainder of the season, he'll be a must-start fantasy player.

news.summary: Hicks had five receptions (on nine targets) for 135 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 27-21 loss versus Boston College.
news.details: Hicks has had to adjust to three different quarterbacks in the past three games. Pitt lost QB Mason Heintschel (ACL) for the season, so Holden Geriner started last time out against North Carolina. Now, Hicks was working with freshman Corey Dailey, and the two had quite the rapport. They'll look to keep up the good work together at Miami on Saturday.

news.summary: Charles compiled four receptions (on five targets) for 41 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 12-7 defeat versus Pittsburgh.
news.details: After not being targeted in Week 1, Charles had five targets in Saturday's loss and scored the team's lone touchdown, a 19-yard reception late in the fourth quarter. He gained 41 yards through the air, ranking second on the team behind Ric'Darious Farmer. He faces a more favorable matchup Saturday versus Georgia State, though he will be without his starting quarterback Alonza Barnett (hamstring).

news.summary: Jennings tallied seven receptions (on nine targets) for 70 yards during Saturday's 20-14 win versus Michigan.
news.details: Jennings put together another solid outing for the Golden Gophers, leading the way in both receptions and yards against rival Michigan. The 6-foot senior was once again held out of the end zone but was able to make an impact in the game despite quarterback Drake Lindsey totaling just 136 yards through the air. Jennings has been a consistent presence in the Minnesota passing attack this season and should continue to get opportunties moving forward. His next opportunity will come against Purdue on

news.summary: Buchanan caught 3 of 5 targets for 36 yards during Saturday's 21-18 victory over Penn State.
news.details: On a day in which Michigan quarterbacks combined for just 90 passing yards, Buchanan didn't have much opportunity to demonstrate his ability through the air. On the plus side, he did still lead the way for the Wolverines despite logging a season-low 36 receiving yards while tying for the team lead with three receptions against the Nittany Lions, indicating that his role as the top receiving option within the Michigan offense remains unchanged. He will hope for better days moving forward, though

news.summary: Barkate gathered in all two targets for 28 yards during Saturday's 43-35 overtime win over Florida State.
news.details: Barkate was held in check even in a shootout win. Barkate still has multiple catches in every game this season, but his two targets were his fewest yet. He'll look to get more involved in Week 8 against Pitt.

news.summary: Diaz caught 5 of 9 targets for 59 yards during Saturday's 31-14 loss versus Ohio State.
news.details: Diaz saw an increase in volume on the day as the Hawkeyes were forced to all but abandon the run game against a stout Ohio State defense. The 5-foot-10 receiver finished second on the team behind tight end DJ Vonnahme in both receptions and yards on the day, outpacing his fellow receivers by substantial margins in both categories. Diaz will hope to find his way back into the end zone for the first time since Week 1 when the Hawkeyes travel to face Washington on Friday.

news.summary: Horton hauled in two of six targets for 22 yards during Saturday's 27-6 defeat against Missouri.
news.details: Horton struggled to establish himself despite drawing six targets, producing just two receptions. In a game where quarterback Marcel Reed struggled to move the ball, the senior wide receiver finished with his fourth consecutive matchup without finding the end zone. He will work to bounce back against a more beatable matchup in Citadel during next week's meeting.

news.summary: Clement had six receptions (on eight targets) for 105 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 38-37 overtime victory versus Michigan State.
news.details: Clement had his best game of the season against the Spartans, leading the way for the Fighting Illini with season-high numbers in both receptions and yards while finding the end zone for the first time in 2026. The 6-foot-1 senior had about as impactful of a score as possible, delivering on a 25-yard catch-and-run on the first play of overtime to give Illinois what would end up being the game-winning score. He will look to keep the positive momentum going through the upcoming bye week into the t

news.summary: Tracy reeled in 5 of 8 targets for 75 yards during Saturday's 41-13 defeat to Purdue.
news.details: Despite failing to find the end zone, Tracy put together a solid performance against the Boilermakers. The 6-foot senior caught five passes for 75 scoreless yards on the day, finishing second on the team in both categories. Tracy has seen plenty of volume this year but has only found the end zone once on offense. He will hope to get back into the scoring column when the Golden Gophers host Iowa following their upcoming bye.

news.summary: Lyons gathered in 5 of 6 targets for 49 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 28-24 victory over Notre Dame.
news.details: Lyons caught his first touchdown of the season Saturday and it couldn't have come at a better time. He caught the six-yard score with less than two minutes left in the fourth quarter to take the lead over the No. 2 team in the nation. It was another productive performance for Luons after his slow start to the season as he now has 10 catches (on 12 targets) for 110 yards and a touchdown across the last two games.

news.summary: Hampton recorded six receptions (on seven targets) for 71 yards and two touchdowns during Friday's 84-0 win versus Portland State.
news.details: Hampton made his first appearance for Oregon and capitalized on Oregon pulling much of the first unit in the second half. The freshman caught TD passes from Dante Moore and Dylan Raiola and accrued seven targets. His performance could earn him more snaps as the season progresses.

news.summary: Taylor had seven rushes for 15 yards and reeled in 7 of 10 targets for 51 yards during Saturday's 41-13 defeat versus Purdue.
news.details: On a day in which he was limited to just 15 yards on a measly 2.1 YPC on the ground, Taylor made most of his impact as a receiver. The 6-foot senior led the Golden Gophers with seven receptions on the day, totaling 51 yards thorugh the air on 10 targets. Taylor has been largely held in check on the ground this year, totaling 154 yards and four touchdowns on 2.4 YPC across five games, but has contributed as a receiver as well, catching 18 passes for 155 yards and a score in that timeframe. A home

news.summary: Smith caught 3 of 4 targets for 89 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 41-13 defeat to Purdue.
news.details: Despite catching just three passes on the day, Smith led the way for the Golden Gophers with 89 receiving yards to go along with his third touchdown of the season. The 6-foot-1 junior connected with quarterback Drake Lindsey for a 42-yard scoring strike in the third quarter, bringing Minnesota within 14 points at the time. Smith has struggled to see consistent volume this season adn will hope to increase his involvement in the Minnesota passing attack moving forward, with his next opportunity co

news.summary: Vonnahme caught all two targets for 44 yards and two touchdowns during Friday's 41-24 win versus Washington.
news.details: Vonnahme saaw just two targets on the day but made the most of his opportunities, finding the end zone on both targets for his first and second scores of the year. The 6-foot-4 tight end connected with quarterback Jeremy Hecklinski on a pair of touchdowns in the second quarter, from 20 and 24 yards out, respectively, to help build the Iowa lead. He will hope to find his way back into the end zone when the Hawkeyes travel to face Minnesota following the team's upcoming bye.

news.summary: Pritchett caught all two targets for 32 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 20-17 loss to Georgia.
news.details: Pritchett has been the primary receiving tight end for the Crimson Tide over the course of the season, however, he has been overshadowed by the highly productive receiver group. Pritchett did manage to come down with his first touchdown reception against the Bulldogs.

news.summary: Hansen (undisclosed) participated in Saturday's 52-17 win over UTEP.
news.details: Hansen made his season debut Saturday after being observed in uniform before the contest. The tight end logged 13 snaps but didn't record a stat. Now fully healthy, he will look to help Michigan's offense moving forward.

news.summary: Brooks logged four receptions (on five targets) for 96 yards during Saturday's 56-23 victory versus Mississippi State.
news.details: Brooks put up very nice yardage numbers as he came up with several key chunk catches to keep momentum going for the Tide. The biggest of which was a 3rd and 19 first down catch for 39 yards to set Alabama up for their second offensive touchdown of the game. Brooks was unable to find the endzone in this one though as quarterback Keelon Russell continues to spread the ball around across Alabama's top three wideouts in Brooks, Ryan Coleman-Williams and Rico Scott.

news.summary: Lee reeled in their only target for eight yards during Saturday's 27-21 defeat against Boston College.
news.details: Lee has disappeared since exploding for three touchdowns against Bucknell on Sept. 26. In his past three games, he has just seven receptions for 49 yards, as he has had difficulty adjusting to Holden Geriner and Corey Dailey under center since Mason Heintschel (ACL) went down for the season.

news.summary: Hill had 14 rushes for 67 yards and hauled in all four targets for 14 yards during Saturday's 17-14 win over Nebraska.
news.details: Hill has been the more dynamic option for the Ducks over the past few games, showing slightly more explosiveness after contact than his backfield counterpart, Jordan Davison. Although both backs will receive similar carries, Hill carries a bit more fantasy upside at the moment.

news.summary: Ashley (undisclosed) has been given a questionable status for Saturday's clash with West Virginia, per the Big 12 availability report.
news.details: Ashley's status is up in the air for Saturday, as he holds a questionable designation on TCU's initial injury report. The tight end has been a reliable target this season, recording 29 receptions for 392 yards and four touchdowns.

news.summary: Jones posted 18 rushes for 84 yards and reeled in 8 of 9 targets for 58 yards during Saturday's 31-0 win against Mississippi State.
news.details: Jones delivered an all-around productive performance totaling 142 yards. The sophomore running back has now exceeded scrimmage yards in back-to-back games. Jones continues to be the primary option in the LSU backfield and his growing involvement in the passing attack gives him a high value floor even when not scoring a touchdown.

news.summary: Small recorded seven receptions (on nine targets) for 91 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 17-6 victory versus Baylor.
news.details: Small opened the scoring with a 25-yard touchdown reception in the first quarter. While teammate Jordan Dwyer grabbed the headlines with a 150-yard outing, Small turned in another productive performance and maintained the steady volume that has made him a dependable fantasy option. The matchup gets even more appealing next week against West Virginia, a defense that just allowed a ton of yards to Cincinnati.

news.summary: Watkins notched four receptions (on six targets) for 31 yards during Saturday's 31-0 win over Mississippi State.
news.details: Watkins had a disappointing despite hauling in four receptions, as he was limited to just  31 yards. The scoreless day marks the fourth straight game Watkins has been held without a touchdown. The sophomore now has 33 receptions for 447 yards through seven games but, his production has declined considerably since surpassing 100 receiving yards in two of the first four contests.

news.summary: Dwyer had six receptions (on nine targets) for 150 yards during Saturday's 17-6 win versus Baylor.
news.details: Dwyer turned in his biggest performance of the season. His biggest play came on a 67-yard catch-and-run to open the second half, setting up a touchdown on the very next snap and helping TCU create the separation it needed in a defensive battle. Dwyer has quietly become one of the most explosive receivers in the Big 12, and his timing couldn't be better. He'll now face a West Virginia secondary that just surrendered 389 passing yards to Cincinnati and has been involved in multiple shootouts this

news.summary: Wilson gathered in 3 of 4 targets for 32 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 31-0 win over Mississippi State.
news.details: Wilson found the endzone in Saturday's contest against the Bulldogs as he hauled in three of four targets on the day. Wilson snapped a streak of six consecutive games without a TD catch. Despite the touchdown grab in this one, Wilson has struggled to establish a consistent role in the LSU passing attack.

news.summary: Harris (ankle) says he is good to go for Saturday's game at Auburn, Cory Diaz of The Daily Advertiser reports.
news.details: Harris got hurt midway through last Saturday's game against Mississippi State and did not return. The wide receiver said he would have returned had LSU not been dominating State, which did not score a single point in Week 7. Since a disappointing performance at Mississippi, Harris has excelled in SEC competition, with 18 receptions (on 21 targets) for 302 yards and five touchdowns across the Tigers' last three conference games.

news.summary: Singleton reeled in 3 of 8 targets for 45 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 27-24 victory against Georgia.
news.details: Singleton saw a large number of targets in this one but wasn't able to turn them into receptions. Singleton however, was the beneficiary of a nicely executed trick play, catching a 24 yard touchdown pass from fellow receiver Christian Neptune.

news.summary: Ellis (head) is not on UCLA's injury report for Saturday's matchup against Purdue.
news.details: After missing the last contest against San Diego State with a head injury, Ellis is good to go for UCLA's Big Ten opener against Purdue. The wide receiver logged just one catch for 20 yards during his Bruin debut in Week 1 against California.

news.summary: McCray tallied three receptions (on five targets) for 64 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 24-21 loss to Northwestern.
news.details: Despite catching just three passes on the day, McCray made the most of his opportunities against Northwestern. The 5-foot-10 senior connected with quarterback Alessio Milivojevic for a 53-yard scoring strike in the fourth quarter, giving the Spartans a 21-13 lead at the time. McCray will hope to keep the positive momentum going as the Spartans travel to face UCLA on Saturday.

news.summary: Montague hauled in 5 of 7 targets for 72 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 22-16 victory over Maine.
news.details: Montague has been hot and cold this season. He had two grabs for 55 yards and a score in the opener against Cincy, but he didn't have a single catch in Week 2. The wideout then had a career day against FCS Maine in Week 3. Given how ineffective this offense looks overall, though, it appears unwise to bank on production from Montague.

news.summary: Beers posted four receptions (on eight targets) for 45 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 21-13 defeat against Kentucky.
news.details: Beers accounted for Oklahoma's lone touchdown on a 20-yard reception from quarterback John Mateer, giving him his second score over the last three games. The tight end will look to maintain his involvement in the passing attack against Mississippi State next week.

news.summary: Green hauled in 5 of 9 targets for 60 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 27-21 win versus Pittsburgh.
news.details: Green scored his first touchdown of the 2026 campaign and had his best outing since Week 1, when he tallied six catches for 74 yards. This Eagles' passing game remains shaky on a week-to-week basis, but he'll look to stay hot in Week 8 at Georgia Tech.

news.summary: Moore gathered in all two targets for 42 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 38-37 overtime loss to Illinois.
news.details: Moore connected with quarterback Alessio Milivojevic on a 24-yard scoring strike to the corner of the end zone in the fourth quarter, bringing the Spartans to within seven during their attempted comeback bid. The 6-foot-1 receiver has established himself as a regular target for Milivojevic recently, caught 10 passes for 108 yards and a touchdown across his last three games. He will hope to build momentum off his performance against the Fighting Illini during next week's matchup against Northwest

news.summary: Morgan reeled in 4 of 8 targets for 72 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 52-38 victory over Purdue.
news.details: Morgan has overtaken the other candidates and is now the Bruins' most productive receiver. A year ago, it was difficult to single out any receiver of note, but Nico Iamaleava's accuracy and poise have markedly improved, and Morgan is reaping many of the benefits.

news.summary: Sategna totaled eight receptions (on 14 targets) for 83 yards during Saturday's 21-13 defeat against Kentucky.
news.details: Sategna led the team in receptions and targets, earning the majority of the team's passing attempts. The junior wideout has at least eight receptions for 80 yards in two of his last three outings and will look to build on his performances when Oklahoma travels to Mississippi State next Saturday.

news.summary: Pough caught 4 of 6 targets for 106 yards and one touchdown during Friday's 28-21 win versus Rutgers.
news.details: Pough had a career, breakout game against Rutgers, as despite playing plenty of snaps in the opener against Cincinnati the receiver didn't catch a pass. That changed against the Scarlet Knights' soft defense, and Pough notched his first career 100-yard game and reeled in the Eagles' lone receiving touchdown. He'll look to stay hot next week against FCS Maine.

news.summary: Allen hauled in 10 of 12 targets for 120 yards during Saturday's 34-24 defeat versus Virginia Tech.
news.details: Allen has logged 10 catches in back-to-back games; his chemistry with quarterback Alberto Mendoza only appears to be growing. There's clearly a concerted effort to get him the ball as well, as he's tallied 23 targets over the past two weeks after he notched 23 over the first four games combined.

news.summary: Bullard caught both targets for 66 yards during Saturday's 27-10 defeat versus Notre Dame.
news.details: On a day in which Spartan quarterbacks completed just nine passes, Bullard led the way with 66 receiving yards on two receptions against the Fighting Irish. The 5-foot-11 receiver saw most of his production come on a 53-yard strike from quarerback Alessio Milivojevic in the second quarter, leading to Michigan State's only touchdown of the game. Bullard will hope for better days for the Spartan offense as a whole moving forward, with his next opportunity coming against Nebraska on Saturday.

news.summary: Miller reeled in all four targets for 58 yards during Saturday's 53-25 loss against Texas Tech.
news.details: Miller had a season-low four targets in Saturday's blowout loss, half of his previous low on the year. He still gained 58 yards and he caught four passes for the fifth time this season, but it was a disappointing performance from him. He'll look to bounce back Saturday at Kansas State.

news.summary: Harris caught 7 of 13 targets for 63 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 53-25 defeat against Texas Tech.
news.details: Harris caught his eighth touchdown of the season Saturday, a two-yard pass from Mikey Keene in the third quarter. He had a season-high 13 targets in the loss which makes sense considering the Sun Devils were losing big for the majority of the contest. It was his second-lowest yards total of the season, but his touchdown salvaged another good performance from the star receiver.

news.summary: Tibbs accrued five receptions (on eight targets) for 67 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 35-24 win over Kansas.
news.details: Tibbs came through with the biggest catch of the game for Kansas State, hauling in a nine-yard touchdown from Avery Johnson in the fourth quarter to help the Wildcats pull away from Kansas. The score was Tibbs' second in as many games and further solidified his role as the Wildcats' leading receiver. With touchdowns in back-to-back contests and a clear lead role in the receiving corps, Tibbs is establishing himself as the most dependable pass-catching option in the Wildcats' offense moving forwa

news.summary: Wingo tallied five receptions (on eight targets) for 49 yards during Saturday's 27-24 loss against Florida.
news.details: Wingo led Texas in receptions and finished with at least five receptions for the third time this season . The junior receiver will look to build on this performance for next week's clash against Ole Miss.

news.summary: Brooks caught all three targets for 91 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 54-10 win against Eastern Michigan.
news.details: Brooks scored his second touchdown of the season in the blowout win, and it seems he's well on his way to eclipsing all of his previous seasonal totals with his current numbers. At 6-2, he'a a very visible 50/50 option for Colton Joseph.

news.summary: Dixon-Wyatt logged two receptions (on three targets) for 28 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 31-23 victory over Penn State.
news.details: Trent Mosley's return was bound to cut into Dixon-Wyatt's production, and expectations should be tempered now that Mosley and Tanook Hines are regular contributors. Jayden Maiava did find him in the red zone for a score, however.

news.summary: Shipp is questionable for Saturday's matchup versus Syracuse, per the ACC availability report.
news.details: Shipp has returned to the injury report after being listed as questionable last week before ultimately being cleared. The wideout scored his first touchdown of the season against Duke in Week 7.

news.summary: Williams caught their only target for 44 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 49-30 win versus Louisiana.
news.details: The emergence of Trent Mosley and Kayden Dixon-Wyatt has lessened Williams' impact in the passing game, but he saw several snaps against Louisiana and will continue to be used when the formation calls for more than three receivers.

news.summary: Hatcher hauled in 13 of 15 targets for 224 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 34-26 defeat to Louisville.
news.details: Hatcher might be one of the most unheralded players in America. He has eight or more receptions in four of six games, and he has rolled up at least 126 receiving yards in three in a row, while scoring at least one touchdown (five total) in the past three outings, too. He'll look to keep up the good work at NC State on Saturday night.

news.summary: Bowman (undisclosed) is listed as questionable ahead of Saturday's matchup against Wisconsin.
news.details: After missing the previous two games with an undisclosed injury, Bowman may miss a third consecutive game against the Badgers on Saturday. The tight end has 21 receptions for 204 yards and two touchdowns in five games.

news.summary: Thurman caught 4 of 7 targets for 52 yards during Saturday's 24-20 win versus Duke.
news.details: Thurman didn't have a bad game by any means, but it wasn't the biggest fantasy outing for the tight end. He remains a big part of the game-plan, as he notched seven more targets and still averages 7.2 targets through six games. Next up for UNC is a home game against Syracuse in Week 7.

news.summary: Alexander caught 3 of 9 targets for 20 yards during Saturday's 31-3 victory over Missouri.
news.details: Despite leading the Rebels in targets against Missouri, Alexander wasn't able to capitalize with just 20 yards receiving. The down day snapped a streak of four straight games with a receiving touchdown for the star wideout. The junior now has 35 receptions for 523 yards through six games and remains Ole Miss' leading receiving threat.

news.summary: Henry recorded two receptions (on four targets) for 32 yards during Saturday's 31-3 win over Michigan State.
news.details: Henry was barely used in the victory, but opponent quality was likely the major contributor to the downtick and shouldn't be a major concern for Henry's outlook moving forward.

news.summary: Ray hauled in 7 of 8 targets for 115 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 32-24 win versus LSU.
news.details: Ray hasn't seen much action on the season however he cashed in big time in this one. Ray's eight targets led to a team high seven receptions and 115 yards while giving him his first touchdown grab of the season. It will be interesting to see if this is a catalyst for big things for the junior wide out or is just a blip on the radar.

news.summary: Mosley recorded nine receptions (on 13 targets) for 111 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 31-23 victory over Penn State.
news.details: Mosely jumped right back into action and got back to his prolific ways in USC's offense.  He showed no signs of his knee injury as Jayden Maiava sent 13 targets his way. He managed some highlight-worthy catches against Penn State's secondary, which had no answer for him.

news.summary: Harris had two receptions (on three targets) for 35 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 31-3 victory against Michigan State.
news.details: Wisconsin has a rich history of tight end excellence, and Jacob Harris is continuing the trend with 238 yards and three touchdowns through five games. At 6-6, Harris is a very visible target for Colton Joseph, and he should come in handy moving forward.

news.summary: Sadler (undisclosed) logged one reception (on three targets) for 13 yards during Saturday's 37-26 loss to Notre Dame.
news.details: Sadler rejoined the receiving corps against Notre Dame after a one-game absence. The wideout did not see heavy volume, though he was one of six pass catchers to haul in a catch. He will look to add to his season totals of five receptions for 86 yards as the team prepares for Week 6 against Pittsburgh.

news.summary: Odom caught 4 of 6 targets for 37 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 31-3 victory versus Missouri.
news.details: Odom had a solid day hauling in three receptions including a 10-yard touchdown grab. The sophomore tight end has now recorded four grabs in four consecutive games, totaling 18 catches for 201 yards over that span. Though Odom's yardage production has declined in recent weeks his consistent involvement in the passing attack and redzone capabilities continue to make him a good tight end option for fantasy managers.

news.summary: Coleman caught 3 of 4 targets for 18 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 27-24 loss against Florida.
news.details: Coleman salvaged an otherwise quiet afternoon with a nine-yard touchdown reception from Arch Manning in the fourth quarter. The junior wideout has found the end zone in back-to-back games and will aim for a bigger outing during next week's contest against Ole Miss.

news.summary: Hines posted four receptions (on seven targets) for 82 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 31-23 win over Penn State.
news.details: Hines made some impressive grabs against Penn State, and while Trent Mosley's return stole some of his thunder, he's clearly a favorite target for Jaydeb Maiava and will continue to deliver production going forward.

news.summary: Carter gathered in 1 of 4 targets for eight yards during Saturday's 53-25 victory against Arizona State. He also recorded two rushes for three yards and a touchdown.
news.details: Carter didn't make much of an impact through the air, but he still managed to find the end zone on a one-yard rushing touchdown in the fourth quarter. With the Red Raiders spreading touches around during a comfortable victory, Carter salvaged fantasy value with the score though his receiving production remained limited. For fantasy managers, the touchdown was good, but the lack of involvement in the passing game remains the bigger story. Until his target volume increases, Carter's value will con

news.summary: Gibson compiled seven receptions (on 11 targets) for 75 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 45-42 loss against West Virginia.
news.details: Gibson caught his fourth touchdown of the season Saturday, a four-yard reception in the first quarter. He had a season-high 11 targets and caught seven of them, gaining 75 yards for the second time this season. He faces a difficult matchup versus Texas Tech next, but the team will likely be throwing the ball a lot again.

news.summary: Eakin compiled three receptions (on four targets) for 24 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 53-25 victory against Arizona State.
news.details: Eakin continued his knack for converting opportunities into fantasy production, hauling in a touchdown in the blowout win. The score gives him a touchdown in three of his last five games, an impressive rate considering he's averaging just 5.3 targets per contest over that span. Eakin may not dominate the target share in Texas Tech's deep receiving corps, but he continues to make the most of his chances in an offense that creates scoring opportunities every week. As long as Will Hammond and the R

news.summary: Johnson gathered in 7 of 8 targets for 120 yards during Saturday's 53-25 victory over Arizona State.
news.details: Johnson continued his highly efficient season (9.7 yards per target), posting his second 100-yard receiving performance of the year. While he has yet to command more than nine targets in a single game, Johnson continues to maximize every opportunity and remains one of the most explosive pieces of the Red Raiders' passing attack. For fantasy managers, Johnson's production is a reminder that target quality can be just as important as target volume. With Will Hammond playing at a high level and Tex

news.summary: Johnson caught 3 of 5 targets for 85 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 45-42 defeat against West Virginia.
news.details: Johnson caught his first touchdown of the season Saturday, a 51-yard reception in the second quarter. He also gained a season-high 85 yards in the close loss. He's had a solid past two games, catching nine of 14 targets for 145 yards and a score. While the Bearcats' passing offense can be a bit volatile, Johnson is clearly a big part of the gameplan in passing situations.

news.summary: Hudson logged two receptions for 16 yards during Texas Tech's 29-7 win at Colorado.
news.details: For the 2026 NCAA season, like during 2025, Texas Tech's receiver corps includes a capably proven Hudson. Since his re-enrollment, each of his games features multiple targets. Of the wideout's 12 logged, he caught seven for 78 yards, 11.1 averaged per catch.

news.summary: Henry caught 2 of 3 targets for 128 yards during Saturday's 45-42 defeat against West Virginia.
news.details: Henry only had two receptions Saturday yet he still gained nearly 130 yards. He caught passes of 69 yards and 59 yards and somehow did not score on either. While he is not targeted often in the passing game, he's proven himself to be an excellent deep threat for the Bearcats which could earn him more looks during the second half of the season.

news.summary: Tabb totaled 15 carries for 118 yards and two touchdowns and reeled in all four targets for 51 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 45-42 loss to West Virginia.
news.details: Tabb was able to take the majority of the work in Saturday's shootout after Gi'Bran Payne left early with an injury. Tabb made the most of the extra workload, scoring three touchdowns for the third time in his last four games. He also rushed for over 100 yards for the second time this season and has a season-high 51 receiving yards. Tabb already established himself as a valuable asset with Payne on the field, but this may be Tabb's backfield now depending on the severity of his teammate's injury

news.summary: Jackson caught 6 of 7 targets for 160 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 45-42 win versus West Virginia.
news.details: Jackson was the biggest beneficiary of Iowa State's offensive explosion. In a game that featured more than 1,000 yards, Jackson consistently stretched the field and delivered the chunk plays that kept Iowa State's offense rolling. With defenses paying so much attention to Aiden Flora in the run game, Jackson can find favorable opportunities downfield.

news.summary: Duff reeled in 9 of 16 targets for 113 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 37-30 victory versus Maryland.
news.details: Rutgers put together an excellent showing against the Terps, showcasing their best offensive weapon, Duff, who continues to cruise near the top of the FBS wide receiver rankings.

news.summary: Phelps caught 4 of 6 targets for 88 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 52-31 victory versus West Virginia.
news.details: Phelps caught his third touchdown of the season Saturday, a 42-yard reception in the fourth quarter to give his team a two-score lead. With both Gio Richardson (hamstring) and Chris Hunter (knee) out, Phelps had a season high six targets and made the most of them, gaining nearly 90 yards in the win.

news.summary: Williams tallied 11 rushes for 165 yards and two touchdowns and reeled in all two targets for eight yards during Saturday's 53-25 victory against Arizona State.
news.details: Williams took full advantage of an expanded workload with Cameron Dickey sidelined, erupting for a career-high 165 rushing yards. The breakout performance was fueled by explosive scoring runs of 62 and 38 yards, further cementing Williams as one of the most dangerous home-run threats in the Big 12. At this point, Williams is no longer a feel-good story but a central piece of an undefeated Texas Tech offense. Even after an early fumble, the Red Raiders continued to trust him, and he responded wit

news.summary: Mizell caught 6 of 7 targets for 183 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 52-31 victory over West Virginia.
news.details: With Gio Richardson (hamstring) and Chris Hunter (knee) both out, Mizell became the top target Saturday. He made the most of the opportunity, scoring a pair of touchdowns and gaining a career-high 183 yards through the air. He now has 24 targets across the last four games, establishing a big role in this excellent passing offense with or without Richardson and Hunter.

news.summary: Hayes caught all three targets for 18 yards during Friday's 24-10 loss versus Brigham Young.
news.details: Hayes was unable to make a significant impact against BYU as Iowa State struggled to generate explosive plays all evening. The Cyclones should have a better opportunity to get the passing game going when they return from their bye against Arizona.

news.summary: Wagner recorded four receptions (on five targets) for 61 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 45-14 victory against Ball State.
news.details: Wagner put together his best performance of the season on Saturday, logging four catches for a season-high 61 yards to go along with his first touchdown of the season. The 5-foot-10 junior connected with quarterback Aidan Chiles on a 12-yard scoring strike in the third quarter, giving the Wildcats a 38-14 lead at the time. He will hope to build positive momentum off Saturday's performance, with his next opportunity coming against Michigan State on Saturday.

news.summary: Wilde gathered in 6 of 9 targets for 57 yards during Saturday's 24-21 victory against Michigan State.
news.details: Though Wilde was held out of the end zone for the fourth time this season, he manage to lead the way for the Wildcats in both receptions and yards on the day. The 6-foot-2 senior tied his season-high with nine targets against the Spartans, indicating that his role as the top dog in the passing attack remains steady. His next opportunity will come against Rutgers on Saturday.

news.summary: Polite compiled one reception (on two targets) for 34 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 55-7 victory versus Bowling Green.
news.details: Polite, a true freshman, recorded the first touchdown of his collegiate career in Iowa State's blowout win. The score is an encouraging sign for his long-term development, but it's still difficult to project consistent fantasy value in an offense that has leaned heavily on the run through three games. For now, Polite is primarily a dynasty stash and a name to monitor as Iowa State enters Big 12 play.

news.summary: Bowick reeled in 3 of 5 targets for 27 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 35-32 loss against Houston.
news.details: Bowick round the end zone again in the loss to Houston, extending his scoring streak to four consecutive games. The score gives him touchdowns in five of Oklahoma State's six games this season, reinforcing his role as one of Drew Mestemaker's most trusted weapons near the goal line and in critical situations. Even on a night when Caleb Hawkins and Wyatt Young posted huge numbers, Bowick still managed to make his usual impact, a testament to the depth and reliability of Oklahoma State's passing g

news.summary: Kolb gathered in all two targets for 19 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 59-0 win against Murray State.
news.details: Kolb found the end zone again, giving him touchdowns in consecutive weeks. In an offense that has suddenly become one of the most explosive units in the Big 12, that's a trend fantasy managers should pay attention to. The volume isn't overwhelming, but tight end production is often driven by red-zone usage, and Kolb is clearly earning trust near the goal line. With Drew Mestemaker throwing the ball effectively and Oklahoma State showing it can support multiple pass catchers, Kolb's fantasy outlo

news.summary: Young hauled in 5 of 9 targets for 99 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 35-32 defeat to Houston.
news.details: Young continued his remarkable scoring run as he extended his touchdown streak to five consecutive games, a testament to both his reliability and his growing chemistry with Drew Mestemaker in one of the Big 12's most explosive passing attacks. Even with defenses paying increasing attention to Oklahoma State's passing game, Young continues to find ways to produce. He narrowly missed his third 100-yard game of the season and remains one of the Cowboys' most dependable fantasy options thanks to his

news.summary: Williams had five receptions (on 11 targets) for 54 yards during Saturday's 27-24 loss versus Utah.
news.details: Williams had double-digit targets in his fourth straight game Saturday, though he had just 54 yards, his lowest total since Week 1. It was not a bad performance by any means and his scorching pace did need to slow down at some point. He still remains a great option for Saturday's game at Oklahoma State.

news.summary: Hawkins logged 17 carries for 68 yards and gathered in 7 of 8 targets for 125 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 35-32 defeat versus Houston.
news.details: Hawkins' receiving total was the highest of his career and nearly set a school record for receiving yards by a Cowboys running back. When Houston took away the ground game, Oklahoma State simply featured Hawkins through the air, and he responded with his best fantasy outing of the season. The ability to produce regardless of game script or defensive approach significantly raises both his floor and ceiling moving forward. At this point, Hawkins isn't just a volume-based running back. He's becomin

news.summary: Coleman gathered in 3 of 5 targets for 77 yards during Saturday's 35-32 loss versus Houston.
news.details: Coleman continued his steady emergence, setting a new season high with 77 receiving yards. While he remains behind the Cowboys' top receiving options in target share, Coleman has now delivered consecutive encouraging performances and continues to prove this offense can support multiple fantasy-relevant pass catchers.

news.summary: Knight had 13 carries for 23 yards and one touchdown and caught 3 of 4 targets for six yards during Saturday's 17-7 win against Wisconsin.
news.details: Wisconsin was the first team to marginalize Wayne Knight this season, though the elite back managed a touchdown. While the game showed that Knight isn't matchup-proof, he's well set up for a good night against Northwestern in Week 8.

news.summary: Jones (undisclosed) is unavailable for Saturday's clash with Cincinnati, per the Big 12 availability report.
news.details: Jones will miss his second straight game as he continues to deal with an undisclosed injury. His next chance to suit up is next Saturday versus Arizona.

news.summary: Komolafe recorded 15 rushes for 67 yards and one touchdown and hauled in 4 of 5 targets for 51 yards during Saturday's 24-21 victory versus Michigan State.
news.details: Komolafe scored on a 10-yard scamper in the second quarter, giving the Wildcats a 10-7 lead at the time. The 5-foot-11 running back went on to lead the way for the Wildcats with 67 rushing yards on the day while accounting for a season-high four receptions for 51 yards through the air as well. He will hope to keep the positive momentum rolling as the Wildcats host Rutgers on Saturday.

news.summary: Ia is available for Saturday's game at Kansas, per the Big 12 availability report.
news.details: Ia, who was listed as probable heading into Saturday, is officially off the injury report and available Saturday. Ia has caught two passes for 19 yards and a touchdown through two appearances this season.

news.summary: Brown (undisclosed) is not listed on the injury report for Saturday's game against Mississippi State.
news.details: Brown did not take the field in Week 6 against Kentucky, raising concerns about whether he sustained an injury, but he has cleared LSU's initial injury report ahead of Saturday. The wideout has recorded eight receptions for 89 yards across five appearances this season.

news.summary: Walsh has been given a questionable status for Saturday's game versus Iowa, per the Big Ten availability report.
news.details: Walsh has logged multiple targets in three of Minnesota's six games this season, giving the Gophers an occasionally relied-on option at tight end. Inconsistency aside, he has been their top TE this season.

news.summary: Cobb had eight carries for 58 yards with 2 catches for no yards in Saturday's 21-15 win over Vanderbilt.
news.details: Cobb continues to see little work as Byrum Brown has been the overwhelming feature in the Auburn offense. Brown out carried Cobb 10 to eight however Cobb was able to average a stellar 7.3 yards per carry. Cobb continues to be a bit of a touchdown dependent option at running back due to the offensive play style Auburn has chosen to go with.

news.summary: Warren hauled in 2 of 3 targets for 43 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 31-28 win against Louisville.
news.details: Warren, a senior from Picayune, Miss., has carved out a nice role for himself in the past two games, totaling five grabs for 79 yards and the touchdown. With WR JoJo Trader (lower body) going down against the Cardinals, he and Victor Snow could be fighting for targets if the team is without Trader against Wake Forest on Saturday.

news.summary: Davidson posted 13 rushes for 59 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 37-0 victory against Charleston Southern.
news.details: Davidson was limited to under 60 yards and has been held to a total of 84 rushing yards in the past two weeks. Still, he's also scored a touchdown each of the Tigers' last four games. He remains the clear top option in the Clemson ground game, even if his production has fluctuated along with the Tigers' offensive performances.

news.summary: Beebe (undisclosed) posted 18 rushes for 122 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 47-15 win against Rutgers.
news.details: Beebe took the field Saturday after being deemed a game-time decision prior to kickoff. The running back logged his second straight game with over 100 rushing yards and a score, extending his scoring streak to three contests by punching in a one-yard touchdown in the fourth quarter. Beebe should continue splitting carries with Turbo Richard as he has logged double-digit touches in all five games this season.

news.summary: Henderson (undisclosed) is available for the Buffaloes' clash with Texas Tech in Week 5.
news.details: Henderson was deemed probable, and indeed, the tailback is good to go against the Red Raiders. The tailback has been a rotational member of the Buffaloes' backfield with 24 carries for 111 yards this season.

news.summary: Clough (undisclosed) is good to go for Saturday's clash with Georgia Tech, per the ACC availability report.
news.details: Clough is set to make his return Saturday, and he should be one of the go-to options on offense in Boston College's passing game since he recorded six catches on 10 targets for 50 yards in his first two appearances of the season. This will be his first appearance since Week 2.

news.summary: Eka totaled eight rushes for 59 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 63-7 victory against Dixie State.
news.details: Eka, a true freshman, played his first collegiate game Saturday and it went very well. He scored his first career touchdown and led the team in rushing yards and attempts. Those stats are a bit misleading though, as he played with the second team offense once the game was already out of hand. He likely won't get many opportunities moving forward barring a massive blowout.

news.summary: Cook tallied 15 rushes for 40 yards and reeled in 2 of 3 targets for 41 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 45-42 win over Cincinnati.
news.details: Cook has already established himself as West Virginia's workhorse on the ground, but he delivered in a new way during the Mountaineers' dramatic win. Cook caught a 40-yard touchdown pass from Michael Hawkins in the fourth quarter, making his first receiving touchdown of the season and tying the game during West Virginia's late comeback. While the rushing efficiency wasn't eye-popping against a Cincinnati defense that focused heavily on slowing the run game, Cook's involvement as a receiver highl

news.summary: Hayes completed 20 of 27 passes for 249 yards and three touchdowns during Saturday's 38-17 win against Rice. He also had five rushes for three yards.
news.details: Hayes led the offense to score 31 unanswered points to secure Tulsa's fourth win and first conference victory of the season. The quarterback threw three touchdowns for the second time this year, posting his most efficient performance by completing 20 of 27 passes (74.1 percent). Since returning from injury in Week 5, his last three games have been productive, totaling 728 passing yards and seven scores with zero turnovers. He will look to keep rolling Saturday at Navy.

news.summary: Moore (undisclosed) is listed as probable ahead of Saturday's matchup against Oklahoma State.
news.details: Moore will most likely play Saturday against the Cowboys despite battling an undisclosed injury. The Texas transfer has 23 catches for 312 yards and two touchdowns.

news.summary: Cyrus caught all two targets for 30 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 38-19 victory versus Florida.
news.details: Cyrus found the end zone on a 21-yard reception in the fourth quarter for his first touchdown of the season, although his involvement remained limited to two catches as the LaNorris Sellers spread the ball around. He will hope to earn more opportunities for the team's next meeting with the Vols on Oct. 24.

news.summary: Hiter posted 11 rushes for 62 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 52-17 victory against UTEP.
news.details: Hiter provided the best game of his young career on Saturday, logging a season-high 62 yards to go along with a pair of touchdowns, his first and second as a Wolverine. The 5-foot-11 freshman found the end zone on runs of six and eight yards in the second and third quarters, respectively, helping build an insurmountable Michigan lead following a shaky start to the day. Hiter's performance showed his ability as a young, dynamic runner, but while he sits behind Jordan Marshall on the depth chart,

news.summary: Kontosis (undisclosed) is off the injury report ahead of Saturday's game against Arizona.
news.details: Kontosis had been dealing with an undisclosed injury that clouded his availability for this week but was recently upgraded to probable and now appears on track to play. The sophomore wide receiver has reeled in four receptions for 33 yards across four appearances this season.
