news.summary: Williams (undisclosed) hauled in his only target for 16 yards during Saturday's 29-7 defeat against Texas Tech.
news.details: Williams was a game-time decision for Saturday's contest and ended up suiting up after a one-game absence. The tight end got involved in the passing game, though the Buffaloes' offense was quiet in a low-scoring effort. Through four games, he has recorded four receptions for 54 yards and one touchdown.

news.summary: Neider (undisclosed) has been deemed probable for Saturday's clash with TCU, per the Big 12 availability report.
news.details: Neider will likely take the field Saturday, barring any setbacks. The wideout has recorded at least one catch in six of his seven appearances this season. He will look to extend his reception streak against TCU.

news.summary: Cuono (undisclosed) is good to for Saturday's matchup versus Rutgers, per the Big 10 availability report.
news.details: Cuono is officially set to suit up for Saturday's matchup despite having previously been listed as questionable. He has only carried the ball 11 times for 45 yards across two games this season and should continue to serve a limited role against the Scarlet Knights.

news.summary: Bray caught 2 of 5 targets for 22 yards during Saturday's 41-24 loss against Oklahoma State.
news.details: Bray took a back seat statistically, finishing with just two catches in a game where West Virginia's rushing attack dominated the play calling. The lack of production is more a reflection of the offensive game plan than a change in role, as the Mountaineers ran the ball 66 times and generated most of their offense on the ground. As the passing volume inevitably rises in other matchups, Bray should have better opportunities to make an impact.

news.summary: Swint (undisclosed) will be unavailable for Saturday's game versus BYU, per the Big 12 availability report.
news.details: Swint will sit out his first contest of the season as he deals with an undisclosed issue. He serves as the third option in the backfield, so Duke Watson and Landen Chambers are still expected to handle their normal workload.

news.summary: Overby (knee) has been ruled out for the rest of the season, per the team's game notes.
news.details: Overby will miss the remainder of the season as he deals with a serious knee injury he suffered in Week 6. He finishes the season with 10 catches (on 20 targets) for 212 yards and one touchdown.

news.summary: Adeyi posted two rushes for 20 yards and one touchdown and reeled in his only target for three yards during Saturday's 35-32 loss against Houston.
news.details: Adeyi made the most of his opportunities, punching in a 13-yard touchdown in the third quarter for his first rushing score as a Cowboy. While Caleb Hawkins remains the centerpiece of the backfield, Adeyi's touchdown was a notable milestone.

news.summary: Woods compiled eight rushes for 39 yards and one touchdown and gathered in their only target for 13 yards during Saturday's 17-7 victory over Wisconsin.
news.details: Woods recorded his fifth touchdown of the season in the hard-fought win, but Wisconsin neutralized UCLA's rushing yardage. Woods' numbers usually lag behind Wayne Knight's, but both backs struggled in Week 7.

news.summary: Pickett posted one reception (on six targets) for four yards during Saturday's 35-24 loss to Kansas State.
news.details: Pickett still saw involvement in the game plan with six targets, but the production was limited as Kansas relied more heavily on Isaiah Marshall's rushing ability. A six-target workload suggests Pickett is still a featured piece of the passing game, making this performance look more like a difficult matchup than a sign of a reduced role.

news.summary: Solomon had three receptions (on four targets) for 55 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 62-7 win over William & Mary.
news.details: Solomon still isn't a big part of this passing game, but in a huge blowout against a willy overmatched FCS foe, the second-year wideout got involved and found the end zone for his first career touchdown.

news.summary: Sellers completed 23 of 35 passes for 279 yards and four touchdowns during Saturday's 38-19 win over Florida. He also had 14 rushes for 20 yards with one touchdown.
news.details: Sellers delivered his most productive passing performance of the season, accounting for five total touchdowns without committing a turnover. He connected with four different receivers for scores while completing 65.7 percent of his throws. After an inconsistent start to the season, the redshirt junior quarterback will look to build on this productive outing against Tennessee on Oct. 24.

news.summary: Simmons logged one reception (on two targets) for 27 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 49-14 victory versus Sam Houston State.
news.details: Simmons found the end zone against Sam Houston, this time catching a touchdown from backup QB Tommy Castellanos late in the game. Despite recording just two catches on three targets through four games, Simmons has turned both receptions into scores, making him one of the Big 12's most efficient fantasy producers on a per-touch basis. The touchdown rate is unlikely to be sustainable, but his ability to earn scoring opportunities keeps him on the radar in deeper formats.

news.summary: Hunter (knee) is listed as out ahead of Saturday's matchup against Iowa State.
news.details: After missing last week's matchup with a knee injury, Hunter will miss his second consecutive game on Saturday against the Cyclones. The wide receiver has 13 catches for 155 yards and one touchdown this season. The senior will have a chance to return to action next week against Texas Tech.

news.summary: Dailey is not set to start Saturday but is still expected to see time Saturday at Miami, Matt Zenitz of CBSSports.com reports.
news.details: Dailey, who started last week, is set to cede the starting gig to Holden Geriner for the matchup versus the No. 1 team in the country. Dailey struggled in his first start, completing less than 50 percent of his passes and throwing two interceptions versus Boston College. Still, the true freshman is expected to see time versus the Hurricanes as Pittsburgh continues to search for the replacement for Mason Heintschel (knee) who is out for the season.

news.summary: Middlebrook totaled 14 rushes for 59 yards and caught 3 of 4 targets for 19 yards during Saturday's 23-13 defeat versus Southern Methodist.
news.details: Middlebrook continues to lead the backfield, and he averaged a respectable 4.2 yards per attempt, while showing soft hands catching the ball out of the backfield, too. He has averaged 4.9 yards per rushing attempt this season, and he has two more receptions in four of the past five outings.

news.summary: Purcell caught 3 of 4 targets for 102 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 39-31 defeat versus UNLV.
news.details: Purcell had just three catches for 23 yards prior to his explosion against UNLV. The tight end has a target in each game he's played this season, but the freshman tight end burst onto the scene Saturday in Vegas. He'll look to stay productive in Week 6 against Virginia Tech.

news.summary: Pimpton gathered in his only target for eight yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 17-6 victory over Baylor.
news.details: Pimpton's score was already his third touchdown of the season despite totaling just eight receptions on the year. While the week-to-week volume remains difficult to trust, PImpton continues to prove that he doesn't need many touches to make a fantasy impact.

news.summary: Wells gathered in 5 of 10 targets for 74 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 34-26 loss versus Navy.
news.details: Wells recorded the wildest touchdown of Week 6, hauling in a 10-yard touchdown pass from fellow wideout Omari Singleton. Finding no room to run on a designed wide receiver pass, Singleton threw a desperate heave toward Wells, and the receiver batted the ball into the air before reeling it in and being tackled into the end zone. Outside of the highlight touchdown, the wideout broke loose for a season-long 53-yard gain in the second half. Wells has now recorded three touchdown receptions over his

news.summary: Jackson posted three receptions for 41 yards with a touchdown during Saturday's 21-14 victory against Boston College.
news.details: Jackson had the only receiving touchdown of the game, as big plays through the air were a rarity in a game featuring rain and whipping winds up to gale force. Jackson will look to carry over the momentum in Friday's game at Lane Stadium against Pittsburgh, as ACC play continues.

news.summary: Brown logged nine rushes for 90 yards and gathered in their only target for seven yards during Saturday's 20-17 loss versus Georgia.
news.details: It was clear in this one that Brown was the primary running back that Alabama wanted to feature in the rushing attack. Brown saw more of the action in typical rushing downs while Daniel Hill got more of the work in passing downs. Brown did a fantastic job springing several runs for big gains as he racked up 90 yards of just nine totes.

news.summary: Bruhn (undisclosed) logged 78 snaps during Saturday's 55-0 win against Middle Tennessee State.
news.details: Even though Bruhn was not targeted a single time Saturday, that can be attributed to an unfortunate set of circumstances for the tight end, as Kansas opted to give the ball to many of his teammates instead despite his many snaps against Middle Tennessee State. The tight end will look for his next yard and touchdown in future games, and if he logs both, they will become his updated career highs.

news.summary: Singleton hauled in 7 of 9 targets for 87 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 38-17 win against Rice.
news.details: Singleton was targeted eight or more times for his fourth consecutive game Saturday, recording a team-high seven receptions for 87 yards. The wideout found the end zone late in the second quarter, hauling in an eight-yard pass before halftime. He continues to serve as a reliable target in Tulsa's passing attack after transferring from West Virginia during the offseason. Momentum is high, and he will aim to replicate his performance against Navy in Week 8.

news.summary: Conti (undisclosed) holds a questionable tag for Friday's game versus Wyoming, per the Mountain West availability report.
news.details: Conti is uncertain for Friday after rushing for a season-high 103 yards in Week 7. The running back has the coming days to recover and potentially be removed from the injury report. If he is sidelined, Kemper Hodges could see an expanded workload in the backfield.

news.summary: Latimer accrued four rushes for 14 yards and one touchdown and caught all two targets for 38 yards during Saturday's 45-42 victory over Cincinnati.
news.details: Latimer continued to make the most of his limited opportunities, punching in a three-yard touchdown in the fourth quarter. The score gives Latimer touchdowns in back-to-back games, a development for a reserve back who has become a reliable change-of-pace option behind Cam Cook. While the workload remains modest, Latimer's recent touchdown streak has helped him carve out a niche role in one of the Big 12's most explosive offenses. As long as West Virginia continues generating scoring chances at t

news.summary: McCoy (undisclosed) is out for Friday's game at Stanford.
news.details: McCoy will miss a game for the third time this season, as he was also absent in Week 3 and Week 4. The freshman tailback has seven carries for 78 yards and a score this season, so his absence shouldn't matter too much from a fantasy perspective.

news.summary: Perry (undisclosed) has been ruled out for Saturday's clash with Oklahoma State, per the Big 12 availability report.
news.details: Perry is set to miss his second straight game due to an undisclosed injury. The wideout has served as a depth option in his first season with Colorado, recording only four receptions for 21 yards across five games. He will aim to return against Kansas State in Week 9.

news.summary: Dickens (knee) is expected to miss the remainder of the 2026 season, per Matt Zenitz of CBSSports.com.
news.details: Dickens will miss the rest of the season due to a knee injury suffered during last week's matchup against Pitt. The 5-foot-10 running back had previously totaled 293 yards and four touchdowns on 4.5 YPC on the ground while accounting for 12 receptions for 114 yards and a score through the air as well.

news.summary: Brown had eight carries for 47 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 27-24 defeat to Florida.
news.details: Brown averaged 5.9 yards-per-carry, opening the scoring with a 32-yard touchdown run on Texas' first possession. After scoring in two of his last three outings, the senior running back will look to build on this performance when they host Ole Miss next week.

news.summary: Gibson reeled in all two targets for 36 yards and two touchdowns during Friday's 59-3 win versus Norfolk State.
news.details: Gibson's team-best 36 receiving yards weren't terribly impressive, and he was one of just four players with at least two receptions. The Hoos mostly kept it on the ground in the lopsided affair against the Spiders of the FCS. Gibson cashed both of his receptions in for touchdowns, though, which was nice for fantasy managers. He'll look to carry over the momentum into Saturday's game against West Virginia, and there likely will be more opportunities and targets.

news.summary: Russell was 19-for-29 passing for 147 yards and two interceptions during Saturday's 26-10 loss against Tennessee. He also had 11 rushes for six yards with one touchdown.
news.details: Russell struggled mightily against Tennessee as the Alabama offensive line got dominated. Russell had his worst game to this point of the season as he had his first game without a passing since week one against ECU and followed up his previous low from last week of 185 yards passing. To make matters worse Russell also threw two interceptions. Russell did put together a few nice runs, which the yardage from were all pretty much nullified by sacks however, he was able to scramble for Alabama's lon

news.summary: Hammond was 18-for-26 passing for 232 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 53-25 victory over Arizona State. He also had six rushes for 25 yards with one touchdown.
news.details: Hammond once again delivered an efficient fantasy performance while Texas Tech's rushing attack stole most of the headlines. The junior quarterback directed an offense that scored 43 first-half points and piled up 502 total yards, continuing to show why Texas Tech remains one of the most dangerous teams in the Big 12. Hammond's passing numbers weren't as gaudy as some of his previous outings because Texas Tech dominated on the ground, but his dual-threat ability helped maintain a strong fantasy

news.summary: Mack recorded 13 rushes for 154 yards and two touchdowns and reeled in their only target for negative three yards during Saturday's 30-12 victory versus Hawaii.
news.details: Mack exploded into relevance Saturday, leading the Sun Devils' backfield and doing so to great success. He scores a pair of rushing touchdowns, including a 67-yard burst in the third quarter, and had over double the number of touches as Kyson Brown. The true freshman made a statement in this victory, and while Brown is still assumed to be the starter moving forward, Mack should still see a decent amount of touches after this explosive day.

news.summary: Saleapaga (undisclosed) is not listed on the injury report ahead of Saturday's game at TCU, per the Big 12 availability report.
news.details: Saleapaga didn't suit up against Colorado State in Week 3, but following BYU's bye week, it appears he is ready to take the field once again. The tight end has hauled in three receptions for 28 yards across two games this season.

news.summary: Jones accrued 12 rushes for 77 yards and one touchdown and caught their only target for eight yards during Saturday's 38-17 victory versus Rice.
news.details: Jones contributed to Tulsa's 31 unanswered points, breaking loose for a 45-yard touchdown in the fourth quarter to mark his first score since Week 2. That rush helped add to his team-leading 77 yards on the ground, while his 12 attempts represented a season high. His performance is a positive step toward sharing carries with starter Damari Alston moving forward.

news.summary: McMillan caught 5 of 6 targets for 55 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 35-24 defeat versus Kansas State.
news.details: McMillan remained one of the few bright spots for Kansas, hauling in a first-quarter touchdown against Kansas State. The score gives McMillan touchdowns in back-to-back games and four receiving touchdowns on the season, continuing his emergence as Isaiah Marshall's most dangerous scoring threat in the passing game. As the Jayhawks search for their first Big 12 win, McMillan's growing touchdown production and consistent involvement continue to make him one of the more reliable fantasy options on

news.summary: Mundell notched two rushes for 30 yards and reeled in their only target for 11 yards during Saturday's 20-17 win versus Tulane.
news.details: Mundell has experienced inconsistency on a week-to-week basis, finishing Saturday's contest with three touches for 41 total yards. The running back is still searching for the production he displayed in Week 1 against Bryant, having fallen short of 50 rushing yards in every outing since. He did contribute in the passing game once again, serving as one of three pass catchers to record a reception.

news.summary: Campbell compiled one reception (on two targets) for 48 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 52-21 win versus Weber State.
news.details: Campbell only had one catch in Saturday's win, but it was a 48-yard touchdown reception in the first quarter. He didn't play much in the close Week 1 win over Georgia Tech, so Cambell's time on the field and production is likely because of the FCS opponent. He likely will return to being a non-factor Saturday at Northwestern.

news.summary: Eget was 24-for-38 passing for 249 yards, one touchdown and one interception during Saturday's 24-20 defeat against North Carolina.
news.details: Eget was solid if not spectacular as Duke fell in a rivalry clash with North Carolina. He's now surpassed 245 passing yards in each of his last two outing, which is a promising sign given that he averaged 180.3 passing yards per game across the first four games of the season. Regardless, this Duke passing attack remains rather unreliable for fantasy purposes.

news.summary: Toney posted 11 receptions (on 12 targets) for 154 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 43-35 overtime win against Florida State.
news.details: Toney exploded against the Seminoles in a shootout, nail-biting victory that was quite conducive to fantasy production. Toney has been tremendous as a receiver all year, and Miami is starting to get the superstar involved on the ground too; he has three carries for 50 yards across the last two weeks.

news.summary: Brown (undisclosed) is off the injury report ahead of Saturday's contest at Alabama, per the SEC availability report.
news.details: Brown will suit up for Saturday's game after being listed as probable in South Carolina's initial injury report. The tight end has caught four passes for 19 yards this season.

news.summary: Nwawuihe (undisclosed) totaled 11 carries for 56 yards during Saturday's 56-24 win over Florida Atlantic.
news.details: Nwawuihe returned to action after missing two consecutive games for Army. The running back logged double-digit carries for the third time this season. Nwawuihe paced the backfield with the most rushing attempts on the team outside of quarterback Cale Hellums, who logged 25. Across four games, he has recorded 48 attempts for 220 yards and two touchdowns.

news.summary: Penson compiled five receptions (on six targets) for 86 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 34-24 defeat versus Virginia Tech.
news.details: Penson had his best game of 2026 to date, tallying his most yards and scoring his first touchdown. The wideout has at least three catches for 50 yards in every game but one this fall, but he hasn't been extraordinarily productive otherwise in a hot and cold Georgia Tech passing attack.

news.summary: MacIntyre is expected to start under center for Tennessee against South Carolina on Saturday, per Matt Zenitz of CBSSports.com.
news.details: MacIntyre drew the start against Alabama last week, even with Faizon Brandon healthy after dealing with a shoulder injury. He is in line to man the helm under center for his third consecutive game for Tennessee. As the starter, he has not performed well, completing 39 of 60 passes for 444 yards, one touchdown and three interceptions, but he has defeated two ranked teams.

news.summary: Craver (undisclosed) is listed as questionable ahead of Saturday's matchup against Alabama.
news.details: After missing last week's game with an undisclosed injury, Craver is in jeopardy of missing his second consecutive game against the Crimson Tide on Saturday. The wide receiver has 24 receptions for 241 yards and two touchdowns in six games.

news.summary: Hawkins notched nine rushes for 42 yards and reeled in 1 of 2 targets for negative one yard during Saturday's 34-24 win over Georgia Tech.
news.details: Hawkins averaged a healthy 4.7 yards per carry, and he has served as a pretty solid complementary option to Jeffrey Overton Jr. He has at least eight carries in each of his seven games, and he has averaged a respectable 4.1 yards per carry. As long as Overton remains healthy, his fantasy ceiling is rather limited, but he has proven he can do the job if his number is called.

news.summary: Robinson tallied two receptions for 65 yards during Saturday's 34-27 win versus Georgia Tech.
news.details: Robinson's day was highlighted by a 61-yard reception, which was the longest play from scrimmage from any player on either side. The freshman from Mansfield, Texas showed he can do the job when his number is called. With Nico Brown, Caden High and Robinson, the Cardinal have an impressive trio of receivers to build around.

news.summary: Lewis gathered in 2 of 3 targets for 31 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 41-24 victory over West Virginia.
news.details: Lewis scored for the second consecutive game, hauling in a touchdown as part of Oklahoma's second-half offensive explosion. The interesting wrinkle is that Lewis has managed to score in back-to-back weeks despite seeing just five combined targets during that span, highlighting both his efficiency and reliance on finding the end zone. Until the target volume increases, he'll remain more touchdown-dependent than some of his teammates, but it's hard to ignore a player who keeps producing when calle

news.summary: Howell is questionable for Saturday's contest versus Tennessee, per the SEC availability report.
news.details: Howell popped up on Thursday's injury report with a questionable tag, putting his status for Saturday up in the air. He has 18 carries for 104 yards this season, though he's unlikely to play a large role Saturday regardless of his injury.

news.summary: Welch (hand) is listed as out prior to Saturday's game against Oklahoma State.
news.details: Welch will miss his first game of the season on Saturday against the Cowboys due to a hand injury. The running back suffered the injury during last week's matchup against Utah. The junior has 43 rushes for 220 yards and two touchdowns this year.

news.summary: Jackson logged one carry for two yards and one touchdown and gathered in 1 of 2 targets for 12 yards during Saturday's 31-14 defeat to Ohio State.
news.details: Jackson was limited to just a single carry on a day in which the Hawkeyes were held to just 39 yards on the ground on a putrid 1.9 YPC. Jackson's one attempt did produce a two-yard touchdown, Iowa's only score on the day. The 5-foot-11 sophomore will be hoping for a more expanded workload when the Hawkeyes travel to face Washington on Friday.

news.summary: Nagy (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's matchup against Kansas State.
news.details: After playing in just one snap last week, Nagy has no injury designation ahead of Saturday's affair with the Wildcats. The wide receiver has six catches for 101 yards and two touchdowns this year.

news.summary: Taylor compiled three rushes for 22 yards and one touchdown and gathered in all two targets for 21 yards during Saturday's 27-24 defeat to Utah.
news.details: Taylor scored his first touchdown of the season Saturday, an 18-yard run in the third quarter to take the surprising lead. It was one of only three carries he had in the game though which makes him a difficult player to even roster in fantasy. The Buffaloes' rushing attack is both split and not very effective, leaving Taylor as an unreliable fantasy player.

news.summary: Barnes was limited to seven snaps during Saturday's 35-32 loss to Houston.
news.details: Barnes struggled against Houston's secondary, with his biggest error coming on a route where he slipped, causing Drew Mestemaker to throw his only turnover of the contest. After the mishap, he rarely saw any action on offense, per Marshall Scott of Pistols Firing. His role in the receiving corps could potentially be reduced moving forward in a competitive wide receiver group that features Wyatt Young, Miles Coleman and others.

news.summary: Holman notched 14 carries for 80 yards and caught all three targets for 17 yards during Saturday's 41-23 victory against Northern Illinois.
news.details: With Samuel Harris (undisclosed) unavailable, Holman stepped up as Wyoming's top running back. The senior was productive, averaging 5.7 yards per carry while reaching the 80-yard mark for the third time this year. Through seven games, Holman's totaled 402 rushing yards and three touchdowns on 72 carries. He's added another 100 yards on 14 receptions.

news.summary: Coenen gathered in 3 of 8 targets for 34 yards and a touchdown during Saturday's 21-13 win over Northern Colorado.
news.details: Coenen stepped up as Tyler Hughes' go-to option Saturday, leading the team in targets while hauling in a 15-yard touchdown that put the Cowboys ahead 14-13 in the fourth quarter. After totaling just five receptions for 99 yards and a score last season, the senior Coenen looks poised for a significant step forward in 2026.

news.summary: Perry (undisclosed) is listed as questionable for Saturday's clash with SMU, per the ACC availability report.
news.details: Perry has been a regular target in games, with Weeks 6 and 7 marking the only times the wide receiver has not been sought for a pass. The wide receiver was limited in Week 6, did not play in Week 7 and hopes to break the recent downslide in Week 8.

news.summary: Jennings was 23-for-36 passing for 246 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 23-13 victory over Virginia. He also had four rushes for 26 yards.
news.details: Jennings had a subpar outing in terms of passing yardage, and this time it was due to a suffocating defense by UVA as opposed to ugly weather the weekend before against Boston College. The good news is that Jennings has cut down his miscues lately, and he has at least two passing touchdowns in three in a row, and five of six games to date.

news.summary: Frazier totaled 15 rushes for 101 yards and hauled in their only target for four yards during Saturday's 31-3 victory against Missouri.
news.details: Frazier had a career day as he went for over 100 yards for the first time. The sophomore running back has now recorded at least 70 rushing yards in consecutive games. Frazier's increased involvement in the offense alongside Kewan Lacy is an encouraging development after the two backs combined for 223 yards on against Missouri.

news.summary: Holman (undisclosed) will suit up for Friday's matchup versus Air Force, per the Mountain West availability report.
news.details: Holman has been cleared to play Friday, and he'll add some much-needed depth to Wyoming's receiving corps. He has just three catches for 29 yards this season, however, so he's not expected to carry a massive role across the board.

news.summary: Hoffman warmed up with the starters ahead of Saturday's game versus Oklahoma, Clayton Sayfie of On3.com reports.
news.details: Hoffman, who had one catch on three targets in the season opener, warmed up with the starting offense ahead of Saturday's massive clash. He's in this role at least in part due to Hogan Hansen's (undisclosed) injury. Hoffman should have some opportunities to make an impact versus the Sooners.

news.summary: McNeil totaled 12 rushes for 111 yards and two touchdowns and gathered in 3 of 4 targets for 37 yards during Saturday's 55-0 win against Northern Iowa.
news.details: While he split carries with the rest of the Iowa backfield in the absence of Kamari Moulton and L.J. Phillips, McNeil showed his dynamic ability in Saturday's rout of FCS Northern Iowa. The 5-foot-11 running back ranf or 111 yards and a pair of touchdowns against UNI, crossing the goalline from two and 62 yards out in the first and fourth quarter, respectively. While his performance on Saturday was impressive, his opportunities may dwindle once Moulton and/or Phillips are able to return.

news.summary: Bachmeier completed 23 of 36 passes for 224 yards, one touchdown and one interception during Saturday's 28-24 win against Notre Dame. He also had 13 rushes for 45 yards with two touchdowns and caught another touchdown.
news.details: Bachmeier led the Cougars to one of the biggest wins in school history on Saturday. He led the game-winning drive in the fourth quarter capped off by a six-yard touchdown pass to Walker Lyons. It was one of four touchdowns he accounted for as he joined rare company to throw, run and catch a touchdown in the same game. Now ranked No. 2 in the country, Bachmeier faces a more favorable matchup Saturday at UCF.

news.summary: Gause compiled seven rushes for 11 yards and gathered in 5 of 7 targets for 31 yards during Saturday's 38-14 loss versus Wake Forest.
news.details: Gause made the start with Duke Scott unavailable due to injury, but he averaged just 1.6 yards per carry. As Wake built a significant lead early in the second half, State got away from the run, so Gause never really was afforded a chance to get untracked. He did have five receptions, showing some soft hands out of the backfield, however. If Scott remains on the shelf, Gause should get the start again at Stanford next time out on Oct. 23.

news.summary: Scott (foot) will miss Friday's game versus Stanford, per the ACC availability report.
news.details: This is a huge blow for the Wolfpack, as Scott is the primary option in the backfield. He's racked up 358 rushing yards and four touchdowns this fall, but if he can't go, expect Davion Gause to take on a heavier workload as the RB1 in Scott's absence.

news.summary: Reescano notched 11 carries for 44 yards and one touchdown and reeled in their only target for 10 yards during Saturday's 52-31 win versus West Virginia.
news.details: Reescano scored in his second straight game Saturday, an eight-yard rush early in the second half. He saw his carries nearly cut in half compared to Week 5 though as the Wildcats' offense often scored quickly on their drives. He's still the team's clear top back, but with a season-high of 57 rushing yards so far, his ceiling is not very high.

news.summary: Twitty totaled 46 yards on four receptions during Saturday's 38-27 loss versus West Virginia.
news.details: Twitty had been a bit quiet through the first four games, so perhaps this modest performance will provide a springboard going forward. He jelled nicely with Beau Pribula, and the two will look to keep building rapport against Delaware next Saturday.

news.summary: Morris compiled nine carries for 33 yards and caught their only target for two yards during Saturday's 20-17 loss against Texas.
news.details: Morris remained involved alongside DeSean Bishop, but both struggled to find running room against a strong Longhorns defense. The sophomore running back will work to bounce back in the team's next meeting against Auburn.

news.summary: Johnson (undisclosed) is not on the injury report and will play against Georgia on Saturday.
news.details: Johnson may miss his first game of the campaign on Saturday against the Bulldogs due to an undisclosed injury. The tight end has seven catches for 43 yards in five games.

news.summary: Mabson compiled 15 carries for 108 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 43-8 victory against Southern Miss.
news.details: Mabson led the Tigers in rushing on Saturday as Auburn had no problems taking care of Southern Miss. The Tigers looked content to limit the workload of starting running back Jeremiah Cobb leading to extended work for Mabson. Mabson made the most of it with a solid day. With SEC play coming up next week expect to see Mabson's usage dwindle slightly.

news.summary: Clements (undisclosed) is no longer listed ahead of Saturday's game versus Utah, per the Big 12 availability report.
news.details: Clements has been cleared to play. However, his availability doesn't mean he's going to put up big numbers. The tight end has played in all five games for the Buffaloes, recording two receptions for 16 yards on three targets.

news.summary: Bethel-Roman (personal) will be in uniform for Saturday's contest versus Alabama, per the SEC availability report.
news.details: In the first half of Texas A&M's 2026 season, Bethel-Roman logged multiple targets four times across six games. Despite having zero touchdowns to his name, the wide receiver recorded seven receptions for 56 yards.

news.summary: Hill notched four rushes for 15 yards and reeled in 3 of 4 targets for 24 yards during Saturday's 20-17 defeat to Georgia.
news.details: Hill didn't see much work in the running game against Georgia and was used a bit more in the passing attack. Hill has been Alabama's best pass blocker out of the backfield and was certainly more utilized in that regard against the Bulldogs. Hill saw much of the rushing work go to Trae'shawn Brown and EJ Crowell.

news.summary: Poloskey (undisclosed) logged 40 snaps in Saturday's 20-17 win over Tulane.
news.details: Poloskey failed to draw a target Saturday, but his presence on the field is a positive sign considering he held a questionable tag heading into the matchup. The tight end was utilized primarily in pass-blocking situations, which figures to remain his main role in the offense moving forward. Through six games this season, Poloskey has recorded three receptions for 28 yards and one touchdown on four targets.

news.summary: Lyle (not injury related) logged six rushes for 16 yards during Saturday's 52-3 win against Central Michigan.
news.details: Lyle will look to enter October with a clean slate after facing driving charges this past month. 2026 marks the running back's third year with Miami, and if 2025 is any indication, the U will look to make use of his versatile skill set in the backfield and as a pass-catching option. Last season, for each game the junior was active, he logged at least three carries. Across six matchups, Lyle also recorded a target all but twice.

news.summary: Morrow notched eight rushes for 54 yards and three touchdowns and caught their only target for seven yards during Saturday's 41-0 victory versus Citadel.
news.details: Morrow averaged 6.8 yards-per-carry and found the end zone in three different occasions before halftime. The sophomore ball-carrier will aim to build on this performance for next Saturday's road matchup against Alabama.

news.summary: Ford (undisclosed) is considered probable for Friday's matchup versus North Carolina State, per the ACC availability report.
news.details: Ford is slated to suit up Friday and lead Stanford's backfield given his probable designation. The running back has been dominant on the ground through seven games, notching 114 carries for 529 yards and eight touchdowns.

news.summary: Houston (undisclosed) is listed as questionable ahead of Saturday's matchup against the Wildcats.
news.details: Houston may miss his second consecutive game against Northwestern on Saturday with an undisclosed injury. The wide receiver has 15 catches for 169 yards in five games.

news.summary: Marshall was 12-for-26 passing for 151 yards, one touchdown and one interception during Saturday's 35-24 defeat against Kansas State. He also had 14 rushes for 117 yards.
news.details: Marshall's passing production was more modest than it had been in recent weeks, but he still delivered with his legs for fantasy managers with his second 100-yard rushing performance of the season. While the Jayhawks struggled to sustain offense after their fast start and Marshall threw a costly fourth-quarter interception, his dual-threat ability once again kept him fantasy relevant. The rushing production has become a major part of his value, giving him a dependable floor even when the passing

news.summary: Dieffenbach was 22-for-33 passing for 264 yards and one interception during Saturday's 17-7 win against Wisconsin. He also had six rushes for -12 yards.
news.details: Dieffenbach's insertion into the starting role is actually a boon for UCLA's receivers, as he is more of a traditional passer than Nico Iamaleava (OFS), and he should provide great balance for the offense moving forward.

news.summary: Courtney (undisclosed) is unlikely to play Friday against Duke, per the ACC availability report.
news.details: Courtney looks slated to sit out his second consecutive game for the Cavs, leaving the wide receiver room down some talent with Rico Flores (knee) also out. The junior will likely wait one more week to add to his 18 grabs for 204 yards and a pair of scores, though he hasn't officially been ruled out.

news.summary: Salley (undisclosed) is good to go for Saturday's game versus Arizona State, per the Big 12 availability report.
news.details: There was initial concern about Salley's availability for Saturday after he exited last week's matchup against Kansas, but he has cleared Kansas State's initial injury report and is slated to suit up. The wideout has reeled in 13 receptions for 248 yards and one touchdown across three appearances.

news.summary: Marshall notched 14 rushes for 49 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 21-18 victory over Penn State.
news.details: Marshall scored on a one-yard plunge in the third quarter, giving the Wolverines a 14-3 lead at the time. While his numbers remain unspectacular, the 5-foot-10 junior has been remarkably consistent this season, running for between 40 and 59 yards in all but one game while scoring four total touchdowns in six contests. A home matchup against the defending national champs could serve as a tougher matchup on Saturday.

news.summary: Manning faces competition at quarterback from Karle Lacey, who is expected to get more first-team practice reps this week, Pete Thamel of ESPN reports.
news.details: The development follows Manning's recent output, as his struggles began with a bad performance at Tennessee in Week 4, when he logged more interceptions (one) than touchdowns during a close win. He was not so lucky in Texas' subsequent games, where UT was upset not only by longtime rival Oklahoma but also by Florida,  the latter at home. Manning struggled in both games, throwing critical interceptions at Norman and failing to log multiple touchdowns against the Gators. Lacey receiving first-team

news.summary: Hellums was 1-for-2 passing for two yards during Saturday's 56-24 victory against Florida Atlantic. He also had 25 rushes for 195 yards with five touchdowns.
news.details: Hellums continues to shine on the ground, falling five yards short of topping the 200-yard mark for a second consecutive contest. After a career performance against Tulane in Week 6, he raised the bar by reaching the end zone five times to set a new career-high. Florida Atlantic's defense had no answer for the quarterback or Army's rushing attack, as the Black Knights accumulated 479 yards on the ground. He handled a team-high 25 carries, surpassing 20 rushing attempts for the third time this se

news.summary: Medders completed 2 of 3 passes for 18 yards during Saturday's 41-31 victory over UNLV. He also had 18 rushes for 152 yards with three touchdowns.
news.details: In two games since taking over under center for the Falcons, Medders has rushed for 266 yards and five touchdowns on 34 attempts in back-to-back Air Force wins. The sophomore will look to keep things rolling next week in a road matchup against Wyoming.

news.summary: Bishop recorded 32 rushes for 159 yards and two touchdowns and caught all three targets for 16 yards during Saturday's 26-10 victory versus Alabama.
news.details: Bishop averaged 5.0 yards-per-carry while scoring twice in the second half, helping Tennessee pull away on the scoreboard. The junior running back has now accumulated 517 rushing yards and six touchdowns over his last three games and will look to extend his impressive streak against South Carolina next week.

news.summary: Coleman accrued four rushes for 18 yards and hauled in 2 of 3 targets for 14 yards during Saturday's 41-34 loss versus Mississippi State.
news.details: Coleman remained involved behind Fuller but failed to score for the first time this season. His efficiency remained solid at 4.5 yards-per-carry, though Matthew Fuller's larger workload continues to cap his volume. The redshirt freshman running back will work to earn more opportunities for next week's game against Alabama.

news.summary: Epps compiled eight receptions (on 10 targets) for 163 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 45-42 win against Cincinnati.
news.details: Epps' performance was a welcome response after a frustrating outing the previous week and highlighted the upside that comes with catching passes from Michael Hawkins. While Prince Strachan generated headlines with his breakout performance, Epps quickly reasserted himself as a focal point of the passing attack with a season-high 10 targets and delivered his most productive game in several weeks. For fantasy managers, the biggest takeaway is that the zero-catch game now looks like an anomaly rathe

news.summary: Alston tallied 12 carries for 52 yards and one touchdown and caught 1 of 2 targets for 26 yards during Saturday's 38-17 win versus Rice.
news.details: Alston was more efficient on the ground Saturday after being bottled up by Navy in Week 6. The running back scored the first touchdown of the day for Tulsa, punching in a four-yard carry to bring his season total to six scores. He was outpaced by fellow tailback Trequan Jones (12-77-1), who has seemingly put himself back into the conversation for split reps alongside him.

news.summary: Murph recorded two receptions (on four targets) for 32 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 38-19 win against Florida.
news.details: Murph made his limited opportunities count, scoring on a 26-yard strike from quarterback LaNorris Sellers in the third quarter, marking his first touchdown since the season-opener. The sophomore wide receiver will hope to earn more opportunities for the team's meeting against Tennessee on Oct. 24.

news.summary: Allen posted 19 rushes for 96 yards and a touchdown during Saturday's 41-31 victory over UNLV.
news.details: Allen has now rushed for 196 yards and three touchdowns in his last two contests after totaling just 138 yards and no scores on 43 carries in his first four games this year. Allen, who led Air Force with 19 carries Saturday, will likely lead the backfield again next week on the road against Wyoming.

news.summary: Wright compiled two receptions (on three targets) for 122 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 27-21 win over Pittsburgh.
news.details: Wright had a 69-yard touchdown catch on a deep ball and his other reception went for 53 yards. Those were his first receptions since Week 4, and while it was a nice breakout game for the receiver, Wright has yet to prove he can be a consistent factor for this offense.

news.summary: Edwards compiled 16 rushes for 57 yards and one touchdown and reeled in all two targets for 28 yards during Saturday's 35-24 defeat against Kansas State.
news.details: Edwards made his mark, scoring a third-quarter touchdown against his former team and briefly putting Kansas back in front. While the Jayhawks couldn't hold the lead, Edwards once again showed his ability to deliver in big moments and remained one of the focal points of the offense. The overall rushing numbers weren't overwhelming, but finding the end zone was a notable achievement.

news.summary: Augustave accrued three rushes for 61 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 45-9 victory against Towson.
news.details: Augustave received very little volume but made one of his three opportunities count with a 55-yard touchdown run. He has now scored in each of South Carolina's first two games despite operating as part of a crowded backfield and could earn more opportunities during next week's game against the Bulldogs.

news.summary: Sheppard had 20 carries for 77 yards and gathered in 11 of 12 targets for 98 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 24-20 defeat against North Carolina.
news.details: Sheppard was contained to 77 yards on the ground, but he once again surpassed 90 receiving yards for the second straight week and caught a touchdown as well. The tailback totaled 33 touches; the Blue Devils' offense runs through him week in and week out, and his recent uptick in involvement through the air is quite encouraging for fantasy managers.

news.summary: Emory (undisclosed) is not on the injury report ahead of Saturday's matchup with SMU.
news.details: After suffering an undisclosed injury last week against Wake Forest, Emory is cleared to play on Saturday against the Mustangs. The running back has 59 carries for 205 yards and four touchdowns this season.

news.summary: Long (undisclosed) caught 2 of 3 targets for 55 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 38-32 loss to North Dakota State.
news.details: Long, who was listed as questionable ahead of Saturday's game against NDSU, logged 55 yards and a touchdown in the losing effort. The 5-foot-10 junior wideout will look to help the Falcons get back on track in Week 4 against Nevada, following their bye.

news.summary: Roberts notched seven rushes for 63 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 52-31 victory over West Virginia.
news.details: Roberts scored his second touchdown of the season Saturday, a 30-yard rush in the fourth quarter. He had a season-high seven rushing attempts and reached 60 yards in his second straight game. He's been very effective with his limited touches this season, but he won't be a reliable fantasy option unless he can earn more work.

news.summary: Williams totaled six carries for 151 yards and three touchdowns and gathered in 2 of 3 targets for 16 yards during Saturday's 55-0 victory versus Northern Iowa.
news.details: In the absence of both Kamari Moulton and L.J. Phillips, the Hawkeyes spread out rushing attempts on the day, and Williams certainly made the most of his opportunities. Though the 5-foot-10 running back saw just six rushing attempts on the day, he led the team in yards while ripping off a trio of touchdowns and averaging a ridiculous 25.2 YPC. Williams found the end zone on runs of 48, 16 and 37 yards in the first, second and third quarters, respectively, extending the insurmountable Iowa lead.

news.summary: Wade (undisclosed) will be available for Saturday's game versus Oklahoma State, per the Big 12 availability report.
news.details: Wade played minimally last week versus Houston due to the injury and hasn't lived up to expectations to date after posting 43 catches for 523 yards and five touchdowns a season ago. He'll aim to get back on track Saturday, and there should be plenty of plays run against an uptempo Cowboys squad.

news.summary: Hodges tallied six carries for 24 yards and a touchdown during Saturday's 38-32 defeat to North Dakota State.
news.details: Hodges was questionable coming into Saturday's contest, but the senior would ultimately suit up and log his second touchdown in two games this season. Overall, Hodges has logged 12 carries for 96 yards to start the year in a crowded Air Force backfield.

news.summary: Rogers finished with two catches for nine yards and a touchdown in Saturday's 38-27 loss to West Virginia.
news.details: Rogers was seeing his first action of the season, and he did a good job finding the end zone. However, as long as Dakota Twitty remains healthy, Rogers' role in the offense will be rather limited.

news.summary: Sagapolutele is expected to start under center for California against SMU on Saturday, per Matt Zenitz of CBSSports.com.
news.details: Sagapolutele was available for last week's contest against Wake Forest after clearing concussion protocol, but he did not start under center, as backup Jackson Brousseau earned the nod to begin the game. Eventually, the primary signal-caller took over in the second half and is slated to reclaim his starting job. The team was presumably easing him back into live action. Across six games, Sagapolutele has thrown for 1,290 yards, nine touchdowns and five interceptions.

news.summary: Himon posted seven carries for 27 yards and caught 1 of 2 targets for 11 yards during Saturday's 24-21 victory over Michigan State.
news.details: It was a forgettable day for Himon as he finished with just 38 total yards on eight touches against the Spartans. The 5-foot-9 senior was largely held in check on the day as the Wildcats totaled 134 yards on just 3.2 YPC on the ground in East Lansing. Himon will hope for better days moving forward, starting with a home matchup against Rutgers on Saturday.

news.summary: Knighten tallied six carries for 84 yards and one touchdown and hauled in their only target for zero yards during Saturday's 55-19 win versus Arizona State.
news.details: Knighten scored a 75-yard rushing touchdown in the third quarter Saturday, giving his team a commanding 45-16 lead. It marked his second touchdown of the season and his first since Week 2. He's seen his carries decrease every week since Week 2 and had a season-low six versus Arizona State, but that's in part due to the blowout and how much success the passing game was having.

news.summary: DeBlanc (toe) is ready to rock for Friday's game versus Air Force, per the Mountain West availability report.
news.details: DeBlanc is available after he missed Wyoming's last two games. The wideout has five catches for 49 yards on six targets this season, so he's not slated to have a big impact on offense for Wyoming.

news.summary: Smothers (upper body) is not expected to play Saturday versus Mississippi, per the SEC availability report.
news.details: Smothers is now considered doubtful for Saturday's important contest, a massive blow for the Longhorns' rushing attack. Assuming he misses the game, Raleek Brown is set to lead the backfield in the must-win game.

news.summary: Jacobs reeled in all two targets for 38 yards and one touchdown during Thursday's 77-7 victory over Florida A&M.
news.details: Jacobs failed to reel in his lone target at Stanford in the opener, but the wideout managed to catch each of the passes thrown his way against Florida A&M, and also hit pay dirt for the first time in 2026. The South Carolina transfer may not be the biggest factor in this passing game, but it was good to see him make an impact even in a laugher.

news.summary: Brown had seven rushes for 19 yards and reeled in 0 of 2 targets for zero yards during Saturday's 38-7 loss to Florida State.
news.details: Brown went nowhere fast in the run game, going for just 2.7 yards per attempt. That was the theme of the day for Virginia, as it was snowed under by a suddenly ferocious Florida State defense. There should be a lot more running room for Brown and friends against Syracuse on Saturday night in Charlottesville.

news.summary: Skeete was limited to just one snap in Friday's game against Rutgers, according to Kevin J. Stone of On3.com.
news.details: Head coach Bill O'Brien says the team will play the guys who practice the best and are "ready to go" when asked why Skeete only played one snap. As such, it remains to be seen how much he'll be involved -- if at all -- when the Eagles take on Maine in a Week 3 matchup on Sept. 19.

news.summary: Claiborne hauled in 3 of 4 targets for 31 yards during Friday's 24-10 defeat versus Brigham Young.
news.details: Claiborne led Iowa State with 31 receiving yards, but the Cyclones' passing game never found traction against a defense that held them to just 200 total yards. With Iowa State heading into a bye week, there's little fantasy takeaway here beyond how thoroughly BYU disrupted the offense.

news.summary: Hoover was 20-for-40 passing for 296 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 19-15 loss versus Ohio State.
news.details: Hoover threw for a season-high 296 yards on a day in which he attempted 40 passes, the first time he's surpasses 30 pass attempts this season. The 6-foot-2 senior connected with receiver Nick Marsh on a 19-yard scoring strike in the fourth quarter and was mere inches away from a game-winning touchdown as Marsh couldn't get his feet inbounds for another score in the closing sequence of the game. A road matchup against Michigan awaits on Saturday.

news.summary: Scott (undisclosed) is no longer listed ahead of Saturday's game versus Baylor, per the Big 12 availability report.
news.details: Scott will be available for the Horned Frogs after carrying a probable designation earlier this week. The 6-foot-3 junior wideout has been heavily involved after transferring in from South Alabama, totaling 13 receptions for 183 yards and a touchdown across five games. Scott, who was limited to just a handful of snaps in Week 5, will look to get back on track against Baylor.

news.summary: Mohammed (undisclosed) won't be available for Saturday's game versus SMU, per the ACC availability report.
news.details: Mohammed will miss a third straight game, and his absence represents a huge blow for California's backfield. His next chance to suit up will come against NC State on Saturday, Oct. 31.

news.summary: Hecklinski will start for Iowa at Minnesota in Week 8, per On3.
news.details: Hecklinski was listed as a co-starter with Hank Brown earlier in the week after the former had a stellar performance against Washington, tossing for 202 yards and three touchdowns on 14-of-19 passing. Now, Iowa will officially roll with Hecklinski against the Gophers, switching things up in its quarterback room. He'll look to build on the strong performance in Seattle.

news.summary: Lonergan was 23-for-35 passing for 291 yards, three touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 37-30 victory over Maryland. He also had five rushes for 18 yards.
news.details: Lonergan posted one of his best totals of the season in the upset. Rutgers' offensive line kept Lonergan upright, and he took advantage of the lack of pressure to maximize his connection with KJ Duff.

news.summary: Turner (undisclosed) is likely to play in Saturday's clash with Miami, per the ACC availability report.
news.details: Turner is now considered probable after popping up as questionable on the team's initial report. It's great news for the Panthers as Turner has been in and out of the lineup with injuries, but he's been very effective when healthy.

news.summary: Gee (undisclosed) will miss Saturday's game versus Rice, per the American Athletic availability report.
news.details: Gee will miss his first game of the season due to undisclosed reasons as Tulsa faces off against the Owls. The 5-foot-11 sophomore has tallied nine receptions for 111 yards and one touchdown across his first six games of the season. Gee's next chance to return will come next Friday against Army, but his expected status is unclear at this time.

news.summary: Pendergrass posted 16 carries for 85 yards and hauled in 0 of 1 targets for zero yards during Saturday's 23-13 victory against Colorado.
news.details: Pendergrass got a big workload once again Saturday, taking 16 carries for 85 yards in the win. He has received 15 carries in each of the first four games of this season, a level of consistency that is difficult to find. He has not been very productive with that workload though, as he's averaging just 4.0 yards per carry and has found the endzone just once. He remains a high floor asset heading into the heart of conference play.

news.summary: Overton tallied 14 rushes for 85 yards and caught 3 of 4 targets for 29 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 34-24 victory over Georgia Tech.
news.details: Overton averaged 6.1 yards per carry, and he was able to find the end zone through the air. He has at least 12 carries in each of the past six games, while recording at least three receptions in six consecutive outings. He has pierced the end zone six times in his seven games, running for four scores while adding two touchdowns via the air.

news.summary: Smith (undisclosed) is off the injury report ahead of Saturday's contest versus Nebraska, per the Big Ten availability report.
news.details: Smith has recovered from an undisclosed issue and will return Saturday after missing last week's matchup against Notre Dame. The wideout has recorded just one reception for 10 yards this season, so he will aim to become a bigger contributor in the passing attack now that he is healthy.

news.summary: Richard notched 16 rushes for 46 yards and one touchdown and reeled in 1 of 4 targets for two yards during Saturday's 19-15 defeat to Ohio State.
news.details: Richard crossed the goal line from seven yards out in the second quarter, scoring his sixth touchdown of the season while giving the Hoosiers a 7-3 lead at the time. The 5-foot-9 running back was largely held quiet on the day against a talented Ohio State defense, totaling 46 yards on just 2.9 YPC. A road battle against Michigan awaits on Saturday.

news.summary: Fields caught 2 of 4 targets for 44 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 31-3 win versus Missouri.
news.details: Fields averaged an impressive 22 yards per reception despite just two grabs against Missouri. The veteran wideout was able to come down with a 19-yard touchdown grab  to help him bounce back from a less than stellar 19-yard performance last week against Vanderbilt. Fields demonstrated his big play potential however, his limited volume in the offense remains a concern.

news.summary: Reynolds completed 17 of 26 passes for 127 yards during Saturday's 37-0 victory against Charleston Southern. He also had seven rushes for 40 yards.
news.details: Reynolds' 127 passing yards on 4.9 yards per attempt were both low numbers despite a dominant victory over an FCS foe. Clemson got the bounce-back win after the loss to Miami, but this Tigers' passing game is extremely hard to trust for fantasy purposes at the moment.

news.summary: Pittman totaled three receptions (on four targets) for 19 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 23-13 win over Virginia.
news.details: Pittman had his fewest yardage since going for just a single 2-yard touchdown reception against UC Davis back on Sept. 12. He has scored in back-to-back games, and he has three or more receptions in four straight outings. However, the tight end's yardage continues to be somewhat limited.

news.summary: Rusk (ankle) is out for Saturday's matchup versus Iowa State, per the Big 12 availability report.
news.details: Rusk will remain out Saturday and not be an option at tight end for Arizona. An ankle injury has held him out since Week 4. Tyler Powell is slated to see more targets in the passing attack once again. He will aim to return against Texas Tech in Week 9.

news.summary: Vaughn recorded eight carries for 81 yards and reeled in their only target for six yards during Friday's 59-3 win against Norfolk State.
news.details: Vaughn spelled Xay Davis, and racked up nine total touches in the rout of the FCS opponent. Vaughn is averaging 7.0 carries for game so far through two games, and he is likely to settle into that territory for the long haul, unless an injury to Davis opens up a starting role.

news.summary: McGowan accrued two receptions (on four targets) for 34 yards during Saturday's 23-13 victory over Colorado.
news.details: McGowan, who caught two touchdowns in each of his last two appearances, came back down to earth Saturday with DJ Lagway back at quarterback. He caught two of his four targets for a modest output and was unable to find the endzone in the relatively low scoring affair. He'll look to bounce back Saturday at Arizona State.

news.summary: Brown recorded 24 rushes for 81 yards and gathered in 1 of 2 targets for seven yards during Saturday's 24-17 win versus Kansas.
news.details: Brown led the team with 24 carries Saturday in London, more carries than Cutter Boley had pass attempts. He averaged just 3.4 yards per carry though as he was unable to turn his heavy usage into a big day on the ground. Still, few players in the country have the chance at this type of utilization, so Brown remains as a high-floor running back heading into the heart of conference play.

news.summary: Calloway (undisclosed) hauled in his lone target for four yards during Saturday's 38-17 win over Rice.
news.details: Calloway suited up Saturday after missing Tulsa's previous two contests due to an undisclosed injury. The wide receiver was one of 11 pass catchers to record a reception during the contest as quarterback Baylor Haynes distributed the ball across the offense. Calloway logged 19 snaps after recording 30 or more in his first three games, so it is possible that the team is easing him back into live action.

news.summary: Strong (undisclosed) carries a questionable tag ahead of Saturday's contest versus SMU, per the ACC availability report.
news.details: A previous report indicated that head coach Tosh Lupoi is hopeful that Strong will be available Saturday, but the team listed him as questionable on the initial injury report. Still, the wideout has the coming days to recover and upgrade his status. Across six games, he has hauled in 28 receptions for 396 yards and one touchdown.

news.summary: Grayes (undisclosed) is no longer listed ahead of Saturday's game versus Wake Forest, per the ACC availability report.
news.details: Grayes is positioned to take the field Saturday despite initial concerns regarding his availability earlier in the week. The wideout has seen action through the air this season, recording 10 receptions for 121 yards and one touchdown.

news.summary: Raynor completed 16 of 29 passes for 98 yards and one touchdown during Friday's 24-10 loss against Brigham Young. He also had nine rushes for 14 yards.
news.details: Raynor and the Iowa State offense ran into a brick wall against BYU as the Cyclones were held to 200 total yards, their lowest output since 2018. A slightly encouraging takeaway is that this looked more like a dominant performance from BYU's defense than a fundamental issue with Raynor or the offense, especially after Iowa State lit up West Virginia for 45 points the previous week. With a bye in Week 7 followed by a favorable matchup against Arizona, fantasy managers should view this game as an

news.summary: Robinson hauled in 3 of 4 targets for 53 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 38-14 defeat to Wake Forest.
news.details: The junior from Fort Lauderdale saw his most extensive action since coming to Raleigh, and he scored his first collegiate touchdown on a 24-yard scoring connection from QB CJ Bailey to make it 7-7 midway through the first quarter. There weren't a lot of highlights for the Wolfpack after this point, however. Robinson will look to keep carving out a role for himself in the offense on Oct. 23 in the next game at Stanford.

news.summary: Meadows will be competing with Noah Rogers for more snaps during Saturday's game against Tennessee, Mike Rodak of 247Sports.com reports.
news.details: With Ryan Coleman-Williams (head/knee) out for this contest, fellow wide receiver Noah Rogers and Meadows could be in line for expanded roles. The sophomore wide receiver has totaled four receptions for 62 yards across two appearances.

news.summary: Cunningham (undisclosed) has been cleared ahead of Saturday's contest versus Texas, per the SEC availability report.
news.details: Cunningham, who was listed as probable on the team's initial report, has now been cleared for Saturday's contest. He caught his first career touchdown last week and he has seven catches for 111 yards across the last three games.

news.summary: Smith had 13 carries for 73 yards and reeled in 1 of 2 targets for 68 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 27-24 defeat against Utah.
news.details: Smith had the vast majority of the work in the Buffaloes backfield Saturday and made the most of the opportunity. He had 73 yards on the ground and opened up the second half with a 68-yard receiving touchdown to get his team back into the game. This performance could finally establish him as the leader in the backfield, although this backfield has been a mess all season so he's still difficult to rely on right now.

news.summary: Buie didn't play in Week 2 due to Iowa tightening its rotation against a better team, per Chad Leistikow of Hawk Central.
news.details: Buie caught two passes for 22 yards in the opener, but didn't play in Iowa's narrow win over Iowa State in Week 2. However, it wasn't due to injury; the receiver simply was squeezed out of the rotation against a Power Four opponent.

news.summary: Johnson (undisclosed) carries a questionable tag ahead of Saturday's game versus Arizona State, per the Big 12 availability report.
news.details: Johnson's availability is uncertain for Saturday after coming off a Week 7 performance against Kansas, in which he threw for 209 yards and one touchdown. The quarterback has the coming days to recover and upgrade his status, but if he is unavailable, Blake Barnett (undisclosed) or Jacob Knuth could start under center.

news.summary: Yates gathered in 2 of 5 targets for 47 yards during Friday's 35-33 victory over Virginia Tech.
news.details: Yates didn't have a lot of opportunities, but he had catches of 17 and 30 yards. Should anything happen to force Cataurus Hicks and/or Censere Lee to the shelf, Yates has proven that he has the potential to step right in and do big things.

news.summary: Gordon (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game at Arkansas, per the SEC availability report.
news.details: Gordon, who was previously considered questionable to play, is now cleared to suit up for Saturday's trip to Arkansas. The sophomore hasn't played since Week 2. He rushed 20 times for 79 yards across his two appearances this season.

news.summary: Abdullah caught all two targets for 83 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 42-3 win versus Delaware.
news.details: Abdullah put a bow on the scoring with a 74-yard scoring strike from backup QB Eli Holstein early in the fourth quarter. It was Abdullah's first offensive statistics of the season, and just the second game he has recorded a catch in his collegiate career. He was seeing snaps with the game out of hand, and he'll likely be back to a reserve role as ACC play resumes next Saturday at Florida State.

news.summary: Craig completed 21 of 36 passes for 294 yards, two touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 17-6 win against Baylor. He also had eight rushes for -12 yards.
news.details: Craig's win was certainly encouraging for fantasy managers, but his interception trend remains worth monitoring. Craig threw one against Baylor, extending his streak to four consecutive games with at least one interception. For fantasy purposes, Craig continues to trend upward thanks to his growing comfort in the passing game and TCU's improving offense. If he can start limiting the turnovers, performances like this suggest he has the potential to become a reliable spot starter down the stretch.

news.summary: Johnson (undisclosed) will be unavailable for Saturday's matchup versus Alabama, per the SEC availability report.
news.details: Johnson will sit out his third consecutive game as he deals with an undisclosed injury. The wideout has an upcoming bye week that will grant him extra time to recover and potentially return against South Carolina on Nov. 7.

news.summary: McCray totaled three receptions, 73 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 59-0 victory over Bucknell.
news.details: McCray was seeing some extra snaps with the game out of hand, and he showed the coaching staff that he is more than equal to the task if needed. The freshman has posted multiple receptions in his two appearances this season. The two touchdowns were the first of his collegiate career.

news.summary: Mestemaker was 22-for-34 passing for 365 yards, three touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 35-32 loss to Houston. He also had six rushes for 34 yards.
news.details: Mestemaker continued one of the most impressive quarterback runs in the country. The performance extended his streak to five consecutive games with at least 300 passing yards, and he nearly engineered a comeback after the Cowboys fell behind 14-3 at halftime. Mestemaker finished the game strong, throwing for 241 yards and all three of his touchdowns in the second half while repeatedly putting pressure on Houston's defense. Oklahoma State's winning streak may be over, but Mestemaker's fantasy pro

news.summary: Pringle totaled four carries for 17 yards and one touchdown and caught all two targets for 35 yards during Thursday's 77-7 victory over Florida A&M.
news.details: Pringle hasn't been much of a factor for the Hurricanes through two easy wins to kick off the 2026 campaign, but in Week 2, he scored a touchdown on the ground and got involved as a receiver. Pringle won't be viable fantasy-wise week in and week out, but Week 2 was an encouraging performance for the second-year tailback.

news.summary: Lagg (undisclosed) will miss Saturday's matchup against Miami.
news.details: Lagg will miss his fourth consecutive game on Saturday against the Hurricanes due to an undisclosed injury. In four games, the tight end has recorded seven catches for 76 yards and one touchdown.

news.summary: Leavitt completed 31 of 38 passes for 289 yards and four touchdowns during Saturday's 31-0 victory versus Mississippi State.
news.details: Leavitt had an impressive performance against the Bulldogs, completing 81.6% of his passes for 288 yards and four touchdowns while avoiding an interception for the first time on the season. Leavitt has now accounted for multiple touchdowns in six consecutive games. The dual threat and high performance ability continues to make him a great option week-in and week-out despite the turnover issues.

news.summary: Denman (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game against UCF, per the Big 12 availability report.
news.details: Denman has seemingly recovered from an undisclosed injury and will take the field for the Horned Frogs on Saturday. The running back should be involved in the backfield after combining for 60 yards and two touchdowns on 14 attempts through the team's first two games.

news.summary: Hendricks gathered in 8 of 11 targets for 54 yards during Saturday's 41-7 loss versus Wake Forest.
news.details: Hendricks tied his season-high in targets with 11 and caught eight of the balls thrown his way, but he was limited to 54 yards. He remains a staple of this passing game, but it's a passing game that's currently stuck in the mud and can't settle on a quarterback.

news.summary: Pettaway accrued four rushes for 12 yards and caught all three targets for 27 yards during Saturday's 55-7 win over Bowling Green.
news.details: Pettaway made his biggest impact against his former team on special teams, returning a kickoff 100 yards for a touchdown in the blowout win. He also chipped in as both a runner and receiver, continuing to showcase his versatility. For fantasy managers, the challenge is that his offensive workload remains limited. However, his ability to contribute to multiple phases of the game keep him intriguing in formats that reward return production.

news.summary: Lindsey completed 22 of 39 passes for 248 yards, one touchdown and one interception during Saturday's 41-13 defeat against Purdue.
news.details: Lindsey had a moderate showing against the Boilermakers, throwing for 248 yards and a touchdown to go along with an interception on a day in which the Minnesota defense gave up over 300 rushing yards and were thoroughly beaten by Purdue. The 6-foot-5 signal caller connected with receiver Jalen Smith on a 42-yard scoring strike in the third quarter, bringing the Golden Gophers within 14 at the time. He will hope for better days moving forward, with his next opportunity coming against Iowa followi

news.summary: Cooper is expected to play in Saturday's contest versus Mississippi, per the SEC availability report.
news.details: Cooper is set to be available for Saturday after being listed as probable on Thursday's availability report. With Hollywood Smothers (upper body) doubtful, Cooper's return to the field is important for the Longhorns. He's set to back up Raleek Brown assuming he's available.

news.summary: Mizell (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game at Maryland.
news.details: Now that Mizell is healthy, he will look to log his first reception since transferring from Florida. The wide receiver has logged a target for UCLA, but he failed to catch the targeted pass back in Week 2 against San Diego State.

news.summary: Maddox had 12 carries for 96 yards and one touchdown and hauled in all three targets for 16 yards during Saturday's 34-24 loss versus Virginia Tech.
news.details: With Justice Haynes and Malachi Hosley both out with undisclosed injuries, Maddox got to lead the way in the Yellow Jackets' backfield. He made the most of his extended opportunity, surpassing 100 yards and scoring a touchdown for the third straight week. Maddox may have earned himself a steady role in this offense even if the two aforementioned tailbacks do return.

news.summary: Dupree recorded 12 rushes for 68 yards and one touchdown and gathered in 0 of 1 targets for zero yards during Saturday's 55-0 win against Middle Tennessee State.
news.details: Dupree took advantage of extended second-half work in Kansas' blowout of Middle Tennessee, punching in a fourth-quarter touchdown as the Jayhawks emptied the bench. With Dylan Edwards firmly atop the depth chart, Dupree's fantasy value remains tied to complementary touches and scoring opportunities.

news.summary: Payne (ankle) holds a questionable designation for Saturday's contest versus Texas Tech, per the Big 12 availability report.
news.details: Payne suffered an ankle injury in last week's contest against West Virginia, and his status is now uncertain for Saturday. The running back has been solid across six games this season, recording 418 yards and two touchdowns on 69 attempts. If he is unable to recover in the coming days, expect Cole Tabb to see additional carries.

news.summary: Hawkins was 25-for-33 passing for 464 yards and three touchdowns during Saturday's 45-42 victory over Cincinnati. He also had 26 rushes for 77 yards with two touchdowns.
news.details: Hawkins is doing things that few quarterbacks in college fantasy football can match. He erupted for a career-high 464 passing yards while leading the Mountaineers to a walk-off victory. What's most remarkable is that Hawkins continues to produce massive fantasy totals regardless of game script. Whether he's piling up rushing yards, carrying the offense through the air, or doing both in the same game, opponents simply haven't found an answer. Against Cincinnati, he completed 25 of 33 passes after

news.summary: Roche (undisclosed) is not listed on the injury report ahead of Saturday's game at Stanford, per the ACC availability report.
news.details: Roche is fully healthy after being placed on Georgia Tech's initial injury report due to an undisclosed issue. The tight end will look to add to his season totals of 12 receptions and 141 yards.

news.summary: Boley is not expected to start Saturday against Kansas State, Matt Zenitz of CBSSports.com reports.
news.details: Boley was benched at halftime in the Week 7 loss to Texas Tech, and it seems he's set to lose his starting role. Mikey Keene did a good job replacing him, completing 25 of 34 passes for 256 yards and two touchdowns in the loss to the Red Raiders. Boley has completed 61.9 percent of his passes for 1,353 yards with a 13:5 TD:INT this season.

news.summary: Berry totaled 15 carries for 125 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 63-14 victory versus McNeese State.
news.details: Berry had a very nice day against the poor opponent as he racked up his first 100-yard game of the season. Berry has been vying for more work in the backfield trying to dig into the reps of Dilin Jones. The two got almost a dead even split with Berry outpacing Jones 125 to 79 on the ground while they both managed to find the endzone.

news.summary: Farrakhan caught 7 of 8 targets for 117 yards during Saturday's 23-13 loss versus Baylor.
news.details: Farrakhan had just one target through three games heading into Saturday's contest, but that didn't stop the sophomore from shining versus Baylor. He saw an uptick in playing time with Danny Scudero (undisclosed) out and DeAndre Moore (undisclosed) injured during the game, and really was able to shine once Isaac Wilson took over the offense after halftime. While his snap count will be determined by the injuries to Scudero and Moore, Farrakhan made a serious case for more playing time, especially

news.summary: Rendina compiled seven carries for 86 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 56-24 victory over Florida Atlantic.
news.details: Rendina had not rushed for more than 30 yards in a contest prior to Saturday, but he saw increased opportunities in the lopsided blowout, recording a season-high seven carries for 86 yards. He scored his first touchdown of the season to open the second half with a 61-yard touchdown run. Rendina has been working behind Godspower Nwawuihe and Samari Howard, making the most of his limited touches this year.

news.summary: Chiles was 18-for-27 passing for 226 yards during Saturday's 24-21 victory versus Michigan State. He also had 16 rushes for 25 yards with one touchdown.
news.details: Chiles had a solid day against his former team, completing 67 percent of his passes while throwing for 226 yards. Though he was held out of the end zone through the air, the 6-foot-4 senior did manage to continue his scoring streak on the ground, converting a one-yard plunge in the fourth quarter to tie the game at 21 at the time. Chiles has now accounted for 16 total touchdowns through six games without a turnover on the season and will hope to continue building positive momentum when the Wildc

news.summary: Powell caught all five targets for 40 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 34-7 victory versus Cincinnati.
news.details: Powell caught his second touchdown of the season Saturday, a five-yard reception in the 4th quarter. He set season highs in receptions, targets and yards in the win as well as he's seen an uptick in snaps since Cole Rusk's ankle injury.

news.summary: Fortenberry had three receptions (on four targets) for 22 yards during Friday's 24-10 defeat against Brigham Young.
