news.details: Fortenberry set a season high with four targets against BYU, a notable development on a night when Iowa State struggled to generate offense. The production wasn't significant, but the increased involvement stands out for a reserve tight end in a game where passing opportunities were limited.

news.summary: Plummer (undisclosed) is not listed on the injury report for Saturday's game against Virginia Tech.
news.details: Plummer is set to take the field Saturday after missing last week's contest against Duke. The wideout has only played in two games this season, hauling in two receptions for 60 yards and two touchdowns.

news.summary: Gallagher gathered in all five targets for 26 yards during Saturday's 28-17 defeat versus Brigham Young.
news.details: Gallagher was tied for the team lead in receptions Saturday, hauling in all five of his targets from Noah Fifita. He wasn't particularly productive with that volume though, only gaining 26 yards versus a difficult BYU defense. The fact that he was looked to five times in a big game is notable though, and it could bode well for him moving forward.

news.summary: Hughes completed 16 of 19 passes for 196 yards during Saturday's 41-23 win versus Northern Illinois. He also had 12 rushes for 183 yards with four touchdowns.
news.details: It was a breakout game for the senior Hughes, who completed a season-high 84.2 percent of his passes. However, the majority of his production came on the ground, where he led the Cowboys in rushing while punching in four of Wyoming's five touchdowns. Hughes is up to 459 rushing yards on the season, with 310 coming in his last two contests. He's completed 63.2 percent of his passes this year for 1,018 yards with three touchdowns and seven interceptions across seven games.

news.summary: Burton reeled in all four targets for 76 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 31-27 win against Illinois.
news.details: Burton broke the plane in the win over Illinois, his first touchdown of the season. With nine targets over his first two games, the receiver is a definite staple of this passing attack thus far. He led the Blue Devils in receiving against Illinois and will look to stay hot in Week 3 against Stanford.

news.summary: Barnes had 13 carries for 63 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 55-7 victory against Bowling Green.
news.details: Barnes benefitted from Iowa State's comfortable lead against Bowling Green. The production was encouraging, but the increased workload appeared to be a least partially driven by the blowout nature of the game. Barnes remains firmly involved in the backfield rotation and continues to be a threat near the goal line, but Aiden Flora's breakout keeps the competition for touches very much alive.

news.summary: Barber caught all seven targets for 83 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 63-14 victory over McNeese State.
news.details: Barber saw his first week of extended work in the blowout win over McNeese State. The freshman wideout made the most of his extended use as he found the endzone twice in his first game action since the blowout win in week one over Clemson.

news.summary: Wilson completed 18 of 30 passes for 256 yards, two touchdowns and two interceptions during Saturday's 27-24 loss to Utah. He also had seven rushes for 41 yards.
news.details: Wilson made his second straight start for the Buffaloes Saturday, and while his performance was by no means perfect, he was competitive versus one of the top teams in the country. He tossed a pair of touchdowns and ran for over 40 yards, giving him a solid fantasy outing. He threw two more interceptions though, bringing him to five across the last two games, but in fairness he played arguably the two best defenses in the country. He'll look to have a cleaner outing Saturday at Oklahoma State.

news.summary: Ludwig recorded three receptions (on four targets) for 30 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 35-24 win versus Oregon State.
news.details: Ludwig caught a late eight-yard touchdown pass, providing a nice boost while filling in for an injured starter Terrance Carter. With Carter sidelined, Ludwig stepped into a larger role and made the most of it. The touchdown alone doesn't make him a must-add fantasy option, but he's worth monitoring if Carter's absence extends and Ludwig continues to see meaningful snaps in the Red Raiders' offense.

news.summary: Vines-Bright caught their only target for 74 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 53-25 loss to Texas Tech.
news.details: Vines-Bright was only targeted once Saturday, but he scored a 74-yard touchdown on that single opportunity. It marked his first touchdown of the season and just the second of his career. While Vines-Bright has been seeing a lot of the field this season, he has just seven catches for 103 yards this season, most of which came on the long score on Saturday.

news.summary: White logged three snaps during Saturday's 35-16 defeat to Houston.
news.details: White's limited offensive snaps could point to the wideout dealing with an injury, or there is a possibility his role in the passing attack may be reduced moving forward. Through five games, the wideout has hauled in 13 receptions for 78 yards and one touchdown. He will aim for more targets in Week 7 against Kansas.

news.summary: Carpenter reeled in all two targets for 39 yards during Saturday's 49-14 victory against Sam Houston State.
news.details: Carpenter saw an expanded role against Sam Houston with Terrance Carter sidelined by a shoulder injury. While he remains behind the top options in Texas Tech's passing attack, his increased usage is worth monitoring if Carter is forced to miss additional time. For now, Carpenter looks like a name to watch in deeper formats rather than a player to rush into lineups.

news.summary: Craig totaled two rushes for 44 yards and one touchdown and hauled in their only target for negative two yards during Saturday's 52-31 win against West Virginia.
news.details: Craig scored his first touchdown of the season Saturday, a 40-yard scamper late in the first half. He only had a season-low two rushing attempts though, so that play was basically all he was able to contribute in the win.

news.summary: Page III compiled seven carries for 58 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 59-0 victory versus Murray State.
news.details: Page III found the end zone against Murray State, benefitting from Oklahoma State's massive lead and the opportunity for reserves to see extended action. While the score was notable, his role remains secondary in the Cowboys' backfield hierarchy. For now, Page III is more of a depth piece than a fantasy option, though performances like this can help earn additional touches moving forward.

news.summary: Edwards tallied 13 carries for 116 yards and caught 0 of 2 targets for zero yards during Saturday's 41-0 win against Citadel.
news.details: Edwards led the Aggies in rushing, averaging an impressive 8.9 yards-per-carry. The freshman running back will hope to earn more opportunities after his first 100-yard rushing performance when Texas A&M visits Alabama next week.

news.summary: Hosley (undisclosed) is listed as out ahead of Saturday's matchup against Boston College.
news.details: Hosley will miss his fourth consecutive game on Saturday against the Eagles with an undisclosed injury. The running back has played in just three games, totaling 16 rushes for 61 yards.

news.summary: Gibson (undisclosed) is good to go for the Buffaloes' clash with Texas Tech in Week 5.
news.details: Gibson was deemed probable on prior injury reports, and the wideout is officially ready to roll against Texas Tech. The sophomore has nine total touches for 53 yards this season.

news.summary: French completed 22 of 30 passes for 389 yards and three touchdowns during Saturday's 45-42 loss to West Virginia. He also had 13 rushes for 52 yards with one touchdown.
news.details: French had his best statistical outing of the season Saturday, throwing for a season-high 389 yards and accounting for four total touchdowns. He also tied a season-high with 52 rushing yards, a number he has oddly hit exactly three times this season. He faces a much more difficult matchup Saturday versus Texas Tech.

news.summary: Jenkins was 30-for-42 passing for 265 yards, four touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 42-28 loss against Oklahoma State. He also had 10 rushes for 13 yards.
news.details: Jenkins made his fourth consecutive start Saturday and despite the loss, it was his best performance of the season. He threw four touchdown passes, three of which came in the first half, and helped his team have a fighting chance against the ranked Cowboys. He committed two turnovers though and he now has three interceptions and three lost fumbles across his fourth start. Alonza Barnett (hamstring) will take back over the offense once he's healthy, but Jenkins has proven himself to be a solid en

news.summary: Dehnicke (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's matchup versus Rutgers, per the Big Ten availability report.
news.details: Dehnicke will miss a fourth consecutive game while dealing with an undisclosed injury, and there's no return timetable for the TE. The junior has 11 catches for 208 yards across 13 targets this season, so his absence will be a noticeable one in the passing game. Alex Honig should be the go-to option at TE as long as Dehnicke remains out.

news.summary: Ferguson posted 17 carries for 119 yards and hauled in 0 of 1 targets for zero yards during Saturday's 27-21 defeat against Boston College.
news.details: Ferguson averaged 7.0 yards per rushing attempt, as he single-handedly took the team on his back trying to will it to a win. The passing game just wasn't there, though. And, Ferguson also had a costly lost fumble in the game. He split the backfield touches with La'Vell Wright, but he was far more productive. Ferguson should lead the backfield in Miami on Saturday.

news.summary: McKenzie completed 17 of 28 passes for 295 yards, two touchdowns and two interceptions during Saturday's 27-21 win over Pittsburgh. He also had eight rushes for seven yards.
news.details: McKenzie's 295 passing yards were a season high, and while he threw two interceptions for the third time this season, he also threw two touchdowns for the second straight week. McKenzie has yet to stuff the stat sheet, but he played decently well in a big win for the Eagles. He'll look to build on this momentum in Week 8 at Georgia Tech.

news.summary: Trader (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's contest versus Stanford, per the ACC availability report.
news.details: Trader was not able to recover ahead of Friday's game and will miss his second consecutive contest for North Carolina State. The wideout has served as a reliable target this season, reeling in 16 receptions for 221 yards, so expect Victor Snow and Tyran Warren to see expanded roles.

news.summary: Warren completed 27 of 39 passes for 279 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 34-7 victory against Elon.
news.details: Warren was very accurate against the FCS opponent, but he didn't have a ton of production against the overwhelmed opponent. The offense was more of a run-heavy attack, and Warren was more of a caretaker than anything else. It gets much tougher as Stanford steps back into conference play Friday with NC State visiting The Farm.

news.summary: Thomas accrued seven carries for 32 yards and one touchdown and caught their only target for four yards during Saturday's 28-10 win over San Diego State.
news.details: Jaivian Thomas was once the incumbent back for UCLA's offense, but Wayne Knight, whom Bob Chesney brought over from James Madison, has unseated him. However, Thomas still appears to have room to produce as a change-of-pace back, and he proved his worth with a supporting line in the decisive win.

news.summary: Mothershed accrued two receptions (on three targets) for 56 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 35-34 overtime loss versus Kentucky.
news.details: Mothershed hasn't seen much action on the year as he has just four total receptions all over the last two weeks. Of those four receptions, two have now gone for touchdowns.

news.summary: Wilson completed 0 of 0 passes for zero yards during Saturday's 31-28 victory over Louisville. He also had seven rushes for 27 yards with one touchdown.
news.details: Wilson won't be tasked with throwing many passes, if any, but he is super effective in Wildcat formations. The sophomore from Columbia, S.C. has managed six rushing touchdowns through five games this season, and he has at least 21 rushing yards in four of those five outings.

news.summary: Ross reeled in 7 of 10 targets for 90 yards during Saturday's 34-26 defeat versus Navy.
news.details: Ross hauled in a team-high seven receptions for 90 yards, marking the first time he has led the receiving corps this season. The wideout also served as Tulane's leading rusher, recording 36 yards on the ground on two attempts during a game in which the team totaled 98 rushing yards. Through six games, Ross has recorded 20 receptions for 212 yards and one score.

news.summary: Grover (undisclosed) is likely to play in Saturday's clash with Texas Tech, per the Big 12 availability report.
news.details: Grover should be an option in the passing attack Saturday, given his probable tag on Cincinnati's initial injury report. The tight end has hauled in 10 passes for 106 yards on 13 targets this season.

news.summary: Mallory accrued 13 rushes for 108 yards and two touchdowns and gathered in 0 of 2 targets for zero yards during Saturday's 43-35 overtime victory against Florida State.
news.details: Mallory surpassed 100 yards for the second time this season, and he scored two touchdowns as well to finish as Miami's leading rusher despite taking fewer carries than starter Mark Fletcher. Though the latter remains the firm RB1 in Coral Gables, Mallory is becoming a consistent part of this offense and has another great chance to produce next week against a reeling Pitt squad.

news.summary: Watson recorded 21 carries for 79 yards and hauled in 0 of 1 targets for zero yards during Saturday's 42-28 loss to Oklahoma State.
news.details: Watson carried the workload in the Knights' backfield Saturday, taking a season-high 21 carries for 79 yards in the loss. It was a promising sign for him to see that much work after he only commanded nine carries in last week's loss. Watson now has 483 rushing yards through six games this season and will hope to continue that pace after the bye week.

news.summary: Preston gathered in their only target for 39 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 55-0 victory over Howard.
news.details: Preston saw just a single target on the day against Howard, but he made the most of his opportunity. The 6-foot receiver hauled in a 39-yard scoring strike from quarterback Josh Hoover in the first quarter to giv ethe Hoosiers a 20-0 lead at the time. Preston joined the Hoosiers in the offseason after transferring in from Tulane and will hope to continue getting more opportunities as the season progresses. A home matchup against Western Kentucky awaits on Saturday.

news.summary: Brown recorded five receptions (on 10 targets) for 74 yards during Saturday's 17-6 defeat versus TCU.
news.details: Brown was targeted 10 times in his second straight game Saturday, this time catching five passes from DJ Lagway. He gained 74 yards, the fourth time this season he's reached at least 60 yards through the air. If he can continue to command this many targets, he'll be a valuable asset across the back half of the season.

news.summary: Cox gathered in 1 of 6 targets for 41 yards during Saturday's 41-24 loss against Utah.
news.details: Cox drew a season-high six targets against Utah, a sign that Kansas wants to keep him involved in the offense. The production still hasn't followed though, as Cox has yet to record more than two catches in a game this season, leaving fantasy managers waiting for the increased opportunity to translate into tangible results.

news.summary: Bentancur caught all two targets for 35 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 28-20 win versus North Carolina.
news.details: Bentancur had done next to nothing this fall, with two catches for a total of six yards through the first two weeks. He still only caught two passes against the Tar Heels, but one of them went for six points. Still, this passing game remains extremely unreliable heading into Week 4.

news.summary: Raymond (undisclosed) is listed as questionable prior to Saturday's matchup against Northwestern.
news.details: After averaging less than 2 yards per carry on 16 attempts last week, Raymond's status for Saturday's affair with the Wildcats is in jeopardy. The running back has 105 rushes for 498 yards and five touchdowns, along with 11 receptions for 101 yards and one touchdown this season.

news.summary: Kinsler (undisclosed) logged three snaps in Friday's win over Virginia Tech.
news.details: Kinsler was dressed and spotted in warmups before the game, so it wasn't surprising to see that he played. The wideout had a minimal role, though, and his next chance to feature more prominently will be in a home matchup against UNC in Week 6 next Saturday.

news.summary: Mini totaled five receptions (on seven targets) for 49 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 41-7 loss against Wake Forest.
news.details: Mini's five catches were a season high, and he found the end zone for the first time since Week 1. Still, this Cal offense is in complete disarray right now, and the Golden Bears can't even settle on a quarterback. Still, Mini has multiple catches in every game but one and remains at least a minor factor no matter who the Golden Bears trot out at gunslinger.

news.summary: Ward caught his only target for 32 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 52-7 win versus Tennessee-Martin.
news.details: Ward caught a 32-yard touchdown from Michael Hawkins, recording his first score of the season. The touchdown was encouraging, but it's difficult to draw major fantasy conclusions from a game where West Virginia built a massive lead and emptied the bench early. Ward remains worth monitoring, though tougher competition ahead should provide a clearer picture of his role.

news.summary: Maiava-Alaimalo (undisclosed) did not play in Saturday's 41-18 win over UNLV.
news.details: Maiava-Alaimalo, who was deemed questionable ahead of Saturday's matchup against UNLV, missed his second consecutive contest. The wideout will aim to recover and potentially suit up against Wyoming on Friday.

news.summary: Gregory gathered in 6 of 8 targets for 94 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 41-0 victory against Citadel.
news.details: Gregory led Texas A&M in receptions and receiving yards, hauling in a 37-yard touchdown from Marcel Reed in the second quarter before adding a 12-yard scoring reception from backup Brady Hart in the fourth. The freshman receiver will look to build on his breakout performance against Alabama next Saturday.

news.summary: Joyner accrued 10 carries for 63 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 29-7 win against Colorado.
news.details: Joyner put the finishing touches on Texas Tech's victory with a 30-yard touchdown run in the fourth quarter, turning a modest workload into a productive day. The 10 carries on the road matched a season-high for Joyner who remains behind Cameron Dickey and J'Koby Williams on the depth chart. Texas Tech is on a bye next week before playing Arizona State.

news.summary: Fifita was 16-for-23 passing for 341 yards, three touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 52-31 win against West Virginia.
news.details: Fifita had a strong outing Saturday, throwing for a season-high 341 yards and tossing three touchdowns for the third time this season. While he and the offense dominated the Mountaineers' defense, Fifita also threw an interception in his third straight game. He'll look to have a clean game after the bye week versus Iowa State.

news.summary: Carr will start against Indiana on Saturday, Nick Kosko of On3.com reports.
news.details: Carr took over for the struggling Bryce Underwood in Michigan's 21-18 win over Penn State in Week 7 and was effective, completing five of his seven passes and tallying 83 total yards with a rushing score. Given Underwood's struggles, Carr will get the chance to see what he can do on an extended look in Week 8.

news.summary: King (undisclosed) is questionable for Saturday's matchup versus SMU, per the ACC availability report.
news.details: King has yet to miss a game this season, but his questionable designation creates initial concerns for his availability Saturday. The wideout has hauled in 11 receptions for 108 yards and one touchdown across six contests.

news.summary: MacCormack tallied 11 rushes for 35 yards and one touchdown and caught their only target for four yards during Saturday's 27-21 victory against Pittsburgh.
news.details: MacCormack hasn't been a huge factor for the Eagles, but the tailback got his first double-digit carry outing of the week against Pittsburgh with Evan Dickens (undisclosed) knocked out of the game. The status of the latter remains to be seen, but MacCormack is certainly next in line if Dickens is forced to miss more time.

news.summary: Haynes (undisclosed) is off the injury report ahead of Saturday's matchup against Boston College.
news.details: After missing last week's matchup due to an undisclosed injury, Haynes will return to action on Saturday against the Eagles. The Michigan transfer has 87 rushes for 462 yards and five total touchdowns this season.

news.summary: Fletcher accrued 16 carries for 66 yards and one touchdown and reeled in 0 of 1 targets for zero yards during Saturday's 43-35 overtime victory versus Florida State.
news.details: Fletcher scored another touchdown, his sixth of the season, and led the way on the ground for the Hurricanes with six carries. His backfield mate, Javian Mallory, out-produced him in the shootout win over rival Florida State, but Fletcher's role in this offense is safe and he'll look to stay productive next week against Pitt.

news.summary: Patterson is questionable for Saturday's contest versus UCLA, per the Big Ten availability report.
news.details: Patterson has been the key back for the Spartans since Cam Edwards (knee) was ruled out for the year, but now he is banged up as well, leaving the backfield further devoid of its top talent. It will be worth keeping an eye on his status as the contest approaches.

news.summary: Manning tallied one reception (on seven targets) for 19 yards during Saturday's 31-26 defeat against Cincinnati.
news.details: Manning's stat line was not pretty, finishing with just one catch despite seeing seven targets. Rather than viewing this as a complete dud, fantasy managers should focus on the opportunity, especially with the Wildcats throwing 50 passes and potentially facing changes in the receiver rotation if Jaron Tibbs' injury lingers. Better days could be ahead if that level of involvement continues.

news.summary: Brown completed 15 of 26 passes for 150 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 27-24 win over Georgia. He also had 26 rushes for 115 yards with one touchdown.
news.details: Brown continues to put up moderate passing numbers but was extremely deadly with his legs in this one. The big QB went for over 100 yards on the ground for the second straight game. Brown also extended his rushing touchdown streak to four games increasing his season total to five while also tossing a touchdown.

news.summary: Smith totaled four receptions (on five targets) for 86 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 34-24 victory over Washington State.
news.details: Smith caught his first career touchdown reception Saturday, a 38-yard score in the third quarter. After receing just four targets over the first three games, Smith was targeted five times Saturday and made the most of the opportunity with 86 yards, the second most on the team. His increase in workload early into his freshman campaign is very promising, but it's too early to tell if it will translate consistently into Big 12 play.

news.summary: Gage logged six rushes for 110 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 63-14 victory versus McNeese State.
news.details: Gage hasn't seen much action on the year as his six carries against McNeese State brought his season total to 21 carries. Gage made the most of the work though as he cashed in for two touchdowns.

news.summary: Strachan hauled in all three targets for 84 yards during Saturday's 45-42 win over Cincinnati.
news.details: Strachan may not have matched the massive yardage totals posted by DJ Epps, but he played a pivotal role in the dramatic win. His biggest contributions came on the game-winning drive. With West Virginia backed up at its own 1-yard line and needing a score, Michael Hawkins connected with Strachan for gains of 41 and 40 yards, flipping field position and setting up Jack Cassidy's walk-off field goal. While Epps remains the top target in terms of volume, Strachan continues to prove he can impact ga

news.summary: Crowell (lower leg) holds a questionable designation for Saturday's clash with Texas A&M, per the SEC availability report.
news.details: Crowell has a chance to suit up Saturday despite exiting last week's contest against Tennessee with a lower-leg injury. A previous report noted that the running back is also expected to take part in practice this week.

news.summary: Kubecka (undisclosed) won't be available for Saturday's game versus Baylor, per the Big 12 availability report.
news.details: Kubecka is set to miss a second straight game due to an undisclosed injury, and it remains to be seen when he'll be able to return to action. His next chance to suit up will come against TCU on Saturday, Oct. 31. With Kubecka out, expect Nahzae Cox to see more targets in the passing game.

news.summary: Wilson logged seven receptions (on eight targets) for 39 yards and a touchdown during Friday's 16-13 overtime win against San Jose State.
news.details: Wilson led the Cowboys in receptions Friday and brought in a game-tying, eight-yard touchdown grab in the fourth quarter, the first of his collegiate career. Wilson's had a steady role in Wyoming's passing game through six games this season, totaling 19 receptions (on 32 targets) for 197 yards.

news.summary: Mendoza was 29-for-38 passing for 335 yards, two touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 34-24 defeat versus Virginia Tech. He also had six rushes for -37 yards.
news.details: Mendoza's 335 passing yards were a season high, and also the first time he'd surpassed 300 yards passing. His 76.3% completion rate was narrowly lower than his 76.7% from a week ago against Duke. Mendoza has been efficient, but he's not offering much as a runner (-47 rushing yards this year) and he's only scored multiple touchdowns in two of six games this fall.

news.summary: Owens logged 18 rushes for 74 yards and gathered in 2 of 3 targets for nine yards during Saturday's 31-21 loss to Kentucky.
news.details: Owens handled a season-high 18 carries and remained the clear lead option in the backfield, though he was kept out of the end zone. The senior running back will aim to get his second touchdown of the season when the Aggies face LSU next week.

news.summary: Thomas had 12 rushes for 56 yards and hauled in all two targets for 14 yards during Saturday's 20-14 victory over Michigan.
news.details: Thomas once again led the way on the ground for the Golden Gophers, outpacing fellow running back Darius Taylor while maintaining a solid level of efficiency (4.7 YPC). The 5-foot-8 junior has seen an increased level of involvement in the running game recently and has capitalized, running for 256 yards and a touchdown on an impressive 7.1 YPC over his last three games. Taylor did manage to find the end zone twice against the Wolverines and was instrumental in the victory, but Thomas should conti

news.summary: Brown gathered in 10 of 11 targets for 76 yards during Saturday's 41-13 loss versus Miami (FL).
news.details: Brown had been limited by a disappointing Clemson passing game so far in 2026, but he finally had a solid performance, notching his first double-digit reception day in the loss to Miami. Quarterback Tait Reynolds looked his way 11 times, which is a big deal considering he had 12 total targets through the first four weeks. He'll look to remain heavily involved in the passing game in Week 6 against Charleston Southern.

news.summary: Fuller compiled 10 carries for 52 yards and gathered in 2 of 3 targets for 19 yards during Saturday's 38-19 victory over Florida.
news.details: Fuller led South Carolina in rushing yards, averaging 5.2 yards per carry. However, his workload was relatively modest, with Jabree Coleman handling carries and LaNorris Sellers contributing rushing attempts. This was the first game in the season in which the redshirt sophomore running back did not find the end zone and will be aiming to get back on the scoring column during the team's meeting with Tennessee on Oct. 24.

news.summary: Martin (forearm) is off the injury report ahead of Saturday's matchup against Michigan.
news.details: Martin will return to action on Saturday against the Wolverine after missing the previous six games with a forearm injury. The running back recorded 77 rushes for 506 yards and six touchdowns in 2025 for the Hoosiers.

news.summary: Nimrod had six receptions (on nine targets) for 60 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 27-24 win against Georgia.
news.details: The Auburn passing game hasn't been much to write home about this year and because of that Nimrod has been a bit inconsistent and touchdown dependent. Nimrod had a solid day against the Bulldogs as he led the team in receptions and receiving yards while also coming down with his third touchdown reception in four games.

news.summary: Moulton accrued 26 rushes for 208 yards and two touchdowns and gathered in their only target for negative two yards during Friday's 41-24 victory over Washington.
news.details: Following a 27-yard performance against Ohio State last week, Moulton bounced back in a major way, establishing a new career-high with 208 rushing yards to go along with a pair of touchdowns as the Hawkeyes dominated Washington. The 5-foot-9 running back found the end zone on runs of 56 and three yards in the first and fourth quarters, respectively, helping building the Iowa lead on the day. Moulton has been very hit-or-miss this season, running for 391 yards and four touchdowns in two games whi

news.summary: Howard posted five carries for 43 yards and one touchdown and reeled in their only target for two yards during Saturday's 56-24 victory against Florida Atlantic.
news.details: Howard saw limited carries due to the return of Godspower Nwawuihe, but he recorded his second touchdown of the season on a 30-yard rush for the first score of the game. He was one of eight different ball carriers to record an attempt in a typical Army contest that relied heavily on the ground attack, as the team compiled 479 total rushing yards. With Nwawuihe back in action, Howard's snaps moving forward are expected to decline.

news.summary: Hale reeled in all four targets for 60 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 23-13 victory against Virginia.
news.details: The receiving yardage total was his highest since dropping 70 yards at Florida State in the opener back on Sept. 7. The touchdown was his first since he had a touchdown at home against Ole Miss in his freshman season for Alabama on Sept. 23, 2023.

news.summary: Bailey completed 28 of 39 passes for 241 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 38-14 loss to Wake Forest. He also had 13 rushes for zero yards.
news.details: Bailey didn't do a bad job with accuracy, but with Duke Scott sidelined due to injury, there wasn't much running game to speak of. So, that placed a lot of pressure on the shoulders of Bailey. He also had 13 of the team's 24 rushes, but he ended up with exactly zero yards on the ground. He'll look for better results at Stanford on Oct. 23.

news.summary: Wright posted 15 rushes for 52 yards during Saturday's 27-21 loss versus Boston College.
news.details: Wright and Damon Ferguson Jr. split the carries, with the latter far more productive with 7.0 yards per carry to just 3.5 yards per carry for Wright. Wright will likely still get his chance at touches, but his fantasy ceiling is rather limited as long as Ferguson is healthy and productive.

news.summary: Thevenin (undisclosed) logged 17 carries for 109 yards and one touchdown and caught all two targets for 24 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 37-30 win against Maryland.
news.details: Thevenin was seen warming up prior to kickoff Saturday and ultimately suited up for Rutgers. The running back produced his best performance of the season, surpassing 100 yards on the ground for the first time while notching a rushing and receiving score. He also outpaced fellow running back Antwan Raymond (16-29-1). Thevenin should continue to split carries with Raymond moving forward and will aim to build on his momentum against Northwestern in Week 8.

news.summary: Eligon (lower body) played in 17 snaps in Week 5 against Penn State.
news.details: Eligon returned to action after missing NU's last three games. The wideout should remain a valuable part of Northwestern's passing attack even if he wasn't involved much in this Week 5 win, as he didn't record a single catch in the Wildcats' 34-13 victory.

news.summary: Mensah was 23-for-34 passing for 326 yards, three touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 43-35 overtime victory versus Florida State.
news.details: Mensah finally looked mortal in Miami's win over Clemson two weeks ago, but after the bye, he returned to form, throwing another three touchdowns in the wild win over Florida State. He did throw his first interception of the season, but Mensah remains one of the most productive quarterbacks in the sport this season and that should remain the case moving forward. Next up for Miami is Pittsburgh at home.

news.summary: Perry accrued five carries for 76 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 62-10 victory against Western Carolina.
news.details: Perry scored a 40-yard rushing touchdown in the third quarter Saturday, his first score of the season. He was one of four backs with at least five carries against the FCS opponent, all of whom scored a touchdown. Perry appears to be the No. 2 back behind Gi'Bran Payne, but that should become more clear once the Bearcats start playing conference opponents.

news.summary: Raphael logged 22 carries for 124 yards and reeled in 1 of 2 targets for four yards during Saturday's 23-13 victory over Virginia.
news.details: While Raphael saw his four-game touchdown scoring streak come to a close, he was able to record just his second 100-yard rushing performance. He has been entrusted with 22 or more carries in three of the past four games, and he is a fantasy stud as long as he keeps up that kind of usage.

news.summary: Payne has been given a questionable status for Saturday's clash with West Virginia, per the Big 12 availability report.
news.details: Payne has been an absolute workhorse in the Horned Frogs' backfield, and the questionable tag suggests there's a chance he might not be available in Week 8. That would be a huge loss for TCU, as Payne has 88 carries for 429 yards and two touchdowns this season.

news.summary: Irvin recorded seven carries for 21 yards and caught all two targets for 37 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 34-7 win against Elon.
news.details: Irvin averaged just 3.0 yards per attempt, which isn't great, and he was credited with a lost fumble. He made up for it with a couple of solid receptions, including a 27-yard touchdown reception from QB Davis Warren. As long as RB Micah Ford remains healthy, Irvin's fantasy value is rather limited.

news.summary: Robinson (undisclosed) is available for Friday's game against Norfolk State, Jacquie Franciulli of 247Sports.com reports.
news.details: Robinson missed the Week 0 game against NC State, but he's back in the mix for this contest against Norfolk State. However, he's buried on the depth chart, so he's not expected to have a big role in most formats.

news.summary: Johnson recorded five carries for 26 yards and one touchdown and caught their only target for 11 yards during Saturday's 62-10 win over Western Carolina.
news.details: Johnson scored a three-yard rushing touchdown late in the second quarter Saturday, his first score of the season. He is one of four Bearcats' running backs with at least five carries in the opening two games, and while he's been solid, he's been the least productive of the four. If the backfield work consolidates -- which seems likely once the team plays better opponents -- Johnson could be left out.

news.summary: Martin posted four carries for 38 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 63-7 victory versus Grambling State.
news.details: Martin capped TCU's blowout win with a 10-yard fourth-quarter touchdown run, taking advantage of extra opportunities after the starters were pulled. The touchdown is a positive development, but it's difficult to project consistent fantasy value from a game where TCU was able to empty the bench early.

news.summary: Harris (concussion) is good to go for Friday's game versus Air Force, per the Mountain West availability report.
news.details: Harris will suit up Friday after missing last week while in concussion protocol. The running back will lead the backfield, having logged 65 carries for 326 yards and two touchdowns across six contests.

news.summary: Milivojevic (undisclosed) is listed as questionable for Saturday's matchup against UCLA.
news.details: Milivojevic is in jeopardy of missing his first game of the season against the Bruins on Saturday with an undisclosed injury. The quarterback is 121-for-185 passing with 1,263 yards, eight total touchdowns and three interceptions in seven games.

news.summary: Lagway completed 22 of 53 passes for 256 yards and one interception during Saturday's 17-6 defeat to TCU. He also had seven rushes for -17 yards.
news.details: Coming off one of the best performances of his career, Lagway struggled to get anything going versus TCU. He completed just 41.5 percent of his 53 pass attempts, his third time through four games at or below 50 percent. His inaccuracy is not only hurting his fantasy production, but it's making it very difficult for the Bears to have sustained offensive drives. He completed 63.2 percent of his passes last season with Florida, so there is hope that he can improve over the second half of the campai

news.summary: Phillips (ankle) is ready to rock for Saturday's matchup versus Minnesota, per the Big Ten availability report.
news.details: Phillips was seen as expected to play in Week 8, and the tailback will be an option in Iowa's backfield. The senior has been limited to just three games this season, notching 18 carries for 63 yards without finding the end zone. He should play a complementary role behind RB1 Kamari Moulton.

news.summary: Green (shoulder) will be in uniform for Saturday's matchup versus Virginia Tech, per the ACC availability report.
news.details: Green is no longer on Clemson's availability report, indicating that he is available for Week 8. The running back has logged multiple rushing attempts in each available game, totaling 21 carries for 88 yards.

news.summary: Martin tallied two receptions (on five targets) for 35 yards during Saturday's 23-13 defeat to Southern Methodist.
news.details: Martin ended up with a team-high 35 receiving yards, but that's not saying much. QB Beau Pribula has really fallen off in the past three games, and that's crushing the fantasy appeal of all of the pass catchers. The junior saw his three-game touchdown streak halted.

news.summary: Phifer is available for Saturday's game at Maryland, per the Big Ten availability report.
news.details: Phifer was listed as probable on Friday, so his availability is not a major surprise. The senior missed the last two games due to an undisclosed injury after receiving one target in the season opener.

news.summary: Flora notched 17 carries for 86 yards and gathered in 2 of 3 targets for negative one yard during Friday's 24-10 loss to Brigham Young.
news.details: Flora ran into a dominant BYU defense that held him in check and kept him out of the endzone. Iowa State managed just 200 total yards and generated almost no offensive rhythm, making this feel more like a testament to BYU's defensive performance than a concern about Flora's long-term outlook. With a bye in Week 7 and a favorable matchup against Arizona waiting on the other side, fantasy managers should view this as a temporary speed bump rather than a trend change for one of the Big 12's most ex

news.summary: Porter tallied three receptions (on four targets) for 62 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 55-19 win over Arizona State.
news.details: Porter caught an eight-yard touchdown pass in the third quarter Saturday, his second straight game with a score. He did well with his four targets, catching three for 62 yards in what ended up being his best performance of the season so far. He'll look to keep rolling Saturday versus TCU.

news.summary: Brame hauled in 3 of 4 targets for 87 yards during Saturday's 24-17 victory versus Arkansas. He also rushed one time for one year and a touchdown.
news.details: Brame led Tennessee in receiving yards despite catching just three passes, averaging 29.0 yards-per-reception while also finding the end zone on a 1-yard run. The performance showcased his ability to create explosive plays, although his limited reception volume remains a consideration moving forward. The sophomore tight end will hope to earn more opportunities in next week's meeting with the Crimson Tide.

news.summary: Norman caught 5 of 6 targets for 88 yards during Saturday's 41-0 win versus Citadel.
news.details: Norman finished second on the team in receiving yards, finishing with a season-high 88 yards. The sophomore wide receiver will look to maintain his involvement in the passing attack when the Aggies face Alabama on the road next Saturday.

news.summary: McFall compiled five carries for 23 yards and reeled in 3 of 4 targets for 33 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 25-16 victory versus Boston College.
news.details: McFall was the primary backup to Kendrick Raphael with Dramekco Green out. It was the second receiving touchdown of the season for McFall, and the fourth of his career. McFall's eight total touches were nice, but as long as Raphael is healthy, McFall's usage should be limited.

news.summary: Reed was 8-for-13 passing for 130 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 41-0 win versus Citadel. He also had four rushes for 23 yards.
news.details: Reed averaged 10.0 yards-per-passing attempt, connecting with wide receiver Aaron Gregory for a 37-yard touchdown in the second quarter before giving way to backup quarterback Brady Hart after halftime. The junior quarterback will look to build on his efficient outing when the Aggies travel to Alabama next Saturday.

news.summary: Hayes returned a kickoff 95 yards for a touchdown early during Saturday's 35-24 loss to Kansas State.
news.details: Hayes' return immediately answered a Wildcats touchdown and helped fuel the Jayhawks' fast start in a rivalry game that saw them jump out to a 17-7 first quarter lead. While Hayes' fantasy value remains primarily tied to return opportunities, the explosive score served as a reminder of the playmaking ability he brings whenever he gets the ball in his hands.

news.summary: Jackson accrued 27 rushes for 159 yards and one touchdown and caught their only target for 13 yards during Saturday's 35-24 win against Kansas.
news.details: Jackson operated as the clear workhorse, and it was easily his best performance of the season. He consistently moved the chains and helped Kansas State control the second half, showing the type of volume-driven upside fantasy managers have been waiting to see. If the Wildcats continue to lean on him this heavily, he'll become one of the more dependable running back options in the Big 12.

news.summary: Bibbs (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game at Oklahoma State.
news.details: Bibbs gives Central Florida capable depth in the team's receiver corps. In all but one of UCF's five games this season, he was targeted at least once on a pass attempt. The only time Bibbs wasn't, Central Florida ruled him out against TCU.

news.summary: Davis totaled seven rushes for 34 yards and hauled in all two targets for 12 yards during Saturday's 23-13 defeat against Southern Methodist.
news.details: Davis had nine total touches, to 17 total touches for Jekail Middlebrook. He has managed at least six total touches in five of seven games to date, and he has averaged 5.2 yards per rushing attempt. When his number is called, he produces, but he'll continue to take a backseat, as long as Middlebrook remains healthy.

news.summary: Grunkemeyer completed 15 of 22 passes for 250 yards and three touchdowns during Saturday's 34-24 win versus Georgia Tech. He also had 13 rushes for 25 yards with one touchdown.
news.details: Grunkemeyer had a total of four touchdowns, leading the Hokies to within one victory of bowl eligibility. He has at least 250 passing yards in five of the past six games, while accounting for multiple passing touchdowns in five of seven games. He has also scored a rushing touchdown in each of the past three outings, and five of the past six contests.

news.summary: Freeman caught 7 of 12 targets for 76 yards during Saturday's 17-6 defeat versus TCU.
news.details: Freeman saw another high target outing Saturday, commanding 12 targets for the third time this season. He has now caught seven passes in five of six games this season, making him immensely valuable in PPR formats. He'll look to keep rolling Saturday at Kansas.

news.summary: Eusebio totaled seven receptions (on 12 targets) for 89 yards during Saturday's 53-25 loss to Texas Tech.
news.details: Eusebio, who had not had a target yet this season, exploded with 12 in Saturday's blowout loss. Most of his workload came in the second half when Mikey Keene took over at quarterback, but that certainly doesn't take away from how well Eusebio played. This performance could earn him more snaps and targets over the second half of the season.

news.summary: Harris accrued two rushes for two yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 31-20 win over Tulane.
news.details: Harris scored twice against Tulane, giving him three rushing touchdowns on just 14 carries this season. Kansas State continues to trust him in short-yardage and goal-line situations, a role that has translated directly into fantasy production. The volume isn't substantial, which creates some week-to-week risk, but the touchdown usage is impossible to ignore. As long as Harris remains the preferred finisher near the end zone, he'll have fantasy value despite seeing fewer touches than other backs

news.summary: Chambliss completed 20 of 36 passes for 241 yards and three touchdowns during Saturday's 31-3 victory over Missouri. He also had four rushes for 14 yards with one touchdown.
news.details: Chambliss delivered another strong performance as he totaled 255 yards and four touchdowns against a solid Missouri defense. Despite completing just 55.6% of his passes, Chambliss extended his passing touchdown streak to 19 games and recorded his second straight game with four total touchdowns. Chambliss has now accounted for 20 total touchdowns through six games as he continues to be one of the most productive quarterbacks in the nation.

news.summary: Fields recorded eight rushes for 66 yards and one touchdown and hauled in his only target for 15 yards during Saturday's 35-24 win versus Kansas.
news.details: Fields may have taken a backseat to Joe Jackson in terms of workload, but he still turned in an effective performance against the Jayhawks. Fields opened the scoring for Kansas State and remained involved throughout the game, even as the Wildcats increasingly rode Jackson's hot hand. The emergence of Jackson as the primary ball carrier is something fantasy managers will need to monitor closely as Kansas State head deeper into conference play.

news.summary: Benetti logged two receptions (on three targets) for eight yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 45-42 victory versus West Virginia.
news.details: Benetti made his mark by catching a two-yard touchdown pass from Aiden Flora just before halftime. In an offense that produced 577 total yards and five touchdowns from Flora alone, Benetti capitalized on one of the Cyclones' scoring opportunities and remains a name to watch in deeper fantasy formats if Iowa State continues generating this level of offensive production.

news.summary: King (undisclosed) is no longer on the injury repot ahead of Saturday's game against Cincinnati.
news.details: King was questionable leading up to the matchup as he dealt with an undisclosed injury but appears to have gotten past it. The sophomore tight end has totaled two receptions for 21 yards this season.

news.summary: Pribula was 13-for-22 passing for 137 yards during Saturday's 23-13 defeat against Southern Methodist. He also had 10 rushes for 25 yards with one touchdown.
news.details: Pribula has done very little through the air lately, but he was able to find the end zone with his feet for the only touchdown for the Hoos. After a hot start, with multiple touchdowns through the air in the first four games, he has just two passing touchdowns in the past three games, while going for 168 or fewer yards.

news.summary: Richardson posted five receptions (on six targets) for 77 yards during Saturday's 41-23 victory over Northern Illinois.
news.details: Richardson emerged as quarterback Tyler Hughes' top target Saturday, with no other wideout logging more than three receptions. It's an encouraging mid-season effort for the senior Richardson, who had just eight receptions (on 18 targets) for 88 yards in his first six games this year.

news.summary: Moore hauled in all two targets for 32 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 62-7 win over William & Mary.
news.details: Moore finally hit paydirt in Week 4, catching just his second and third passes of the season. With just 10 targets through three games, he's not a huge part of this Duke passing game that tends to take a backseat to Nate Sheppard and the running game most of the time regardless.

news.summary: Lacy (undisclosed) is ready to roll for Saturday's game versus Texas, per the SEC availability report.
news.details: Lacy was probable in Wednesday's initial report, but the star tailback has been cleared to play Saturday. His presence should provide a huge boost for the Rebels' rushing attack. He has 62 carries for 352 yards and five touchdowns in five games.

news.summary: Buckley recorded 24 carries for 150 yards and two touchdowns and hauled in 0 of 1 targets for zero yards during Saturday's 21-14 win against Central Michigan.
news.details: Buckley rushed for a season-high 150 yards, marking his third game with at least 100 rushing yards this season, during Saturday's win over the Chippewas. The running back opened the scoring for the Broncos with a nine-yard run in the first quarter and followed up with a seven-yard touchdown run in the third quarter to extend the lead. The Illinois native has 102 carries for 542 yards and seven touchdowns this year.

news.summary: Veltkamp was 33-for-48 passing for 318 yards, three touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 56-24 loss against Army.
news.details: Veltkamp started the game on a rough note, throwing an interception on his first pass attempt that eventually led to an early Army touchdown. It was his first pick since Week 1 against Florida, bringing his total to three interceptions for the season. He found his rhythm on the following two offensive possessions, passing for a pair of scores. The quarterback ultimately finished with three touchdown passes, marking his second consecutive game with at least three scoring throws.

news.summary: Brooks gathered in all two targets for 43 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 38-7 win over Kent State.
news.details: Brooks reeled in his first score since Sept. 12 on Saturday against the Golden Flashes. The wide receiver scored on a 28-yard pass from Broc Lowry to extend the lead before halftime. The California native has 16 catches for 149 yards and three touchdowns this year.

news.summary: Nelson gathered in 3 of 4 targets for 39 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 49-14 victory against Monmouth.
news.details: The VMI transfer logged his first score in two years Saturday. Nelson reeled in a 23-yard pass from Broc Lowry early in the second quarter to extend the Broncos' lead.

news.summary: Parks hauled in all three targets for 55 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 38-7 win versus Kent State.
news.details: Parks recorded his first two scores of the season during Saturday's win over the Golden Flashes. The tight end caught a 42-yard pass from Broc Lowry in the first quarter to open the scoring, then caught a four-yard pass in the fourth quarter to seal the lead. The New Mexico State transfer has 10 catches for 98 yards and two touchdowns this season.

news.summary: Newell (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game against Eastern Michigan, per the MAC availability report.
news.details: Newell was questionable heading into Saturday's matchup but has cleared Toledo's injury report. Through five games, the tight end has reeled in four receptions for 36 yards and one touchdown. He will serve as the backup to Sam Lee.

news.summary: Holloway gathered in all three targets for 38 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 56-24 loss against Army.
news.details: Holloway posted his best outing of the season Saturday, notching a season-high three receptions for 38 yards. It has been difficult for the receiver to earn a significant target share in a competitive passing room while working behind the likes of Easton Messer, Kelby Vaslin and Dominique Henry. He reeled in a 19-yard touchdown in the fourth quarter for his first score of the year. Across six games, Holloway has recorded six receptions for 103 yards and one touchdown.

news.summary: Miller compiled 13 carries for 48 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 34-14 victory versus Eastern Michigan.
news.details: Despite averaging just 3.7 yards per carry on 13 attempts, Miller crossed the goal line twice during Saturday's win over the Eagles. The running back scored on a one-yard run in the second quarter and later in the quarter followed it up with a three-yard touchdown run to cement the lead. The Alabama native has 76 carries for 426 yards and seven total touchdowns this season.

news.summary: Crosby logged eight receptions (on 12 targets) for 69 yards during Saturday's 23-8 loss against Buffalo.
news.details: After being targeted 12 times, Crosby reeled in eight passes for an average of 8.6 yards per reception against the Bulls on Saturday. The wide receiver has 17 catches for 186 yards this season.

news.summary: Cabana (undisclosed) is not listed on the injury report ahead of Saturday's game against Boise State, per the MAC availability report.
news.details: Cabana will suit up Saturday, adding depth to Western Michigan's backfield as the backup to Jalen Buckley. The running back has 12 yards on 7 attempts so far this season.

news.summary: Dabbs gathered in all five targets for 66 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 34-14 victory versus Eastern Michigan.
news.details: Dabbs crossed the goal line for the first time since Sept. 26 on Saturday against the Eagles. The wide receiver opened the scoring, catching a 28-yard pass from John Alan Richter in the first quarter. The Tennessee native has 32 catches for 468 yards and five touchdowns this year.

news.summary: Walendzak notched six rushes for 38 yards during Saturday's 34-14 victory versus Eastern Michigan.
news.details: Walendzak tied his season-low in carries (six) during Saturday's win over the Eagles. The running back had previously scored at least one touchdown in each of his last six games. The Ohio native has 73 carries for 424 yards and nine total touchdowns this season.

news.summary: Mosey caught their only target for 40 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 38-24 defeat against Fresno State.
news.details: Mosey hauled in his second reception of the season and took it all the way for a 40-yard score. That ended up being the wideout's only target of the game, though he has now logged a reception in two consecutive games. With Rice's offense relying on a heavy rushing attack, it will be hard for him to replicate the same production on a weekly basis.

news.summary: Hardeman (undisclosed) is good to go for Saturday's game versus Tulsa, per the American Athletic availability report.
news.details: Hardeman suffered an injury during warmups last week and was held out, but it appears the issue was relatively minor in nature. He should slot back into the regular backfield rotation Saturday and has expanded work ahead with Quinton Jackson (undisclosed) out for the year.

news.summary: Henry gathered in all four targets for 57 yards during Saturday's 56-24 loss against Army.
news.details: Henry caught all four of his targets in a pass-heavy game that saw Caden Veltkamp attempt 48 throws. The wideout was overshadowed by Easton Messer and Kelby Valsin, who both recorded receiving touchdowns as the team's top two pass-catchers on the day. His last two outings have been quiet, reeling in six receptions for 90 yards on eight targets following a breakout performance where he logged 116 yards and two scores.

news.summary: Byars logged 14 carries for 111 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 28-12 defeat to East Carolina.
news.details: Byars provided the only score for Temple on Saturday, going the distance on a 23-yard touchdown run in the third quarter. The running back served as the lone bright spot for the offense and saw an increased workload, partly due to D'Andre Hardeman (undisclosed) getting injured during warmups. Byars has a prime opportunity to claim the primary running back role with Quinton Jackson (undisclosed) sidelined for the season.

news.summary: Hammer gathered in their only target for 12 yards during Saturday's 39-24 victory against Ball State.
news.details: After recording at least three receptions in each of his first four games, Hammer reeled in just one pass Saturday against the Cardinals. The wide receiver has 16 receptions for 298 yards and two touchdowns this season.

news.summary: Mataele totaled 11 rushes for 62 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 28-21 victory versus Rice.
news.details: Mataele found the end zone for the first time this season during the Broncos' win Saturday. The running back scored on a one-yard rush to extend the lead late in the fourth quarter.

news.summary: Barnett had three catches for 34 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 39-24 win versus Ball State.
news.details: Barnett recorded his second score of the season Saturday against Ball State. The wide receiver reeled in an 11-yard pass from John Alan Richter to give the Rockets the lead at the end of the first half. The Ohio native has 10 catches for 164 yards and two touchdowns this campaign.

news.summary: Chenault (undisclosed) had two receptions (on four targets) for 20 yards during Saturday's 38-17 victory against Kent State.
news.details: Chenault was marked questionable heading into Saturday's matchup, but he ended up taking the field. The wideout was not heavily involved in a high-scoring game, hauling in only two receptions. Even with his low usage, he is expected to remain a top target for quarterback Broc Lowry.

news.summary: Lowry was 5-for-8 passing for 48 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 21-14 victory over Central Michigan. He also had seven rushes for 16 yards.
news.details: Despite only attempting eight passes, Lowry led his team to a win over the Chippewas on Saturday. The quarterback connected with Nate Levicki for a 10-yard touchdown to extend the second-quarter lead. The Ohio native has 1,044 passing yards, 238 rushing yards, 11 total touchdowns and one interception this season.

news.summary: Ervin logged 21 carries for 139 yards and one touchdown and reeled in all two targets for six yards during Saturday's 45-17 win versus Louisiana-Monroe.
news.details: Ervin made his presence known on the ground Saturday after modest production since his season opener. The running back has handled a heavy workload all year, logging double-digit carries in all four games, but he finally broke out with over 20 attempts and 100 yards for the first time this season. His high volume is especially impressive considering Florida Atlantic operates a pass-heavy offense. He capped off a 92-yard scoring drive with a two-yard score, marking his second touchdown of the sea

news.summary: Valsin had seven receptions (on 10 targets) for 89 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 56-24 defeat to Army.
news.details: Valsin extended his scoring streak to two games after reeling in a team-long 34-yard touchdown reception in the first quarter. The wideout has six touchdowns on the season to lead Florida Atlantic pass-catchers. He was one of nine different receivers to catch a pass, with the offense resorting to the aerial attack after Army pulled ahead in the second quarter. He continues to build on a standout campaign and will remain a focal point in the offense against Rice in Week 8.

news.summary: Ison accrued 18 carries for 104 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 34-14 victory over Eastern Michigan.
news.details: Ison rushed for a season-high 104 yards during Saturday's win over the Eagles. The running back scored his first touchdown since Sept. 12, extending the second-quarter lead on a 13-yard run. The Georgia native has 60 carries for 296 yards and two touchdowns this year.

news.summary: Richter was 24-for-30 passing for 288 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 34-14 win against Eastern Michigan.
news.details: Richter completed 80 percent of his 30 passes, averaging 9.6 yards per completion during Saturday's win over the Eagles. The quarterback opened the scoring with a 28-yard touchdown pass to Adjatay Dabbs in the first quarter. The Georgia native has 1,853 passing yards, 14 touchdowns and one interception this season.

news.summary: Brown was 2-for-6 passing for 47 yards during Saturday's 38-17 loss against Tulsa. He also had 11 rushes for 154 yards with two touchdowns.
news.details: Brown recorded two long rushing touchdowns Saturday, taking off for 50-yard and 78-yard scores that ultimately stood as Rice's only touchdowns of the game. Both scores came in the first half, as the Owls' offense stalled for the remainder of the contest. His 154 rushing yards were a season high and marked his third 100-yard performance of the campaign. Even while trailing for most of the game, the team did not rely on the passing attack, as Brown attempted just six passes after surpassing 10 thr

news.summary: Messer caught 14 of 17 targets for 102 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 56-24 loss versus Army.
news.details: Messer drew a season-high 17 targets, resulting in 14 receptions during a game where Florida Atlantic leaned heavily on the aerial attack while trailing for most of the contest. The wideout reeled in a 24-yard touchdown pass in the first quarter, extending his scoring streak to two consecutive games. He also passed the century mark for the second time this season and seemed unfazed following the team's bye week.

news.summary: Shields-Dutton (undisclosed) recorded four rushes for 20 yards and hauled in one reception for four yards during Saturday's 56-24 defeat to Army.
news.details: Shields-Dutton took the field Saturday after initial concerns about his availability due to being marked questionable ahead of kickoff. The running back logged a season-high 20 yards on the ground. He will continue to serve as a depth option in the backfield behind Ethan Ervin and Leonard Farrow.

news.summary: Clark totaled six receptions (on nine targets) for 73 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 26-13 victory versus Ball State.
news.details: Clark hauled in his first score of the campaign Saturday against Ball State. The receiver reeled in a five-yard pass from John Alan Richter in the fourth quarter to extend the lead. Through four games, Clark has 13 catches for 178 yards and one touchdown.

news.summary: Witten caught 3 of 5 targets for 84 yards during Saturday's 35-31 loss versus Cincinnati.
news.details: Witten brought in three catches for an average of 28 yards per catch. The Cleveland native brought in a 34-yard pass from David McComb that fueled a touchdown drive early in the first quarter. The wide receiver now has six catches for 184 yards and two touchdowns on the season.

news.summary: Nelson accrued 13 rushes for 142 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 34-14 victory versus Akron.
news.details: Nelson recorded a season-high 142 rushing yards, averaging 10.9 yards per carry on 13 rushes during Saturday's win over the Zips. The running back started the scoring for the RedHawks on a nine-yard run in the first quarter and later cemented the lead with a 58-yard run in the fourth quarter. The Maryland native has 68 carries for 348 yards and two touchdowns this year.

news.summary: Blue (thigh) posted four carries for 29 yards during Saturday's 41-17 victory versus Akron.
news.details: Blue suited up Saturday after being spotted in warmups prior to kickoff. The running back was seemingly limited, recording only four carries while Jayden Clerveaux handled the bulk of the workload. On a positive note, it appears his thigh is no longer an issue, as he looks to see more action at Ohio in Week 6.

news.summary: Townsend logged two carries for 41 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 24-10 win over Wyoming.
news.details: After an eight-touchdown season in 2025, Townsend crossed the goal line for the first time in 2026 against Wyoming on Saturday. Townsend took a 38-yard run to the house late in the third quarter to extend the Chippewas' lead.

news.summary: Clerveaux is cleared from his concussion, Andrew E. Graham of Mitten Football reports.
news.details: Clerveaux's latest update suggests he should be good to go for Week 8. The running back has provided Central Michigan a quality option in the backfield, with his 41 carries for 239 yards (5.8 averaged per carry) and two touchdowns an excellent source behind the offensive line.

news.summary: Gant compiled 15 rushes for 46 yards and one touchdown and gathered in 2 of 6 targets for seven yards during Saturday's 34-14 loss versus Miami (OH).
news.details: Despite averaging just 3.1 yards per rush on 15 carries, Gant led the team in yards (46) during Saturday's blowout loss to the RedHawks. The running back crossed the goal line on a 10-yard rush late in the third quarter to cut the lead. The Florida native has 99 carries for 456 yards and four touchdowns.

news.summary: Roggow was 22-for-38 passing for 234 yards, one touchdown and four interceptions during Saturday's 34-14 loss against Miami (OH). He also had 11 rushes for 10 yards.
news.details: Roggow threw a career-high four interceptions and just one passing touchdown in Saturday's 20-point loss to the RedHawks. The quarterback now has 1,068 passing yards, seven touchdowns and eight interceptions in seven games this season.

news.summary: Heavner completed 8 of 16 passes for 65 yards, one touchdown and one interception during Saturday's 34-14 win over Akron. He also had five rushes for 45 yards.
news.details: Despite completing only 50 percent of his 16 passes, Heavner led his team to a Saturday win over the Zips. The quarterback tossed a 27-yard touchdown to Damarion Witten to extend the lead in the second quarter. The Texas native has 394 passing yards, 159 rushing yards, three total touchdowns and two interceptions this year.

news.summary: Alexander caught 5 of 6 targets for 55 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 45-10 win versus Robert Morris.
news.details: Alexander has recorded scores in back-to-back games to open the 2026 campaign. The tight end reeled in a 25-yard pass from Cibastian Broughton in the second quarter for a touchdown and later hauled in a three-yard reception to cement the Zips' lead.

news.summary: Jones posted seven rushes for 47 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 45-7 win over Holy Cross.
news.details: Jones crossed the goal line for the second consecutive game to open up the season. The running back scored on a two-yard run early in the second quarter to extend the RedHawks' lead.

news.summary: DeShields was 17-for-30 passing for 165 yards during Saturday's 29-2 loss versus South Florida. He also had nine rushes for 12 yards.
news.details: DeShields did not lead any scoring drives for his team during a blowout loss to the Bulls on Saturday. The quarterback completed 56.6 percent of his 30 passes, averaging 5.5 yards per completion. The Ohio native has 1,145 passing yards, 189 rushing yards, seven total touchdowns and six interceptions this year.

news.summary: Hills caught two passes for 31 yards and scored one touchdown in Saturday's 41-17 loss to Central Michigan.
news.details: Hills crossed the goal line for the first time in 2026 on Saturday against the Chippewas. The wide receiver hauled in an eight-yard pass from Brayden Roggow to cut the lead late in the fourth quarter.

news.summary: Allen logged four receptions (on six targets) for 56 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 21-14 loss to Western Michigan.
news.details: Allen contributed his first score of the campaign during Saturday's loss to the Broncos. The tight end caught a 32-yard touchdown pass from Angel Flores to cut the lead in the fourth quarter. The New Jersey native has five receptions for 66 yards and one touchdown this season.

news.summary: Ruffin (undisclosed) is in the clear for Saturday's game versus Western Michigan, per the MAC availability report.
news.details: Central Michigan has regularly used Ruffin as part of the team's offense in games. Despite zero touchdowns to his name, he has logged multiple targets and at least one reception in four of his five games for CMU.

news.summary: Lewis posted one reception (on three targets) for 71 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 41-17 win versus Akron.
news.details: Lewis more than doubled his receiving total on one catch Saturday against Akron. The wide receiver caught a 71-yard pass from Jadyn Glasser to the end zone to cement the lead in the fourth quarter.

news.summary: Billups-Williams logged four catches for 75 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 24-20 defeat versus Bowling Green.
news.details: Billups-Williams recorded his fourth game with at least four receptions this year Saturday against Bowling Green. The wide receiver reeled in a 10-yard pass from Caleb Heavner to tie the game in the fourth quarter. The Illinois native has 19 catches for 265 yards and two touchdowns so far.

news.summary: Harris gathered in 11 of 15 targets for 164 yards during Saturday's 38-7 loss to Western Michigan.
news.details: After being targeted 15 times, Harris reeled in 11 catches for 164 yards, a season high, in Saturday's blowout loss to the Broncos. The wide receiver has 27 catches for 368 yards and one touchdown this season.

news.summary: Huggins reeled in all four targets for 128 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 35-31 defeat versus Cincinnati.
news.details: After an eight-touchdown season in 2025, Huggins contributed his first score of the campaign Saturday. The Bethune-Cookman transfer led the RedHawks in receiving yards (128), averaging 32 yards per catch on four receptions. The wide receiver now has 10 catches for 205 yards and one touchdown on the season.

news.summary: Williams hauled in 5 of 7 targets for 89 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 25-23 loss against Eastern Michigan.
news.details: Williams reeled in his first two scores of the campaign during Saturday's narrow loss to the Eagles. The wide receiver caught a 15-yard pass from Brayden Roggow in the first quarter to cross the goal line, then caught a 40-yard pass in the second quarter to take the lead. The Florida native has 25 catches for 290 yards and two touchdowns this campaign.

news.summary: Ross is available for Saturday's game at UMass, per the MAC availability report.
news.details: Ross, who has missed the last two games with an undisclosed injury, is available to return Saturday on the road. He caught four of seven targets for 52 yards and a touchdown across the first three games of the season.

news.summary: Head coach Neal Brown said that Haygood (undisclosed) will be back for North Texas for Saturday's matchup against Charlotte, per Brett Vito of the Denton Record-Chronicle.
news.details: Haygood was previously listed as questionable after missing each of the last two games for North Texas due to an undisclosed injury, but he appears ready to go this week. The 5-foot-10 sophomore ran for 114 yards and a pair of touchdowns on 3.9 YPC across three contests prior to his injury.

news.summary: White totaled 12 rushes for 105 yards and one touchdown and reeled in all two targets for 37 yards during Saturday's 50-10 win versus Charlotte.
news.details: White made easy work of Charlotte's struggling defense, averaging 8.8 yards per carry and recording a 61-yard touchdown run in the second quarter. The running back extended his touchdown streak to six consecutive games while logging three straight contests with over 140 total yards. He could have contributed even more to his stat line, but North Texas pulled its starters in the fourth quarter due to the lopsided score, allowing backup Brendon Haygood to close out the game.

news.summary: Dickens (undisclosed) is listed as questionable for Saturday's contest versus Hawaii, per the Mountain West availability report.
news.details: Dickens' status is uncertain for Saturday due to an undisclosed issue that may force him to sit out his first contest of the season. The starting quarterback has experienced mixed results this year, throwing for 1,193 yards, four touchdowns and three interceptions across six games.

news.summary: Gathings (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game against Toledo.
news.details: Gathings will return to action against the Rockets after sitting out the last two weeks due to undisclosed reasons. The 6-foot-1 senior wideout has tallied three receptions for 18 yards across two outings this fall.

news.summary: Rice tallied six rushes for 28 yards during Saturday's 30-12 defeat to Arizona State.
news.details: Rice saw his role diminished by the game script again Saturday, as Hawaii fell behind early against the Sun Devils. The sophomore back has just 12 carries for 62 yards in his last two games after totaling 242 yards and three touchdowns in his first four contests this season.

news.summary: Koch caught 3 of 4 targets for 48 yards and one touchdown during Thursday's 45-44 overtime win against Tulsa.
news.details: Koch joined the touchdown barrage Friday after reeling in a five-yard reception in the third quarter. He was one of three different pass catchers to find the end zone, bringing his season total to two. After not seeing any targets in the team's first two games, the last three have been a different story, totaling 10 receptions for 143 yards and two touchdowns on 12 targets.

news.summary: Morrow posted three receptions (on eight targets) for 27 yards during Saturday's 25-18 overtime win against Massachusetts.
news.details: Despite being targeted eight times, Morrow reeled in only three catches during Saturday's win over the Minutemen. The wide receiver has caught just five passes over his last two games. The North Carolina native has 37 receptions for 441 yards and six touchdowns this season.

news.summary: Listorti recorded seven rushes for 29 yards and one touchdown and gathered in 1 of 3 targets for 39 yards during Friday's 24-20 defeat versus UAB.
news.details: Listorti scored his second touchdown of the season on a 7-yard carry, which helped salvage a game where he was only able to produce 29 yards on the ground. The running back hasn't seen much action in the backfield over his last two games, matching his season opener total with just 11 carries across that stretch. He did haul in a 39-yard reception, though the run-first offense rarely relies on production through the air.

news.summary: Hill totaled 21 carries for 64 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 31-28 victory against Robert Morris.
news.details: Despite being the third-leading rusher for the Bulls on Saturday, Hill found the end zone twice during the win. The running back got Buffalo on the board with a four-yard run in the second and topped it off with a one-yard touchdown in the third to take the lead.

news.summary: Collins reeled in all two targets for 117 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 38-34 defeat to Texas-San Antonio.
news.details: Collins served as a key target Saturday, capitalizing on his two receptions by turning both into touchdowns. The 6-foot-3 tight end hauled in a 25-yard score early before beating UTSA's secondary for a season-long 92-yard touchdown catch. He has been a deep threat all season, recording five receptions for 189 yards and three touchdowns, which averages a staggering 37.8 yards per catch.

news.summary: Uiliata posted six receptions (on 10 targets) for 39 yards during Saturday's 27-10 defeat versus Wyoming.
news.details: Uiliata continues to serve as Hawaii's number-one receiver in the absence of Pofele Ashlock (undisclosed). The sophomore's seen 10 targets in three of his first four games this year, totaling  24 receptions for 208 yards and a touchdown.

news.summary: Wright was 16-for-35 passing for 134 yards, two touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 25-18 overtime win versus Massachusetts. He also had five rushes for 13 yards.
news.details: Despite completing only 45.7 percent of his 35 passes for just 3.8 yards per attempt, Wright threw two touchdown passes, leading his team to an overtime win over the Minutemen on Saturday. The quarterback connected with Clint Walker for both touchdowns, including the game-winning score in overtime. In six games, Wright has 860 passing yards, 117 rushing yards, eight total touchdowns and four interceptions.

news.summary: Amachree logged three catches for 71 yards and one touchdown, plus four rushes for 12 yards, in Saturday's 24-20 win over Miami (OH).
news.details: Amachree totaled 71 receiving yards, a season high, in Saturday's win. The running back opened the scoring for the Broncos after reeling in a 64-yard pass from Jay Kastanin. The Michigan native has 33 rushes for 113 yards, 12 catches for 127 yards and one touchdown this season.

news.summary: Johnson (undisclosed) is questionable for Saturday's contest versus Hawaii, per the Mountain West availability report.
news.details: Johnson has landed on Northern Illinois' initial injury report after a Week 7 performance in which he notched a season-high 139 rushing yards. The running back serves as the team's primary starter in the backfield, so if he can't suit up, Elijah Porter is in line to see an expanded workload.

news.summary: Robinson had zero carries and hauled in 4 of 7 targets for 36 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 38-30 defeat versus Florida Atlantic.
