news.details: Robinson found success as a pass catcher, so if he can continue to leverage the passing game, he should see targets moving forward. The running back scored his first collegiate touchdown on a short 8-yard pass in the fourth quarter.

news.summary: McNeil (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game against Western Michigan.
news.details: In the midst of a career year, McNeil will attempt to continue the positive momentum during the month of October. Last month, he logged 23 carries for 105 yards and one touchdown. All those tallies should increase further with Terrance Shelton (arm) out Saturday.

news.summary: Andrews (undisclosed) is off the injury report ahead of Saturday's game against Robert Morris.
news.details: Andrews did not play in last week's game as he was coming back from an undisclosed injury. The junior wide receiver will aim to maximize his opportunities after reeling in six receptions for 39 yards across two appearances.

news.summary: Ridley gathered in all two targets for 84 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 32-31 overtime loss against Ball State.
news.details: Ridley contributed his first touchdown of the campaign during Saturday's narrow loss to the Cardinals. The wide receiver caught a 77-yard pass from Jay Kastantin for a touchdown, cutting the lead in the second quarter. The Virginia native has 22 receptions for 257 yards and one touchdown in seven games.

news.summary: Rogers tallied 11 receptions (on 13 targets) for 89 yards during Saturday's 41-23 loss to Wyoming.
news.details: Rogers continues to see significant volume in the Huskies' passing game -- the senior wideout has seen double-digit targets in four of his six games this season. Overall, Rogers has brought in 49 receptions on 63 targets for 422 yards and two touchdowns this year.

news.summary: Kastantin was 17-for-24 passing for 215 yards, two touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 32-31 overtime defeat against Ball State. He also had nine rushes for seven yards.
news.details: Despite completing 70.8 percent of his 24 passes and tossing two touchdowns, Kastanin could not lead his team to a win over the Cardinals on Saturday. The quarterback found Brennan Ridley on a 77-yard touchdown pass in the second quarter and later connected with Eli Jacon-Duffy on a six-yard pass to tie the game in the fourth quarter. The Massachusetts native has 1,201 passing yards, eight total touchdowns and four interceptions this season.

news.summary: Dendy compiled 15 carries for 86 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 38-10 victory over Sacramento State.
news.details: Dendy set a season-high in rushing yards (86) on 15 carries, averaging 5.7 yards per carry. The running back scored his first two rushing touchdowns since Week 1: a one-yard run in the second, followed by a 30-yard run in the third to cement the lead. The Arkansas native has 77 rushes for 271 yards and three touchdowns this campaign.

news.summary: Barrow recorded 14 rushes for 107 yards and hauled in all two targets for 16 yards during Saturday's 34-26 win over Tulsa.
news.details: Barrow had his best rushing performance of the season while outpacing Vic Listorti, who was expected to lead the backfield entering the year. Barrow was the first running back to take the field and logged 14 carries, representing the highest total among Navy's running backs on a day when quarterback Jackson Gutierrez recorded a staggering 41 rushing attempts. He is making a strong case to secure the primary running back job, and his productive outing against Tulsa marks another positive step for

news.summary: Barfield (ankle) accrued four carries for 17 yards during Saturday's 27-10 loss at Wyoming.
news.details: Given that Barfield was probable for Week 4, Hawaii using him at Wyoming should not be so surprising, and the game suggests that he should revert to his supplemental role. It was how, in 2025, he logged 80 rushing attempts for 371 yards and four touchdowns. As a receiving option, the running back also recorded 27 receptions (on 37 targets) for 257 yards and three more TDs. All of Barfield's aforementioned tallies are his career-highs.

news.summary: Harris (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game against San Jose State, according to Christian Shimabuku of Aloha State Daily.
news.details: Not having Harris would be a huge loss for the Rainbow Warriors, as he has 10 catches for 163 yards on 18 targets this season. His next chance to play should come against Arizona State on Oct. 10, whereas names such as Blaze Kamoku and Carson Brown should be in line for more targets with both Harris and star wideout Pofele Ashlock (undisclosed) on the sidelines.

news.summary: Martin (undisclosed) will be available for Saturday's game against UNC Charlotte, Brett Vito of the Denton Record-Chronicle reports.
news.details: Martin's availability gives North Texas and team quarterback Tayven Jackson a highly valuable weapon going into Week 6. Although the wide receiver still has zero touchdowns this season, he and his QB have gelled well, connecting on 11 of 17 targets for 161 yards. In terms of yardage, Martin has already surpassed his 2024 season's previous career-high, and it is not even halfway through North Texas' 2026 campaign yet.

news.summary: Woodson completed 1 of 1 passes for 63 yards during Saturday's 38-34 defeat versus Texas-San Antonio. He also had five rushes for 73 yards with one touchdown.
news.details: Woodson re-entered the rotation during his second game back from injury Saturday after being unable to see action against Tulsa in Week 6. The quarterback punched in a seven-yard rushing score in the fourth quarter, recording his fifth touchdown on the ground this season. He also connected with starting signal-caller Jackson Gutierrez on his sole pass attempt, executing a designed play that went for 63 yards. It's easy to forget that Woodson opened the campaign as Navy's starter under center bef

news.summary: Bryant reeled in 4 of 7 targets for 66 yards and a touchdown during Saturday's 41-23 loss to Wyoming.
news.details: While it was a tough day overall for the Huskies, Bryant ended the game on a high note, hauling in a 34-yard touchdown late in the fourth quarter, his first of the season. Bryant, a redshirt sophomore, has seen steady volume this year as NIU's number-two receiver behind DeAree Rogers. He's totaled 21 receptions on 38 targets for 286 yards across six games.

news.summary: Scoby accrued six receptions (on eight targets) for 70 yards during Saturday's 38-10 victory versus Sacramento State.
news.details: Scoby hauled in a season-high six catches for 70 yards during Saturday's blowout win over the Hornets. The tight end now has 24 catches for 252 yards this season.

news.summary: Alejado was 23-for-40 passing for 250 yards, a touchdown and an interception during Saturday's 21-10 loss versus New Mexico.
news.details: Alejado's now completed fewer than 60 percent of his passes in back-to-back weeks while throwing four interceptions in his last three contests. Across seven games this season, Alejado's completed a career-low 58.9 percent of his throws for 1,860 yards, six touchdowns and five interceptions. He'll look to turn things around next week on the road against Northern Illinois.

news.summary: Baldwin (undisclosed) is ready to roll for Saturday's game versus Ball State, per the MAC availability report.
news.details: Baldwin was unable to suit up last week, but he'll rejoin the action Saturday after missing just one contest. He's totaled 12 carries for 50 yards through four games this season and doesn't figure to be much of a fantasy factor.

news.summary: Walker posted seven receptions (on nine targets) for 45 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 25-18 overtime victory against Massachusetts.
news.details: Walker contributed both touchdowns for his team during Saturday's win over the Minutemen. The tight end reeled in a two-yard pass from Jason Wright to tie the game in the third quarter and scored the game-winning 15-yard touchdown in overtime. The Indiana native has 20 receptions for 155 yards and two touchdowns this season.

news.summary: Gutierrez completed 3 of 7 passes for 120 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 38-34 defeat versus Texas-San Antonio. He also had 21 rushes for 139 yards with two touchdowns.
news.details: Gutierrez returned to his hometown of San Antonio and continued his dominant campaign, accounting for four touchdowns. The quarterback showed his versatility as a wideout, catching a pass from fellow signal-caller Braxton Woodson that went for 63 yards before he fell one yard short of the goal line. He tossed two touchdown passes for the second time this season, both connecting with tight end Jordan Collins. Woodson saw some action under center as a rushing presence in the backfield, but Gutierr

news.summary: Jackson was 24-for-31 passing for 349 yards and five touchdowns during Saturday's 50-10 victory against Charlotte.
news.details: Jackson was stellar once again for North Texas, leading a Mean Green passing attack that continues to elevate its play week by week. The quarterback threw a career-high five touchdowns and avoided turnovers after committing three giveaways against Tulsa last week. He connected on his first 14 passes of the game, distributing his five scores among four different pass catchers to bring his season total to 15 passing touchdowns. The blowout allowed him to sit out the entire fourth quarter while bac

news.summary: Sharp (undisclosed) hauled in their only target for three yards during Saturday's 38-10 victory over Sacramento State.
news.details: By logging a reception Saturday, he has caught a pass in four consecutive games. During the four-game span, he logged 12 receptions for 181 yards and one touchdown.

news.summary: Johnson (undisclosed) logged 20 snaps during Saturday's 32-31 loss to Ball State.
news.details: Johnson was questionable heading into Saturday's matchup but suited up to join Bowling Green's receiving corps. The wideout was unable to draw a target in a high-scoring affair. He will look to be more involved against Buffalo in Week 8.

news.summary: Carvalho gathered in 7 of 11 targets for 86 yards during Saturday's 30-12 loss to Arizona State.
news.details: It's the second time that Carvalho's seen double-digit targets this season, as he finished the day with a season-high 86 receiving yards. While Carvalho's yet to find the end zone this season, he's maintained a steady role in Hawaii's passing game, totaling 29 receptions (on 45 targets) for 335 yards across six games.

news.summary: Clacks totaled one 59-yard catch and one touchdown in Saturday's 20-17 loss to Western Michigan.
news.details: Clacks managed to reel in just one pass that went for a score in Saturday's loss. The wide receiver hauled in a 59-yard pass from Jason Wright to tie the game for the Bulls in the first quarter.

news.summary: Brasfield (undisclosed) hauled in his only target for 58 yards and a touchdown during Saturday's 34-26 victory over Tulsa.
news.details: Brasfield reeled in his lone target for a 58-yard touchdown that served as the only passing score of the contest for Navy. The wideout has now logged two consecutive games with a long touchdown after scoring on a 68-yard reception against Air Force in Week 5. He is emerging as a primary pass catcher in a Navy offense that rarely relies on the passing attack. He will look to extend his scoring streak in Week 7 against conference foe UTSA.

news.summary: Alves notched five receptions (on seven targets) for 76 yards during Saturday's 21-10 loss to New Mexico.
news.details: While it was another subpar outing from the Rainbow Warriors offense, Alves put together another solid day, leading the team in receiving yards. After totaling just four receptions (on 12 targets) for 46 yards in his first four games this year, Alves has brought in 11 receptions (on 17 targets) for 257 yards and a touchdown in his last three contests.

news.summary: Reese reeled in 5 of 6 targets for 101 yards and one touchdown during Thursday's 45-44 overtime win over Tulsa.
news.details: Reese led all pass catchers with 101 yards and tied for the most receptions with five. It was a breakout game for the tight end, who was looking to bounce back after only appearing in one game last season with Mississippi State. He passed the century mark for the first time in his collegiate career and hauled in his second touchdown of the season on an 11-yard catch in the second quarter. He's emerging as a reliable target for Tayven Jackson, reaching over 70 yards in two consecutive games.

news.summary: Tipton gathered in 3 of 5 targets for 93 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 50-10 victory versus Charlotte.
news.details: Tipton hauled in a 75-yard touchdown, producing the longest reception of his career and bringing his season total to two receiving scores. The majority of his production resulted from that single play, with his other two receptions combining for 18 yards. Regardless, he turned limited opportunities into a career day, setting personal bests with 93 receiving yards while averaging 31.0 yards per reception.

news.summary: Burch logged 28 carries for 172 yards during Saturday's 25-18 overtime win against Massachusetts.
news.details: Burch logged his fourth consecutive game with at least 100 rushing yards during Saturday's win over the Minutemen. The running back averaged 6.1 yards per carry over 28 rushes. The New York native has 118 carries for 661 yards and two touchdowns this season.

news.summary: Stevenson caught 9 of 13 targets for 122 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 50-10 victory over Charlotte.
news.details: Stevenson matched his season high with 122 receiving yards and notched two touchdowns in his second straight game. The wideout continues to serve as Tayven Jackson's top target, leading North Texas with nine receptions. He put North Texas on the scoreboard with a five-yard touchdown reception in the first quarter before adding a 34-yard score in the third quarter. Through six games, Stevenson has recorded 33 receptions for 453 yards and five touchdowns.

news.summary: Rosa recorded 10 carries for 30 yards during Saturday's 13-10 victory versus Kent State.
news.details: After a two-touchdown performance last week, Rosa posted just 30 yards against Kent State on Saturday. The running back has 56 rushes for 219 yards and four touchdowns this campaign.

news.summary: Brune posted 12 carries for 55 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 48-7 victory versus Sacramento State.
news.details: Despite averaging just 4.6 yards per rush on 12 carries, Brune crossed the goal line twice during Saturday's win over the Hornets. The German-born running back opened the scoring with a three-yard touchdown run in the first quarter and later scored on a 14-yard run in the second quarter to extend the lead. The junior has 73 carries for 330 yards and three touchdowns this year.

news.summary: Mattord recorded eight carries for 54 yards and one touchdown, and hauled in all three targets for 22 yards in Saturday's 38-14 victory over Massachusetts.
news.details: Mattord registered a season-high 54 rushing yards along with his first score of 2026 on Saturday against the Minutemen. The running back took a 25-yard run to the house to cement the Eagles' lead in the fourth quarter.

news.summary: Poulos completed 11 of 14 passes for 165 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 48-7 victory over Sacramento State. He also had five rushes for 48 yards.
news.details: Poulos completed 78.6 percent of his 14 passes during Saturday's blowout win over the Hornets. The quarterback threw a 67-yard touchdown pass to Preston Bowman, extending the lead in the third quarter. The California native has 503 passing yards, 181 rushing yards and six total touchdowns this year.

news.summary: Prosper gathered in 10 of 13 targets for 109 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 29-3 win against Lindenwood.
news.details: Prosper led the Eagles in receptions (10) and receiving yards (109) during Saturday's win. The wide receiver found the end zone for the first time this campaign after reeling in a 24-yard pass from Noah Kim in the first quarter to extend the lead. In five games, the Florida native has 21 catches for 220 yards and one touchdown.

news.summary: Dorwart hauled in 2 of 3 targets for 42 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 31-14 win against Central Michigan.
news.details: Dorwart reeled in his third score of the season Saturday against the Chippewas. The wide receiver caught a 44-yard pass from Nick Poulos that crossed the goal line to extend the lead before halftime. The Maryland native has 13 catches for 202 yards and three touchdowns this season.

news.summary: Bowman caught 3 of 7 targets for 94 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 48-7 victory over Sacramento State.
news.details: Despite being targeted seven times, Bowman made the most of his three receptions, averaging 31.3 yards per catch in Saturday's win against the Hornets. The wide receiver has caught touchdowns in back-to-back weeks, including a 67-yard touchdown pass from Nick Poulos that extended the lead in the third quarter. The Ohio native has 12 receptions for 171 yards and two touchdowns this year.

news.summary: Mack totaled four receptions (on nine targets) for 37 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 34-14 defeat to Toledo.
news.details: Despite being targeted nine times, Mack caught just four passes in Saturday's loss to the Rockets. The wide receiver scored on a 12-yard pass from Noah Kim to cut the lead in the third quarter. The Indiana native has 31 receptions for 337 yards and four touchdowns this year.

news.summary: Blue (undisclosed) notched one carry for six yards during Saturday's 25-23 win over Akron.
news.details: Blue was limited to one carry Saturday after recording double-digit carries in his previous two outings. Joey Mattord and Braydon Bennett both saw an expanded workload. Blue was questionable prior to kickoff, and his limited activity could point to the running back still being banged up.

news.summary: Bennett logged 10 carries for 42 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 38-14 win against Massachusetts.
news.details: Bennett averaged 4.2 yards per carry on 10 attempts Saturday against UMass. The running back crossed the goal line on a two-yard run to extend the Eagles' lead in the second quarter.

news.summary: Long reeled in 7 of 9 targets for 84 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 34-14 defeat to Toledo.
news.details: Long averaged 12 yards per reception on seven catches in Saturday's blowout loss to the Rockets. The tight end scored on a 30-yard pass from Noah Kim in the second quarter to cut the lead. The California native has 38 receptions for 366 yards and two touchdowns this year.

news.summary: Edwards completed 15 of 25 passes for 191 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 24-20 win versus Duke. He also had nine rushes for 20 yards.
news.details: Edwards was held to under 200 yards through the air and logged an otherwise solid but certainly far from special performance in the win over Duke, as has been the theme for the Wisconsin transfer all season. Edwards has been more of a game manager-type quarterback for the Tar Heels, which isn't conducive to much fantasy production.

news.summary: Alexander tallied 10 rushes for 57 yards and one touchdown and hauled in 3 of 4 targets for 40 yards during Saturday's 31-21 defeat to Arkansas.
news.details: Alexander opened the scoring with a four-yard touchdown run, marking his fifth rushing score of the season. The senior running back has scored in three of his last four outings and will look to build on that momentum when they visit Kentucky next week.

news.summary: Miller is available for Saturday's game versus LSU, per the SEC availability report.
news.details: Miller, who was considered probable on the team's initial report, has now been cleared to play in Saturday's clash with LSU. Miller was injured early in Week 4's win over South Alabama after his 96-yard performance at Texas A&M in Week 3.

news.summary: Spence (leg) was seen wearing uniform ahead of Saturday's game against Auburn, Joey Dwyer of SI.com reports.
news.details: Spence was observed participating in pregame warmups in uniform, indicating he may be available to his season debut. The senior tight end is expected to be an important part of this offense.

news.summary: June recorded 13 carries for 49 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 24-20 win versus Duke.
news.details: June scored for the second straight week as UNC topped Duke in a rivalry clash in Week 7. The running back's 13 carries were also a season high, but that was partially due to Benjamin Hall suffering a hamstring injury mid-game. June will look to stay involved next week against Syracuse.

news.summary: Hill tallied 11 rushes for 26 yards and caught 0 of 1 targets for zero yards during Saturday's 34-26 loss to Louisville.
news.details: Hill averaged just 2.4 yards per carry, as he was outshined badly by Ahmad Miller with 18 carries for 123 yards and a TD, averaging 6.8 yards per carry. As such, Hill might have to take a backseat to Miller if he gets on another heater Saturday at NC State.

news.summary: Brown gathered in all four targets for 81 yards during Saturday's 35-31 win against North Carolina State.
news.details: Brown made the most of his opportunities, averaging 20.3 yards-per-reception and finishing second in receiving yards behind Junior Sherrill. The junior wide receiver will aim to build on this performance during next week's meeting with Auburn.

news.summary: Joseph completed 6 of 16 passes for 66 yards during Saturday's 17-7 loss against UCLA. He also had 18 rushes for 71 yards with one touchdown.
news.details: The wheels came off Wisconsin's offense against UCLA, largely due to a lukewarm performance from Joseph. He completed just six passes in the defeat, and although he ran for a good total, it wasn't enough to overcome a strong day from Ty Diffenbach. The Badgers will try to recover at home and make a statement win against USC in Week 8.

news.summary: Darby gathered in all five targets for 35 yards during Saturday's 21-13 win versus Oklahoma.
news.details: Darby hauled in all five of his targets but was fairly limited on the day as the Oklahoma defense did a good job against the passing attack holding Kentucky to just 158 yards through the air. The freshman continues to be a key part of the passing attack hauling in at least four receptions in each of the last three outings. The freshman has emerged as one of Kenny Minchey's favorite targets accumulating 21 receptions for 210 yards and a touchdown over the last three games.

news.summary: Miller posted 18 carries for 123 yards and one touchdown and hauled in their only target for seven yards during Saturday's 34-26 defeat to Louisville.
news.details: Miller has scored rushing touchdowns in back-to-back games, and three of the past four outings. The big performance was a bit unexpected, as he had 30 carries for just 114 yards in his first four outings. He'll try to keep up the momentum at Nort Carolina on Saturday.

news.summary: Conner gathered in 6 of 9 targets for 87 yards during Saturday's 35-26 win versus Delaware.
news.details: Conner led with six receptions and finished second in receiving yards behind Junior Sherrill. Across two games, the junior tight has shown promise in the receiving game and will hope to earn more opportunities in next week's game against NC State. d

news.summary: Young totaled nine carries for 45 yards and one touchdown and reeled in their only target for four yards during Saturday's 31-21 defeat against Arkansas.
news.details: Young averaged 5.0 yards-per-carry and scored on a three-yard run in the third quarter, marking his second rushing touchdown of the season. The senior ball-carrier will look to maintain his involvement in Vanderbilt's backfield against Kentucky next Saturday.

news.summary: Clement gathered in all two targets for 35 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 66-3 win versus New Hampshire.
news.details: Clement opened with a strong performance, as the senior gathered his first collegiate touchdown in the lopsided affair. He'll look to keep the momentum going in the conference opener Saturday against Cal.

news.summary: Miller notched 19 rushes for 102 yards and one touchdown and reeled in 0 of 1 targets for zero yards during Saturday's 31-23 win versus Penn State.
news.details: Miller had little trouble finding openings against Penn State, and he was once again a more effective option over Waymond Jordan, who is getting fewer carries as each week passes. He'll get a week off to rest and prepare for a tough Week 8 matchup against Wisconsin.

news.summary: Skinner hauled in all four targets for 61 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 45-13 victory against Youngstown State.
news.details: Skinner and fellow tight end Willie Rodriguez co-led the team in receptions on the day with four a piece. If there is any indications to be taken from this season opener it may be that the tight ends will have a big role in this offense moving forward. Keep an eye on Skinner through out the season.

news.summary: Johnson logged 10 rushes for 35 yards and hauled in 0 of 1 targets for zero yards during Saturday's 28-25 defeat versus Virginia.
news.details: Johnson was back in the lineup for the first time since Sept. 17, as he has missed time due to a hand injury. He had some bright spots, but there was a lot of rust, too. His 3.5 yards per carry did represent a season best. He'll look to build on that momentum Saturday against Louisville.

news.summary: Coleman (undisclosed) is questionable for Saturday's game versus USC, per the Big Ten availability report.
news.details: Coleman's status is uncertain for Saturday as he deals with an undisclosed injury. The wideout has been inconsistent this season, recording three games without a reception while combining for 122 yards across his other two contests.

news.summary: Patterson (quad) is not on the injury report ahead of Saturday's game against LSU.
news.details: After recording just five carries due to a quad injury a week ago, Patterson is cleared to play Saturday against the Tigers. The running back has 45 rushes for 355 yards and three scores this season.

news.summary: Minchey was 21-for-28 passing for 158 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 21-13 victory versus Oklahoma. He also had seven rushes for four yards.
news.details: Minchey was efficient against the Sooners completing 75% of his passes and connecting with Willie Rodriguez for two touchdowns. The senior quarterback now has 13 TDs to just one interception on the season through seven games.

news.summary: Boyer gathered in all two targets for 35 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 31-21 win against Texas A&M.
news.details: Boyer hasn't seen much action this year as he has just four catches through three games. However Boyer continues to make the most out of his limited action as he now has touchdowns in back-to-back games.

news.summary: Ross-Simmons tallied six receptions for 105 yards during Saturday's 21-18 loss against California.
news.details: Ross-Simmons easily had the most receiving yards of any player on either side, but the production came in a losing effort. It was just the second 100-yard game of his career, and his first as a member of the Orange. He had a career-high 123 receiving yards for Colorado State in a loss against Washington State on Sept. 2, 2023.

news.summary: Hilton (undisclosed) is not listed on the injury report ahead of Saturday's game at Penn State, per the Big Ten availability report.
news.details: Hilton was deemed probable in Wisconsin's initial injury report and is now officially set to suit up Saturday. The wideout will look to add to his season totals of seven receptions and 69 yards while aiming to become a favorite target of Colton Joseph.

news.summary: McGill accrued 12 rushes for 75 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 24-20 win against Duke.
news.details: Hall (hamstring) suffered an injury early in the Week 7 clash with Duke, allowing McGill and Demon June to lead the way in the Tar Heels' backfield. McGill had the more productive day, and he scored for the first time since the opener. He could be in line for another solid outing in Week 8 depending on the status of Hall.

news.summary: Anderson (undisclosed) will not play in Saturday's game versus Vanderbilt, per the SEC availability report.
news.details: Anderson, who was listed as questionable on the team's initial report, has officially been ruled out for Saturday's contest. It's a tough blow for the Wildcats as Anderson has 13 catches for 157 yards and one touchdown across the last three games. His next chance to play is after the bye week at Tennessee.

news.summary: Anderson (undisclosed) is not on the injury report ahead of Saturday's matchup against Louisville.
news.details: Anderson will return to action Saturday against the Cardinals after missing the previous two weeks with an undisclosed injury. In three games, the freshman running back has 30 carries for 146 yards and two touchdowns.

news.summary: Dupree is expected to play in Saturday's game versus USC, per the Big Ten availability report.
news.details: Dupree popped up on Thursday's availability report, though he doesn't appear to be dealing with anything serious given his probable designation. The junior has 49 carries for 215 yards and two touchdowns through six games this season.

news.summary: Wormley posted three rushes for 52 yards and one touchdown and gathered in their only target for two yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 42-35 victory against Rutgers.
news.details: The Trojans had a solid lead, so they brought out Gormley, but he played well enough to stay in while the Scarlet Knights came roaring back. Wormley is one of the best adds of the freshman class, ensuring that the never-ending conveyor belt of USC running back talent won't stop moving anytime soon.

news.summary: Maiava was 21-for-33 passing for 301 yards and three touchdowns during Saturday's 31-23 victory against Penn State.
news.details: Road wins on the East Coast have been hard to come by for the Trojans, but Maiava helped the team buck the trend in Happy Valley. he delivered another excellent total and powere dUSC offense to a much-needed win. They'll get a week off as they prepare to face another stiff test against Wisconsin.

news.summary: Sama (upper body) is ready to roll ahead of Saturday's game versus UCLA, per the Big Ten availability report.
news.details: Sama has tallied just five carries in the last three games due to a variety of injuries, but he's seemingly the team's best option in the backfield and figures to see his fair share of toes Saturday. He enters the day averaging 6.8 yards per carry, tallying 28 for 190 yards and a score in his three appearances.

news.summary: Russell totaled six receptions (on nine targets) for 53 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 34-26 defeat to Louisville.
news.details: The freshman from Opa Locka, Fla. saw his first meaningful action at UConn on Oct. 13, but he saw a total of seven touches in this one. Russell has tremendous upside, and he might carve out a nice role for himself in the offense if he can continue to take advantage of opportunities when they present themselves.

news.summary: Curtis completed 19 of 31 passes for 274 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions during Saturday's 31-21 loss against Arkansas. He also had eight rushes for 13 yards.
news.details: Curtis averaged 8.8 yards-per-pass attempt and connected with wide receiver Junior Sherrill for a 24-yard touchdown, but his two interceptions proved costly, including one returned for a touchdown. The freshman quarterback will work to limit his mistakes when Vanderbilt travels to Kentucky next Saturday.

news.summary: Bacheyie reeled in 5 of 6 targets for 29 yards during Saturday's 34-26 defeat to Louisville.
news.details: Bacheyie's five receptions marked a new season high, but he also saw his four-game touchdown streak halted. He'll look to start a new touchdown-scoring streak on Saturday at North Carolina.

news.summary: Barnes logged eight carries for 100 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 45-21 victory over South Alabama.
news.details: Barnes saw action for just the second time this season and capitalized. The senior running back had his first 100-yard performance since 2024 against Maine.

news.summary: Jackson (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game against Michigan State.
news.details: After a one-game absence, Jackson is available, which may be needed if Abu Sama (upper body) out leaves the Badgers without their top rusher. With 15 carries this season, Jackson has logged 57 yards, good enough for a 3.8 better than his 2025 average (3.4) with USC.

news.summary: Brown (undisclosed) is questionable for Saturday's clash with Northern Illinois, per the Mountain West availability report.
news.details: Brown is aiming to return to action for the first time since Week 5. He serves as a depth option in the receiving corps, so a potential absence would not alter the team's wide receiver rotation.

news.summary: Guerin (undisclosed) will miss Saturday's game versus UTSA, per the American Athletic availability report.
news.details: Guerin will miss a game for the first time this season. He hasn't been much of an asset on offense, however, as he's made just one catch all season long. His next chance to play will come against North Texas on Saturday, Oct. 24.

news.summary: Mulder (undisclosed) will miss Saturday's game versus South Florida, per the MAC availability report.
news.details: Mulder won't be an option to play against USF, but he hasn't been a big contributor on offense. It remains to be seen when he'll be able to step back on the field.

news.summary: Bray accrued three rushes for 82 yards and one touchdown and reeled in all four targets for 19 yards during Saturday's 33-0 win versus Utah State.
news.details: Bray made the most of his opportunities against Utah State, breaking loose for a 63-yard touchdown run, his first rushing score of the season. While the workload was limited, the explosive play immediately put him on fantasy managers' radar. Bray's role is still somewhat dependent on efficiency and big plays, but this performance showed the upside he brings. He's worth monitoring as conference play begins.

news.summary: Dampier was 24-for-41 passing for 278 yards, three touchdowns and two interceptions during Saturday's 27-24 win over Colorado. He also had eight rushes for negative eight yards.
news.details: Dampier has now accounted for seven total touchdowns over the last two weeks, but he also committed two turnovers for the second consecutive game, a trend that bears watching as Utah entered the toughest stretch of its schedule. Even with the turnovers, Dampier remains one of the nation's most productive fantasy quarterbacks thanks to his ability to generate points through both the air and on the ground. That versatility will be put to the test this week when undefeated Utah welcomes a surging H

news.summary: Andrews caught his only target for eight yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 27-24 victory over Colorado.
news.details: Andrews needed only one catch to make an impact, turning it into an eight-yard touchdown on Utah's opening drive against Colorado. The score was his second touchdown of the season, and while the weekly volume remains minimal, Andrews continues to show a knack for capitalizing on his limited opportunities near the goal line.

news.summary: Grice (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's contest against Tulsa, per the American Athletic availability report.
news.details: Grice is set to miss his second consecutive game for Rice. The wideout has seen action in an Owls' passing attack that rarely utilizes the air game, reeling in six receptions for 64 yards on 10 targets. His next chance to play will come against Florida Atlantic next Saturday.

news.summary: McGary (shoulder) reeled in his only target for 10 yards during Saturday's 77-6 win against Southern University.
news.details: With a singular reception, McGary is only three yards away from tying the 13 that he logged for Houston last season. He earned a big move to UH thanks to his previous success with Tulsa, and the tight end is hoping that said production can be replicated for this year's Cougars.

news.summary: Hall (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Saturday's contest versus Syracuse, per the ACC availability report.
news.details: Hall went down with a hamstring injury during last week's contest against Syracuse, putting his status in question for Saturday. The running back plays a prominent role in North Carolina's backfield, having rushed for 283 yards and five touchdowns on 57 carries across six games. If he is unavailable, Jaylen McGill could see more carries.

news.summary: Weigman was 24-for-33 passing for 343 yards, five touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 35-32 win against Oklahoma State. He also had 11 rushes for 52 yards.
news.details: Weigman was excellent in Saturday's ranked victory, throwing a career-high five touchdown passes to get past the ranked Cowboys. He also threw for over 300 yards for the second time this season and rushed for 50 yards for the third time in his last five games. It's been a phenomenal season so far for Weigman, but he doesn't have any time to celebrate just yet with a road contest at No. 10 Utah coming up on Saturday.

news.summary: Sanford accrued nine rushes for 36 yards and caught their only target for 10 yards during Saturday's 35-32 victory against Oklahoma State.
news.details: After seemingly taking over the backfield across the last three games with 55 rushing attempts, Sanford took the backseat to Makhi Hughes on Saturday. He stayed relevant with 10 touches, but it was a stark difference compared to the last three games. With another difficult matchup Saturday at Utah, Sanford isn't the best play considering his now uncertain place in the backfield.

news.summary: Foster (undisclosed) is still dealing with his soft-tissue injury, Andrew E. Graham of Mitten Football reports.
news.details: There is some clarification on how Foster is doing, albeit without publicizing where he is hurt going into Week 8. For now, his injury status is in question for Saturday's game against Miami (OH).

news.summary: Kim (undisclosed) is questionable for Week 8 at Ohio, per Andrew E. Graham of Mitten Football.
news.details: "We'll just see how much Kim can take during the week," Eastern Michigan head coach Chris Creighton said Monday. Kim suffered the undisclosed injury against Toledo in Week 7 on a day where he tossed for 214 yards and two touchdowns, also losing a fumble. If Kim can't go, expect Jace Stuckey to draw the start in his stead.

news.summary: Angeli (undisclosed) has been deemed questionable for Saturday's matchup versus North Carolina, per the ACC availability report.
news.details: Angeli has missed Syracuse's last three games while dealing with an undisclosed injury, and it remains to be seen whether the signal-caller will be back in the mix for this weekend. Malachi Nelson (leg) and Amari Odom (shoulder) are out, meaning Danny Lauter could end up starting despite being the No. 4 QB on the roster.

news.summary: Humphrey (undisclosed) won't be available for Saturday's contest versus Syracuse, per the ACC availability report.
news.details: Humphrey will sit out his second straight contest for North Carolina. The wideout serves as a depth option in the receiving corps, so his absence should not affect the Tar Heels' offensive game plan. He will aim to return against Miami in Week 9.

news.summary: Neer (undisclosed) was shaken up after crashing into a video board on the sideline in the second quarter of Ohio's 48-7 blowout win over Sacramento State, per Cam Robertson of the Athens Messenger.
news.details: Neer didn't return to action after his collision on the sideline. The receiver has been quite productive this season, and he's up to 32 catches for 441 yards and five scores through seven games. However, his status is somewhat murky after he was knocked out of the Week 7 win over Sacramento State. Up next for Ohio is a home hame against Eastern Michigan on Saturday, Oct. 24.

news.summary: Milliner will miss Saturday's game versus Charlotte, per the American availability report.
news.details: Milliner has been a key piece of the Mean Green's passing attack this season, so his absence will certainly be a ding heading into the matchup. Fortunately, North Texas has an off week on deck, so Milliner will have an additional week to rest up before the team returns to action Oct. 24 versus Navy.

news.summary: Ficklin rushed for two yards on a single carry during Saturday's 27-24 victory against Colorado.
news.details: Ficklin didn't attempt a pass, but he once again saw action as part of Utah's situational package, recording a rushing attempt. Ficklin has logged at least one rushing attempt in every game this season, showing Utah remains committed to finding opportunities for him even with Devon Dampier entrenched as the starter.

news.summary: Patrick (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game versus Miami (OH), per the MAC availability report.
news.details: Patrick is set to miss his first game of the season for Akron. The running back, through six games, has notched 41 attempts for 221 yards. Marquese Williams is in line to fill his role in the backfield.

news.summary: Easter (undisclosed) will be in uniform for Saturday's matchup versus Syracuse, per the ACC availability report.
news.details: Easter is slated to take the field Saturday after suffering an undisclosed injury in Week 7 against Duke. He will add depth to North Carolina's tight end group.

news.summary: Bond (undisclosed) did not play in Saturday's 34-14 win against Eastern Michigan.
news.details: Bond sat out his first game of the season Saturday despite not being listed on Toledo's injury report. It is unclear why the wide receiver was sidelined, as he has played consistent snaps for the offense this season. His status will be worth monitoring heading into a Week 8 matchup against Western Michigan.

news.summary: Hughes notched 18 carries for 77 yards and caught their only target for three yards during Saturday's 35-32 victory versus Oklahoma State.
news.details: Hughes had a season-high 18 carries Saturday, an excellent sign considering he was out-touched by Re'Shaun Sanford across the last three games. Hughes didn't light up the stat sheet, but he helped keep the chains moving in the very important victory. He's set to be relied on a lot again Saturday at No. 10 Utah.

news.summary: Carvalho (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game against Iowa State, per the Big 12 availability report.
news.details: Carvalho has seemingly recovered from his undisclosed issue and has cleared Utah's injury report. The wideout has appeared in every game this season, recording two receptions for 38 yards.

news.summary: Baxter (undisclosed) has been given the green light for Saturday's matchup versus Vanderbilt, per the SEC availability report.
news.details: Baxter, who was listed as probable on the team's initial report, has now been cleared to play Saturday versus Vanderbilt. It's great news for the Wildcats as Baxter has over 500 yards from scrimmage and eight touchdowns this season.

news.summary: Isaac (undisclosed) will miss Saturday's game versus Toledo, per the MAC availability report.
news.details: Isaac will be held out during this week's contest as he continues to work his way back from an undisclosed injury. He will aim to be available for next week's meeting with Ohio.

news.summary: Flores is in concussion protocol following Saturday's 21-14 defeat against Western Michigan, according to Double C Sports.
news.details: This puts Flores' status for the Chippewas' next game in question pending further updates on Tuesday. Any absence would affect Central Michigan's quarterback plans after Flores handled a major rushing workload in Saturday's loss. If he's out, look for Jadyn Glasser to have a bigger role under center.

news.summary: Jackson (undisclosed) will miss Saturday's game versus Tulsa, per the American Athletic availability report.
news.details: Jackson will miss his first game of the season due to undisclosed reasons as the Owls host Tulsa in Week 7. The 5-foot-11 wideout has tallied seven receptions for 102 yards and a touchdown across six games after transferring in from Cincinnati. Jackson's next chance to appear will come on the road against FAU in Week 8.

news.summary: Devereaux (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's contest versus Toledo, per the MAC availability report.
news.details: Devereaux has been troubled by an undisclosed injury that will force him to miss his fourth consecutive contest. The wideout last played in Week 3 against Wisconsin, where he hauled in three receptions for 38 yards and one touchdown. In his absence, Harold Mack and Benson Prosper are set for expanded roles in the passing attack.

news.summary: King (undisclosed) will miss Saturday's game versus South Florida, per the MAC availability report.
news.details: King will not be an option in the backfield and is set to miss his first game of the season. The running back splits carries with Brandon White, positioning Jakorion Caffey to see an increased workload in his absence.

news.summary: Mateer was 24-for-40 passing for 270 yards, one touchdown and three interceptions during Saturday's 21-13 defeat against Kentucky. He also had 13 rushes for nine yards.
news.details: Mateer's three interceptions overshadowed his passing production, including a costly fourth-quarter pick-six that helped Kentucky secure the victory. The junior quarterback will look to clean up his turnovers when the team visits Mississippi State next Saturday.

news.summary: Laughery recorded 17 rushes for 70 yards and reeled in 4 of 6 targets for 24 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 38-37 overtime victory versus Michigan State.
news.details: Laughery had a solid day on the ground, leading the way for the Fighting Illini with 70 yards, but his biggest contribution came through the air. The 5-foot-11 senior connected with quarterback Katin Houser on a five-yard touchdown toss in the first quarter, giving the Illini a 10-0 lead at the time. Laughery will hope to keep the positive momentum going when Illinois host Oregon following the team's upcoming bye.

news.summary: Davison recorded 12 rushes for 29 yards during Saturday's 17-14 victory versus Nebraska.
news.details: Davison's results finished well behind Dierre Hill, who looked like the more explosive back for the second consecutive week, although the yardage differential last week was similar. Davison is struggling to gain yards after contact, and while he's a bigger back suited to short-yardage situations, Hill seems to have a slight edge in getting more touches right now.

news.summary: Avant totaled 10 rushes for 72 yards and one touchdown and caught all two targets for 16 yards during Saturday's 27-24 victory over Texas.
news.details: Avant led Oklahoma's backfield with 72 rushing yards, averaging an impressive 7.2 yards-per-carry while finding the end zone on a two-yard run. The junior running back will work to build on this performance for next week's meeting with Kentucky.

news.summary: Simpson is absent from the lineup Monday in Game 1 of the ALCS against the Guardians.
news.details: With left-hander Foster Griffin toeing the rubber for Cleveland, the left-handed-hitting Simpson will begin the festivities on the bench. The Rays will roll out Ryan Vilade in left field. Simpson is a good bet to eventually enter Monday's contest after the Guardians turn to their bullpen.

news.summary: Turang went 2-for-3 with two walks, a double, an RBI and three runs in Game 2 of the NLCS against the Dodgers on Monday.
news.details: The second baseman never found his swing during the NLDS against the Padres, going 2-for-16 with two walks and a stolen base, but he's been a force through two games versus the Dodgers with three walks and two extra-base hits. Turang posted career bests during the regular season with 21 homers, 100 RBI, 102 runs and an .816 OPS in 151 contests, and his bat has quickly come alive after a slow start to the playoffs.

news.summary: Bauers was named the NLCS MVP after going 1-for-3 with a walk, a double and three RBI in Game 4 against the Dodgers on Thursday.
news.details: The first baseman's ground-rule double during the fourth inning cut a 4-0 deficit in half, and he brought home another run with a bases-loaded walk in the fifth. There were a few strong options to be named series MVP for Milwaukee, but it's hard to argue against Bauers, who went 4-for-14 with three walks, a double, a homer and six RBI during the four-game sweep.

news.summary: Caminero went 2-for-3 with a walk, a two-run home run and an additional run scored in Game 6 of the ALCS versus Cleveland on Monday.
news.details: The 23-year-old extended Tampa Bay's lead to 5-1 with a two-run shot in the seventh inning, his first home run of the postseason. Caminero entered the contest with a .636 OPS through eight playoff games, but his Game 6 performance boosted his slash line to .273/.351/.455 in 43 plate appearances this postseason. With the Rays now headed to the World Series, he may have found his power stroke just in time.

news.summary: Yelich is out of the lineup for Game 1 of the NLCS against the Dodgers on Sunday, Curt Hogg of the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel reports.
news.details: Yelich started all four games versus San Diego during the NLDS, including the series opener versus lefty Robbie Ray, but the veteran slugger will hit the bench Sunday with ace southpaw Tarik Skubal taking the mound for Los Angeles. Yelich was a key piece of Milwaukee's offense versus the Padres -- going 5-for-14 with a double, two steals, one RBI and two runs -- and the Brewers may need him to deliver similar numbers to make the World Series. The 34-year-old will likely make an appearance off th

news.summary: Aranda went 3-for-4 with a walk, two RBI and two runs during Game 4 of the ALCS against the Guardians on Saturday.
news.details: The first baseman went hitless in the first three games of the series, but he delivered a pair of RBI singles and scored twice Saturday to help Tampa Bay even the series 2-2. Aranda homered in Game 1 of the ALCS against the Yankees but is otherwise without an extra-base hit in October. Still, the three-hit performance improve his postseason slash line to .269/.345/.385 through seven games.

news.summary: Chourio went 1-for-4 with two RBI in Game 2 of the NLDS against the Padres on Sunday.
news.details: The 22-year-old outfielder came through in the clutch during the bottom of the ninth inning with a two-out, two-run single off All-Star closer Mason Miller to turn a 3-2 deficit into a 4-3 victory. Chourio clubbed a two-run homer in Game 1 on Saturday and has been the key offensive cog for the Brewers in the first two games of the series, driving in four of the team's seven runs. He's batted leadoff in both contests and is likely to stick there, with manager Pat Murphy looking to get the outfiel

news.summary: Diaz went 1-for-4 with a two-run home run in Game 6 of the ALCS against the Guardians on Monday.
news.details: Diaz now has an extra-base hit in four straight postseason contests, going 7-for-18 with three doubles, two homers, four RBI and five runs during that span. The 35-year-old's homer Monday provided some key insurance runs late, pushing Tampa Bay's lead to 7-3 in the eighth inning to help secure a World Series berth. Diaz has a .906 OPS in 41 plate appearances during the postseason.

news.summary: DeLuca will start in center field and bat seventh Monday in Game 2 of the ALDS against the Yankees.
news.details: Cedric Mullins was the Rays' primary center fielder versus righties during the regular season. However, it's been DeLuca at the postion for each of the team's first two playoff games, despite the Yankees starting a right-hander in both contests. DeLuca went hitless in three plate appearances in Game 1.

news.summary: Mitchell (neck) will start in center field and bat seventh in Friday's game against the Orioles.
news.details: Mitchell didn't start the last two days due to a neck issue. However, he appeared in Thursday's game versus the Pirates off the bench and is back in the lineup for Friday's series opener in Baltimore.

news.summary: Misiorowski will start Game 1 of the NLCS against the Dodgers on Sunday.
news.details: Misiorowski took the mound to begin the opening contest of the NLDS against San Diego, and the Brewers will turn to their ace again to begin their best-of-seven series against Los Angeles. The 24-year-old is a strong contender to take home the NL Cy Young Award after posting a 1.80 ERA and 0.80 WHIP across 174.2 innings in the regular season, but he wasn't quite as dominant during his first postseason outing, allowing two runs on four hits and a walk while fanning six batters in four innings.

news.summary: Contreras went 3-for-4 with a walk, a solo home run and two additional RBI in Monday's win against the Dodgers in Game 2 of the NLCS.
news.details: The 28-year-old continues to wield a hot bat this postseason, as he's hitting .391 (9-for-23) with four walks, three homers, five RBI and four runs through six games. Contreras has entrenched himself as the Brewers' No. 3 hitter and has been the engine of the offense thus far in October.

news.summary: Hicks is absent from the lineup Monday for Game 1 of the ALCS against the Guardians.
news.details: Hicks went just 1-for-10 at the plate in the ALDS sweep of the Yankees. With the Guardians turning to southpaw Foster Griffin in Game 1, the left-handed-hitting Hicks will yield to Nick Fortes at catcher for the Rays.

news.summary: Mesa is out of the lineup for Game 5 of the ALCS against the Guardians on Sunday.
news.details: The 25-year-old had started all seven of Tampa Bay's playoff games, but he'll head to the bench Sunday against Cleveland lefty Parker Messick. Mesa clubbed a decisive two-run homer in Game 3 of the ALDS versus the Yankees, but overall he's batting just .160 (4-for-25) with 11 strikeouts in October.

news.summary: Pratt (illness) will start at shortstop and bat seventh Saturday against the Cardinals.
news.details: Pratt missed out on the starting nine Friday but entered the game off the bench, and he now seems to be feeling well enough to resume serving as Milwaukee's starting shortstop. The 22-year-old has enjoyed quite a bit of success at the plate this month, batting .306 (19-for-62) with 12 RBI, eight runs scored and six steals over 19 games.

news.summary: Frelick is absent from the lineup for Wednesday's tilt versus the Pirates.
news.details: It's the third straight game that the left-handed-swinging Frelick has been out of the lineup, and all three of them have come against righties. Jake Bauers will cover right field, and Andrew Vaughn will be at first base for the Brewers.

news.summary: Palacios is out of the lineup for Game 5 of the ALCS against the Guardians on Sunday.
news.details: Palacios went 3-for-4 with a stolen base and two runs in Game 4 on Saturday but will take a seat Sunday since southpaw Parker Messick is starting for Cleveland. Ben Williamson is manning the keystone and batting eighth in a pivotal Game 5.

news.summary: Walls went 3-for-4 with three runs scored and an RBI in the second game of Tuesday's doubleheader against the Yankees.
news.details: The shortstop led the charge in a 6-1 win for the Rays that clinched the AL East crown, and a first-round bye in the playoffs. Walls is in the lineup for his defense, not his offense, but despite a hip issue that cost him a good chunk of September, he's put together a .289/.364/.342 slash line over 46 plate appearances since Aug. 28 with two doubles, two steals, five RBI and nine runs in 13 contests.

news.summary: Hamilton went 2-for-4 with a solo homer, a stolen base, two total RBI and two total runs in Game 4 of the NLCS against the Dodgers on Thursday.
news.details: The speedy infielder contributed in his typical fashion during the fifth inning with an RBI single, a steal and a run scored, and he followed up by doubling the Brewers' lead with a ninth-inning solo shot off Edwin Diaz to help Milwaukee complete the series sweep. Hamilton clubbed only four homers in 121 regular-season games, the last of which he hit Aug. 18 versus the Mariners.
